row.name: DACHstudio Jigsaw Puzzle Box
row.detailed_description: Welcome to DACHstudio Jigsaw Puzzle Box - where beautifully hand drawn art meets the most relaxing gameplay. From relaxing 4x4 (16 pieces) puzzles to the mind-bending and challenging 28x26 (728 pieces) grids, challenge yourself or just relax at your own pace. Get two Free Images per DLC to see if you vibe with the artworks before buying a DLC. Support the artists you like. Attention achievement hunters: Some achievements can only be reached by playing the DLCs. Features 2 free images for each available DLC to puzzle Optional puzzle piece rotation Multiple levels of difficulty Different mouse cursors Different backgrounds Zoom Relaxing music and atmosphere
row.short_description: Beautifully drawn artworks from the DACHstudio members for you to puzzle. Multiple difficulties from 16 up to 728 pieces 🧩 for everyone to enjoy.

row.name: QuickSwitch
row.detailed_description: Welcome to QuickSwitch, a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter that takes intensity to a whole new level. Engage in fierce combat across various gamemodes such as : - Free-For-All - Team Deathmatch - Capture the Flag - Survival Arena You can also build your QuickSwitch experience to your own liking with highly customisable lobbies. Choose between a large range of skins, weapons combo, and lot of maps presenting different tactical challenges. Showcase your skills with detailed player statistics, leaderboards and in-game profiles. Join our vibrant and cozy community, pulsing with camaraderie, where legends like g0dak stand shoulder to shoulder with aspiring newcomers. Compete in high-stakes tournaments for glory and rewards. Whether you‘re a seasoned competitor or a newbie seeking thrills, QuickSwitch promises an immersive and inclusive gaming experience that will keep you coming back for more.
row.short_description: Fast Multiplayer 2D shooter, focusing on skills and timing. Vast variety of gamemodes, maps, weapons, skins. Fight for your ranking and glory !

row.name: Shy Cats Hidden Tracks - Paris
row.detailed_description: This is a game of pure art like no other. It combines Hidden Object with Music Creation! And you will be the conducting maestro! 170 + hidden objects 60 Singers! Each singer plays a different melody Find fans around town to get more money Hint System Shop System with 10 different musicians to hire In a beautifully hand-drawn scenery! They are all ultra-cute kittens, hand-animated with an exclusive soundtrack composed solely for the game.
row.short_description: A unique musical hidden object game where you search the streets of Paris for singing kittens from a choir and money bags to hire and assemble a cat band. As orchestra conductor, you'll be able to configure the musicians as you wish, creating your own music and choir melodies. Find them all!

row.name: Pizzakai
row.detailed_description: You died, and have been Isekai'd into a world where you are Pizza. You cannot doubt that this is awesome. Use Various Weapons to Put Holes in Your Favorite Foods! - Use a Caesar's Downfall to decimate all visible enemies! - Use a Howie's Little Friend to smack your adversaries into the next dimension! - Use a The Domino Effect to burn your way through obstacles! Explore a Large Level and Encounter Various Enemies - An agile breadstick that breaks into two and will try to slice you up! - A cowardly chicken wing that runs away, and throws molotovs to overcook you! - A hefty deep dish pizza that can tank much more than your own thin crust! Credits Secret Ten Studios: Zane O'Dell (Producer and Weapon/Systems/Dialogue/UI Engineer) Suraj Karthikeyan (Producer/Systems Engineer/VFX Artist/Sound Designer/Weapon Engineer & Designer) Farhan Parekh (2D Artist) Connor Miller (Level Designer/UI Designer/Weapon Designer/Mechanics Designer/Gameplay Designer/Animation Programmer) Andrew Tran (Level Designer) Eli Mcardle (Movement Programmer) Ryan Chang (AI Engineer) Matthew DeBoer (Gameplay Programmer) Elex McCoy (Game Writer) Lyndsay Mohr (Sound Designer) Chari Bayar (Composer)
row.short_description: Play as a deceased man by the name of Peppy who has been recently reincarnated as a freshly baked Pizza mobster. Offered a deal by a 'Pizza God,' Peppy must enter the crime den of the House of Unified Triple-Cheeses and engage in combat if he wants any chance of returning to his own world.

row.name: Typing Tales
row.detailed_description: Typing Tales is a pure typing game. It can be played without touching your mouse even once. Put your skills to the test or practice a new language and have fun! 🤯 fight, navigate and use abilities, all with your keyboard 🤯 😱 unlock more content through runs 😱 ⌨️ navigate the whole game with your keyboard ⌨️ Key Features dynamic difficulty 👉 so you can relax or go as hard as you want! roguelike 👉 unlock maps, secrets, musics, characters and enemies across runs! explore 👉 maps can be moved through to find pickups or secrets! unique enemies 👉 all enemies have unique abilities! choose your length 👉 engage in short sessions or in endless mode!
row.short_description: Typing Tales is a typing survivors like. Slay enemies to unlock new abilities and upgrade existing ones. Progress to uncover new game modes, maps, characters and abilities. Can you discover all secrets and get all achievements?

row.name: Rocksmith+
row.detailed_description: Learn guitar and piano with an expanding library of thousands of songs! Rocksmith+, an award-winning music learning service, is the evolution from Rocksmith 2014 Edition, which had to be retired for music licensing requirements. In Rocksmith+, the catalog of licensed songs is different and expanded. As for the key features that made prior iterations help millions of players learn how to play guitar, they are the same. But Rocksmith+ now also includes piano – for the same price. Our key features include Riff Repeater and Adaptative Difficulty to hone your skills. Rocksmith is the only music learning service that adjusts difficulty as you play. So, join the 5+ million of players to learn at YOUR pace with real-time feedback and song exercises. Rock on! Note: If you purchased Rocksmith 2014 Edition, you can continue to use it.
row.short_description: Learn guitar and piano with an expanding library of thousands of songs!

row.name: Dino Cats
row.detailed_description: 👽 CHECK OUT THE COSMO CATS! 🤖 DIVE INTO THE ADVENTURE WITH ROBO CATS! ❄️ DIVE INTO WINTER ADVENTURE WITH CATS! About the Game 🦕 Once you get to the dino park, you find a lot of cats that have settled here. Find 100 hidden cats here - for free! 🌈 Paint them in your favorite colors by simply clicking on them. You can choose a color in the pause menu. 🌒 Negative mode will show you the game in new colors. 🔮 Stuck? Use the hint button! 🕓 There's a time mode, for the fastest cat finders. 🏆 Also: 100 achievements named by the players themselves Saving progress 15+ real meow sounds Camera zoom in and out Gamepad support Brightness settings Suitable for all ages Also 1 bonus level: ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤDiscord:ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤTwitter: ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ
row.short_description: 🦕 Hidden Dino Cats - Find and paint 100 hidden cats in this dinosaur park! Test your attention and relax in this cozy and free game 😺

row.name: Horizon Valley
row.detailed_description: Embark on an endless adventure in our dynamic endless runner game where every run is a unique experience! Navigate through a constantly changing landscape filled with thrilling obstacles that will put your reflexes to the test. But that's not all - immerse yourself in a world of customization with our diverse range of menus. Personalize your character with an array of stunning outfits, unlock epic treasures from mysterious chests, and watch as your avatar transforms into a true legend before your eyes. With each run, discover new challenges and breathtaking vistas, ensuring every moment is filled with excitement and anticipation. Get ready to run, customize, and conquer like never before in our captivating endless runner experience!
row.short_description: Horizon Valley is an exciting endless runner where you'll encounter different types of scenarios. Your goal is not only to set a new record with every attempt but also to unlock incredible characters and ships that suit your style. You can obtain them through random chests, special spins, and more!

row.name: 箱庭小駅伝
row.detailed_description: あなたのPCの中に箱庭駅伝狂会ができて、年3回の駅伝大会を開催するようになります。 箱庭感覚の駅伝シミュレーションゲームです。 各大学40人、40大学で計1600名の選手が正月駅伝出場、さらには駅伝3冠を目指して練習に励んでいます。 あなたはどん底の状態にある一つの大学を選び監督になりチームを運営します。 主なイベントは以下のとおりです。 4月　新入生が入ってきます。 5月　陸上トラック5000ｍ、10000ｍ、ハーフマラソンの大会が行われます。 6月　「11月駅伝」の予選会が行われます。 8月　夏合宿が行われます。夏合宿は能力を大きく伸ばすチャンスです。 10月　「10月駅伝」が行われます。また、「正月駅伝」の予選会も行われます。 11月　「11月駅伝」が行われます。 1月　「正月駅伝」が行われます。 3月　「学生ハーフ」ハーフマラソン大会が行われます。 駅伝三冠を目指してもよいですし、目指さなくてもよいですし、ただ記録を眺めているだけでもよいですし、 お好きなプレイスタイルでご自身のペースでお楽しみください。
row.short_description: 箱庭感覚の駅伝シミュレーションゲームです。

row.name: Sharpshooter
row.detailed_description: Fully playable with the Revolver. Buy the 'Supporter Pack DLC' to support my work and get more weapons to play with: Machine Gun, Bow, Carbine, Coach Gun, Repeater and Dual Pistols. ::: STORY ::: The outlaws aren't too happy about you jailing their leader, Sheriff. They're all over town. Grab your six-shooter and clear them out. ::: STRAIGHTFORWARD NON-STOP ACTION ::: Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns. Get rid of all outlaws or die trying. ::: CUSTOMIZE GAMEPLAY MECHANICS ::: There is a bunch of options that modify different aspects of how the game mechanics work. This allows you to shape the difficulty to suit your playstyle and skill level. Do you want the gunfights to require hardcore skill or just be casual? Here are some examples: What reaction time should outlaws have, and how well do they aim? Do you want projectiles to be affected by gravity? Should damage account for velocity? Choose the amount of health you have and if it regenerates after a specified time. Should reloading be realistic, fast, or not even needed? ...
row.short_description: Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns. Customize the gameplay mechanics to suit your playstyle. Straightforward, non-stop action.
row.notes: Blood effects when hitting enemies that splatters the enviroment. Bullet wounds on bodies. Dismemberment. All can be disabled.

row.name: Pipe Escape
row.detailed_description: Pipe Escape is a tight controlled 2D puzzle game where the only objective is to escape a labyrinth of pipes whilst in a constant state of spin. Work with the spin, not against it. Encounter the challenges that await in the maze of leaky pipes. The pipes are inhabited by bats and you are not welcome. Find your way to an exit through the depths of this pipe hell!
row.short_description: A 2D puzzle game with a spin! Make your way through obstacle courses of pipes, water streams and bats as fast as you can whilst spinning out of control.

row.name: 怪異ジャッジ・ラビリンス
row.detailed_description: すべてのものが「意味ありげ」な探索推理ファンタジー！ 　怪異の正体が「元人間」か「本物の怪異」かを二択でジャッジ！ もし、判断を間違えると………大変なことになります。 目の前に広がるワンダーランドは、誰かの心の世界か？それとも、怪異の罠か…？ ■5つの世界を探索！→1つの世界が15分で遊べる短編集！ ■エンドはそれぞれの怪異ごとに「①成功」「②失敗（正体を間違える）」「③タイムオーバー（怪異のジャッジ中に理性ゼロ）」の3パターンがあります。 ■実況・生放送：大歓迎です！大変励みになります！ （動画のタイトルには「ゲーム名」を入れて、説明文にはこのゲームページURLを入れておいてください。） 《遊び方》【キーボード】 カーソルキーで移動　　Enter/Z/スペースキーで決定　　Xキーでキャンセル 【マウス】 左クリックで決定　右クリックでキャンセル 本ゲームからプログラム又は素材を抽出して配布等する行為（有償であるか又は無償であるかを問いません）は禁止です。 本ゲームからプログラム又は素材を抽出して改変する行為は禁止です。 本ゲームから素材を抽出して自作のゲームに使用する行為（有償であるか又は無償であるかを問いません）は禁止です。 クレジット 《制作ツール・素材》 RPGツクールMZ 権利表記：「©Gotcha Gotcha Games Inc./YOJI OJIMA 2020」 《効果音》効果音ラボ様
row.short_description: 不思議な世界にとびこむ、探索型カジュアル推理ファンタジー！ ヒントを得るたび主人公の様子がおかしくなっていき…

row.name: SpHero
row.detailed_description: You are a Sphere, you are a Hero, you are... a SpHero! The jealous tetrahedrons and hexahedrons have had enough of your no-corner business and decided to take over Spheria. Use your Spherical powers to overcome your enemies and the trials ahead. You will be able to roll faster, bounce higher, throw fireballs or be a rolling magnet! Venture in 60 hand crafted levels and defeat 6 Boxes (bosses). Customize your costume and become the ball you always wanted to be with your own combination of patterns, flags and colors! Traverse treacherous and challenging uniquely themed levels and make it to the finish.
row.short_description: You are a Sphere, you are a Hero, you are... a SpHero! Use your Spherical powers to overcome your enemies and the trials ahead. You will be able to roll faster, bounce higher, throw fireballs or be a rolling magnet! Venture in 60 hand crafted levels and defeat 6 Boxes (bosses).

row.name: 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD Roadmap About the Game ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW After a conversation with President of Underwood Corporation, you must urgently go to the studio for the shooting of a new episode of the Paranormal Investigators TV show. Unfortunately, the elevator is broken and you need to go through 50 floors on the stairs, but there are 3 simple rules: 1. If there is no anomaly, go down to the floor below. 2. If there is an anomaly, return to the floor above. 3. The corridor is safe, but if it changes, the rules will change. 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue is inspired by games like The Stanley Parable, PT, The Exit 8, and narrates what happened a couple of hours before the events in the Paranormal Investigators. Key Features: 200 options for anomalies 4 endings Jump scares VHS Filter
row.short_description: Find a way out.
row.notes: This game contains scenes related to the themes of suicide, murder and psychological violence. The game is not recommended for people who currently have difficulty with these issues.

row.name: Necrosphere64
row.detailed_description: Enjoy your stay in the afterlife. Features [sic]: State-of-the-art 64×64 pixel resolution 2-button controls , and neither of them jumps Ultra- minimalist approach to Metroidvania Proudly short : About 2—3 hours long Collectibles, power-ups, and bosses like every game Instant respawn — dying is a core mechanic Hard and frustrating (it's a feature) Speedrun-friendly: in-game timer and almost no RNG Bespoke soundtrack by Patricia Taxxon (complete album at bandcamp: patriciataxxon ) Join our discord to chat with the developers and community! From super casual players to turbo speedrunners, you are very welcome!!
row.short_description: An adventure that will test your skills using only 2 buttons!

row.name: Soul Eater
row.detailed_description: About this Game 'Soul Eater' is an exhilarating 2D platformer roguelike game that offers players a dynamic and constantly evolving gaming experience. With every playthrough, the game dynamically adjusts the positions of enemies and map layouts, guaranteeing that players face fresh challenges and surprises each time they engage with the game. Moreover, players have the option to randomly upgrade their skills, introducing an element of unpredictability and strategic decision-making to their gameplay. Game Story The player embarks on a journey through a sword containing the soul of a being desperate for revenge against their past betrayers. The soul within the sword shares the player's past wounds and anger, fueling a desire for vengeance against their enemies. As the player travels the world, they seek out those who betrayed them in the past, and with each encounter, they have the opportunity to seize their souls. These acquired souls are absorbed into the player, further empowering the player, and allowing player to control the enemy. Controls Move the character 'W','A','S','D' Throw the sword 'R' Interact with NPC 'V' Skill 'Q' Attack 'Left Mouse Click' Parrying ' Drag while holding down the right mouse button ' Requirement 'Soul Eater' only work Window system
row.short_description: The player embarks on a journey through a sword containing the soul of a being desperate for revenge against their past betrayers. As the player travels the world, they seek out those who betrayed them in the past, and with each encounter, they have the opportunity to seize their souls.

row.name: On Track
row.detailed_description: Welcome to On Track! Enjoy a relaxing environment to help you tackle any tasks big or small you’ve been procrastinating on. On Track was built track by track to help you get focused. When you board, name any goal you want to accomplish, set a timer, and get to work! Listen to laidback music and adjust ambient audio if ASMR is more your speed. Manage your Tasks Set a timer and make your to-do list of tasks. Feel accomplished as you cross off each item you’ve completed and re-assured you can edit and delete any tasks as you go. You can start, stop, restart or edit your timer sessions to help you stay on top of your tasks. Watch the World Go By As the landscape rolls by, it will evolve over time as you complete more task sessions. Keep an eye out and you may even see some surprises. You can slow down or stop the train at any time. Relaxing Lo-fi Soundtrack On Track features a playlist of relaxing lo-fi inspired tunes to help you get into your flow state and become one with the train. Adjust the background sound effects for your custom soundscape including the sound of the train and passengers in neighboring train cars. Early Birds and Night Owls Adjust the time of day to your personal taste, from the darkest of nights to the brightest of days.
row.short_description: On Track is a cozy productivity tracker to help you rejuvenate, relax, and focus on tasks you want to accomplish. Watch a lush landscape roll by as you watch from your cozy train seat. Set a timer to focus, manage a todo list with all your goals, and relax as you stay on track.

row.name: Math Path Builder
row.detailed_description: Math Path Builder Challenge yourself at generated levels that get harder and harder. The goal is simple: Connect the path from the origin to all goals, but the numbers need to add up! Every level has exactly one start position. You have one or many goal positions which exact value you need to reach. You can guide a path from the start to each goal. The path can split. Use numbers or modifiers to reach the goals value. Mathematic operations are always done in sequence. The game includes a rudimentary online rank which simply tells you which global rank you have based on your highest completed level. It is best played in a small window. No accounts needed, no advertisements or in-game purchases. The game is completely free. Enjoy!
row.short_description: Create a path to solve all goals. Sounds simple? ... It isn't!

row.name: TRAUMA Pro Wrestling
row.detailed_description: Welcome to TRAUMA Pro Wrestling, a promotion that doesn't kiss ass, nor draw money! Your road to stardom begins today, here's what we got in store for you! -14 different match types, each customizable with steel cages, electric barbed wire & more! -A deep Career mode in which you can become a dastardly heel, a beloved babyface, or a mix of both! -A character editor that allows you to create your dream superstar from head to toe! -Complete control over the game's rules, physics and AI to guarantee replayability and experimentation! -Over 20 wrestlers and 10 arenas to choose from! Since you were wearing diapers and it's always been your dream to compete in one of our rings, so there you go! Now it's your chance to prove your worth! Don't be afraid to take shortcuts, especially if in the form of heavy drugs, and always remember that if your gimmick doesn't work for you, brother, you can persuade the bookers to change it. ...Cash only, thanks. TRAUMA Pro Wrestling, AVAILABLE NOW!
row.short_description: Welcome to TRAUMA Pro Wrestling, a promotion that doesn't kiss ass, nor draw money! Your road to stardom begins today, take a look at what we got in store for you!

row.name: 江梦潮音 J.M.Rhythm
row.detailed_description: J.M.Rhythm is a black-and-white style rhythm game set in the southern regions of Yangtze River of China. It combines the elegance of Chinese ink painting with the beauty of music. We wish you could feel the depth of traditional Chinese art and enjoy the picturesque scenes of 'Jiangnan' while playing this game. It is the first work produced by J.M.Arcady, an indie game team formed by undergraduates. We are dedicated to spreading the essence of Chinese culture through games. One of the game's special features is that you can use our “rhythm generator” to upload your own music and it will generate a corresponding beatmap automatically. The beatmap is written in the form of JSON and allows manual modifications.
row.short_description: J.M.Rhythm is a black-and-white style rhythm game set in the southern regions of Yangtze River of China. It is the first work produced by J.M.Arcady. In this game, you can use our “rhythm generator” to upload your own music and it will generate a corresponding beatmap automatically.

row.name: Escape From Zombietown
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Zombietown! Each zombie has a unique ability. Some zombies are fast, some are slow, and others even explode! Your job is to escape town while taking out the zombies. Watch out for the zombies that shoot lasers, and stay on your feet for the zombies that throw eggs. You never know who could be around the next corner! But Don't Worry, You Have The Right Tools For The Job You can find different equipment around the map. Guns eliminate zombies quickly, but you can run out of ammo if you're not careful. Pills give you temporary powerups, so make them count. Health packs heal you when you get hit by the zombies, and grenades blow up zombies in different ways. The impact blows them up instantly, the incendiary lights the zombies on fire, and the decoy distracts them - the perfect getaway!
row.short_description: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.

row.name: Counterpick Labs
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord About the Game Key Features Mix and match quirky weapons and gadgets to build your perfect fighter. Single player story missions. Classic and roguelike pvp modes. Rollback netcode. Frequent updates with new weapons, missions, upgrades, and more! Smooth platform fighter action Combo your opponents and knock them offstage to secure the win. Play locally or online with rollback netcode. Free to play with no way to buy power. Build your perfect fighter Over 200 (and growing!) loadout combinations, plus countless cosmetic options. For a tanky, ranged build, pair Oleg's might with the Warp Mine's teleport, and hurl Chakrams to deal damage from afar. Or dominate the skies by combining Space Suit's triple jump with Jet Boots' maneuverability and the momentum-altering recoil of the Flame Cannon. Classic & roguelike combat Enjoy intense, skill-based combat in Classic mode. Or try your luck in the roguelike Arena mode, where you'll earn powerful upgrades as you fight, from elemental weapon auras to ricocheting projectiles to dramatic stat boosts.
row.short_description: Counterpick Labs is a free platform fighter where you mix and match gear to build your perfect loadout. Featuring a single player story mode, a roguelike PvP mode where you earn powerful upgrades as you fight, and a classic no-frills PvP mode.

row.name: Unreal Physics
row.detailed_description: Dive into the dynamic world of physics with Unreal Physics an immersive 3D physics sandbox and demo collection that pushes the boundaries of Unreal Engine. This unique experience combines the cutting-edge FluidNinja and Chaos physics systems to deliver a mesmerizing showcase of fluid dynamics, destruction, and realistic simulations. Fluid Dynamics Unleashed: Witness the incredible power of FluidNinja as it brings fluid simulations to life in ways you've never imagined. Whether it's the graceful flow of water, the mesmerizing realism of smoke, or the viscous flowing of molten lava, the fluid dynamics in this sandbox will leave you in awe. Chaos Physics on Display: Brace yourself for a revolution in destructible environments and realistic physics simulations with Unreal Engine's Chaos Physics. Experience the sheer thrill as structures crumble, debris scatters realistically, and chaos ensues in response to your every action. The level of destructibility will redefine your expectations of in-game physics. Endless Possibilities in the Sandbox: Engage with a variety of physics-driven demos and sandbox environments that showcase the versatility of FluidNinja and Chaos Physics. From tinkering with fluid dynamics to unleashing controlled chaos, each demo invites you to explore, experiment, and marvel at the beauty of physics in action. Visual Spectacle: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals that showcase the capabilities of Unreal Engine. From the realistic rendering of fluid surfaces to the intricate details of destructible objects, every frame is a testament to the technological prowess that FluidNinja and Chaos Physics bring to the gaming landscape. Embark on a adventure into the realms of physics with Unreal Physics a playground for FluidNinja and Unreal Engine physics showcasing the possibilities of current physics systems. This sandbox experience isn't just a game – it's a showcase of innovation, creativity, and the awe-inspiring power of physics simulations
row.short_description: Unreal Physics is a exploration of in-game physics like never before, this dynamic 3D sandbox features a mesmerizing collection of demos, showcasing stunning visuals and realistic simulations. It's a playground of endless possibilities where creativity meets the cutting edge of physics technology
row.notes: players can punch and shoot enemy ai

row.name: Milky Way TD SURVIVORS AUTOBATTLER RTS: Earth
row.detailed_description: Full Game About the Game Milky Way is a mix of Tower Defense, RTS, Auto-Battler and Survivors genres. Visit planets in the Milky Way Galaxy and protect them against hordes of enemies. Milky Way: Earth is a demo version of the game, where 1 of 4 maps, 9 of 11 towers and 3 of 5 skills are available. BUILD YOUR BASE Develop your economy: gather stone with mines and gold with furnaces. Strengthen your defenses: use collected resources to build towers to fight off the enemies. Towers are divided into two types: some of them summon units, while others attack enemies. Some of the summoned units are perfect in order to distract enemies against themselves and protect other towers. Remember that the good placement of the towers is the key to victory. USE SKILLS Gather mana with pylons and spend it on powerfull skills. You can summon a giant meteor, shoot with orbital gun or unleash a starfall on your enemies. Use everything to win! SURVIVE! There're over 40 types of enemies in the game, some of them have dangerous abilities. Can you survive against all of them? FEATURES Dynamic and engaging gameplay A variety of gameplay styles 11 towers with their own abilities 4 maps with unique atmosphere Multitude of upgrades to choose from
row.short_description: Milky Way is a unique mix of Tower Defense, RTS, Auto-Battler and Survivors. Build your base, choose random upgrades and use powerful skills to survive against hordes of enemies.

row.name: Block Tower TD 2: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Full Version About the Game Block Tower TD 2: Prologue is just a part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. In the prologue, 2 maps, part of the towers and upgrades are available. Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique. Build the World! Unleash your potential in creating defensive strategies, playing in a world where every block is important for your defense. Create unique tactics by placing blocks in the right places. Build the Towers Tower placement is a key aspect in Tower Defense games. Especially in Block Tower: build them on elevations, leave space for resources, cleverly combine blocks. Each tower has an experience bar: the earlier it is built, the stronger it becomes at the end of the game. Skilful tower placement will make your defense stronger and more efficient. Choose Upgrades The sequence of upgrades plays a crucial role in progressing through each stage. Optimize your strategy based on resources, magical towers, or fortified defense. The random block generation, combined with tactical decisions, gives the game almost endless replayability. Harvest Resources Develop your economic strategy wisely. Early investment in economic buildings can be risky but will provide a significant advantage in the end. The random distribution of resources in each game creates new strategic challenges, requiring your creative approach and decision-making skill.
row.short_description: Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique.

row.name: Asterball
row.detailed_description: Asterball is an online third-person sports game where you play as a Sportsman on one of two teams in a game of gridiron, with a unique twist. Levels Asterball contains multiple different levels, each with their own unique gameplay elements. Battle it out in the classic Starfield, which takes you back to the basics. Or compete in the Warpgate, which challenges the players with limited platforms and portals. Items Each Sportsman can gain points during gameplay from various tasks, such as scoring touchdowns or tackling other players. These points ca be used to gain advantageous items to help. Items only last for the round, but can help gain an edge on the opponent in different ways. The Sportsman can purchase the electrifying Lightning Rod to gain a huge increase in speed, or can play on the offensive with the Pulse Bomb, causing targets to be knocked back.
row.short_description: Enter the galactic gridiron field as a Sportsman to beat your opponents in the fast-paced sport of Asterball. Play in a PVP setting where two teams battle it out in the field to see who can win with the most touchdowns.

row.name: Crowd Diver
row.detailed_description: Dive into Crowd Diver, an asymmetrical social detective stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised. FEATURES Seeker Bind-Rod The Bind Rod is a powerful weapon in Crowd Diver's armory. The Seeker use this weapon to capture monsters. Security Consoles There are four consoles placed across the city. Activate them to reduce the targets visibility to the monster. Be cautious, as they can counter-hack the consoles! Monster Kill Mechanic Three targets are added for each monster that enters the game. They were highlighted through the map. Kill them when you are in distance! Quick Change Change your appearance as quickly as possible when you think you've lost the Seeker with the Quick Change mechanic. Environment Interactive World Use doors and teleporter to move quickly to other parts of the map. Futuristic Map The map presents itself as a unique environment in the futuristic style of Solarpunk. With its innovative design and captivating atmosphere, it offers players a visually impressive setting for their adventures. ABOUT US This game was created as part of a student project during our third semester at the School for Games in Hamburg, developed over a period of 10 weeks!
row.short_description: Crowd Diver is an asymmetrical stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised.

row.name: Viking Frontiers: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the North A series of unfortunate events has brought you to an unknown shore, and it is your task to transform it into your new home and fortress. Can you unite the remnants of your clan? Can you withstand the challenges of nature? And most importantly, will you prove worthy of the honorable title of Jarl? The fate of your people rests on your shoulders… Viking Frontiers Features A deep, extensive survival system Immersive simulation features, including crafting, building, hunting, expeditions and many, many more Management of clansmen’s needs, laws, activities and living conditions Beautiful, realistic graphics that allow you to experience everything from a first-person perspective Numerous quests, random events, day and night system Addictive gameplay steeped in an authentic Viking vibe and awesome sound effects Your people need you Know that your newly formed settlement will face many challenges and difficulties. You, as its leader, must learn to recognize the most favorable opportunities and the greatest threats. It's entirely up to you, whether you choose to follow the path of the hunter, farmer, priest, builder, or any mixture of them all. Discover your own ways of survival and master a host of useful skills to tame this wild, dangerous land. Feel the thrill of survival Viking Frontiers combines the best elements of RPG, Survival, Simulation, and Strategy genres to provide you with an absolutely unique gaming experience. If you choose so, you can delve into the main story, explore the in-game world, or focus on side quests or your other favorite activities. Jump right into the misty tale straight from the Viking sagas and enjoy varied, highly replayable gameplay. Stay up to date Be sure to join our community to show off your settlement and exchange the tales about your deeds with other Viking Frontiers players. Become a member of the clan and join our Discord server, where we regularly host interesting events and engaging competitions. To always stay up to date, follow our Social Media channels. See you there, Jarl!
row.short_description: Survival of your people - that's the only thing that matters. Become the leader of a newly founded Viking settlement and lead it to safety and glory. Gather, build, craft, hunt, raid and follow your Gods to endure hardships of nature and save your clan from violent destruction.

row.name: Battle Room Beta
row.detailed_description: BATTLE ROOM BETA offers an immersive online multiplayer TPS shooter experience, completely free as a beta version. No daily maintenance, installation or complex configuration required: Just start the game! As simple as opening a door, incredibly easy to get into the action! Non-stop adrenaline-filled excitement awaits you in different battle rooms where 2 teams will face each other! Players will be able to enjoy high-quality graphics even on very low-end devices! KEY FEATURES Limited edition characters with unique abilities for the beta version, but with fairly balanced gameplay. 2 different levels that present familiar objects and interesting environments for exploration. Continuous weapon discoveries and utilization for strategic advantage. Cross-platform playability between PC and mobile devices, supporting multiple languages. FUTURE UPDATES In the near future, BATTLE ROOM will introduce: 2 additional game modes. Over 10 new levels and 20 additional characters for expanded gameplay. Character customization options for personalization. Features like ranking systems, achievements, and new items for enrichment. A diverse array of unique weapons to unlock and master. New abilities like climbing and dodging bullets.
row.short_description: Join the action-packed world of BATTLE ROOM BETA! Jump into the game right away, no preparation required! Explore different maps, team up with your friends and dominate the competition by making best use of the unique features of your chosen character!
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content and Some Nudity or Sexual Content.

Click the egg to obtain more eggs until your hearts content (One million Eggs). Features High-Resolution Models RTX Raytracing Detailed Textures Up to 1 Player! Egg

row.name: The Monarch: First Light
row.detailed_description: Full Release About the Game The Monarch is a Kingdom-like strategy game that has minimalistic control & smooth gameplay with power-up aspects. The gates of hell open each night, terrorizing the land. As the player, you must find a way to destroy the gates and defend your lands in the process! Gather coins, recruit peasants, train units, build powerful structures, gain power-ups, and adapt! Can you bring peace to the land? New Player Tips If you take a hit, you lose a coin. Hold a few extra coins in your pouch just to be safe! Build and upgrade your walls as soon as possible! Try to recruit at least 1 peasant every day! The forest is dangerous at night; watch out!
row.short_description: Will you be the savior to purify this land? The Monarch is a lane-defense game where you control a monarch, expand your kingdom, and defend against evil by strategically managing gold resources, recruiting diverse units, and exploring a world filled with mythical threats.

row.name: Real Life
row.detailed_description: 🧩 Welcome to the world of Real Life You wake up in a dark dungeon-labyrinth. Your goal is to find the key, defeat the boss, and move on to the next level — or return to the tavern with your loot and grow stronger. The deeper you go, the more dangerous your enemies become… but the greater the rewards. If you die, you lose everything. You'll respawn at the nearest tavern, penniless. Your journey is to uncover the truth about this place... and whether it even has a bottom. ⚠️ Remember: the most dangerous enemy in the dungeon is another **player**. 🎮 The game is being developed in two main stages: **Roguelike** and **MMORPG**. 1️⃣ **Roguelike** is based on procedurally generated dungeons. I'll be adding all core mechanics and dungeon modes. Once everything is in place and class/build balance (including PvP) is tuned, I’ll move on to MMORPG development. 2️⃣ **MMORPG** will be built on top of the Roguelike base, but progress will not carry over. Essentially, it will be two games in one client — the second featuring an open world, sieges, node systems, and city management. 🎭 Atmosphere & Inspiration Inspired by anime like **Sword Art Online** and other survival-in-dungeon stories. Also by LitRPG novels like **'Moonlight Sculptor'**, **'Dragon's Heart'**, and more. Game inspirations include **Ragnarok**, **Lineage 2**, **Aion**, **Diablo**, **The Witcher**, **The Elder Scrolls**, and **Elden Ring**. 🔮 The Vision I'm making this game **for myself** — my dream game. I’m disappointed with the modern game industry chasing trends and casualization. I want to create a true **hardcore old-school experience** — where you don't just play the game, you live in it. In this world, you’ll find friends, enemies, maybe even love. Join guilds, meet teammates in real life. You can go solo, or team up with a friend… but beware — **your friend might shoot you in the back and steal your loot**. You might run into another group deep in the dungeon. You could kill them and take everything. Or negotiate, pay a fee, or team up to defeat the boss… but what happens after is up to you. What matters is knowing **when to stop** — kill the boss, get back to the tavern, trade your loot, and grow stronger. Now you and your friends, fully geared, are ready to go even deeper. Here, death means **losing everything** — and maybe even your friends. 🩺 I’m a healer In every game, I’ve always played support. (Yes, I’m a good healer 😉) I also love crafting. These elements will get special attention. Healers are team players. I’ll be aiming for a balance where **a disorganized team of strong players will lose to an average team with good synergy**. There will be a place for solo players too — but it will require **serious skill**. Teamplay will be a core focus — but choose your teammates wisely: **friendly fire is enabled**. Difficulty-wise, the game will feel like a **Souls-like**. 💰 Will there be Pay2Win? Everyone defines Pay2Win differently. Personally? **I hate it**. Since I’m making this for myself, here’s the current monetization plan (subject to change): - 🎮 The game will be **free-to-play**, if I can successfully combat cheating and botting. - 💳 There will be a **subscription**, purchasable for real money or in-game currency ('Core'). Subscription may include: - x2 “Core” drop — local monster loot currency (1 per kill) - +10–20% carry weight - Extra storage or personal tavern room - Cosmetic items - Increased item drop chance 🎁 Most importantly: the subscription will be **tradable for in-game currency (Core)**. So a player can buy it for $5 and sell it to another player for Core — **players will set the price**. ❌ What **won’t** be in the shop: - Items generated out of thin air (no stat gear, no Core currency, no consumables). 📊 Development Budget - 💸 Budget as of 13.02.2024: **~$3,300** - Target cost for Roguelike version: **$5,000**, max **$10,000** - Server cost: stable 5k–10k online = at least **$35,000** - More players = more server cost 📆 Development started: **June 2023** 🎯 Planned release of Roguelike version: **June 2025** 🧑‍💻 I'm a full-time **sysadmin**, working on the game in my free time. If community support reaches **$1,000/month**, I’ll quit and go full-time on the game. 💬 Join the Discord server! Report bugs, give feedback, and help shape the game ❤️
row.short_description: Survive the dungeon and return to the tavern with your loot to venture further — or die alone and lose it all.
row.notes: The game is being developed according to the norms of Islamic Sharia, and the developer is in no way going to violate Sharia law. There are no sex scenes, naked women and men in the game. But there is violence, both psychological in the Prologue game mode and physical. Also in Prologue mode, there are scenes with the use of tobacco and alcohol. row.name: Unlock the Three
row.detailed_description: Unlock the Three: A Horror Escape Game This game can be played in single-player mode or with 2 to 5 players online. Story: Unlock the Three tells the story of four characters trapped in a hospital overrun by a mysterious monster. These characters are: The Police Officer: Strong and brave, they can lead the way in difficult situations. The Medic: With medical knowledge and skills, she can treat the wounded. The Security Guard: He knows the hospital's passages and security systems. The Father: A devout man of faith, he can use his faith to protect the others and ward off the monster. Gameplay: The game is played with a team of four players, each controlling one character. One additional player takes control of the monster. Monster: The monster must use its cunning to hunt its prey and hinder the survivors. Survivors: The survivors must progress through the hospital by finding keys and escaping the monster. Each character has their own unique set of skills that they must use together to survive. Character Abilities: The Police: They can use their pistol flashlight to see around and protect themselves and others from monsters. The Medic: She can heal the wounded and revive the fallen. The Priest: He can use his faith to protect the other survivors from the monster. He can hold up a cross to repel the monster and give the others a chance to escape. He can also bless the other survivors to clear their minds. The Security Guard: He can watch the building from cameras and guide the others. Features: A tense and atmospheric experience Five unique playable characters (including the Monster) Team-based gameplay Unlock the Three is an exciting game that combines horror, mystery, and teamwork. Can you work together with your friends to escape the monster and survive the hospital? About the Developer: Unlock the Three is created by a solo indie developer, dedicated to crafting unique and immersive gaming experiences. As a solo developer, I have put a lot of effort into this game, but there might be some issues or bugs. I apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and support.
row.short_description: Unlock the Three is about a Police,Medic,Security Worker and a Father trying to escape from a Monster in locked hospital. Each survivor has its own unique skills to perform and survivors must be collaborate with each other to be able to escape.
row.notes: This game is intended for mature audiences and may not be suitable for all players. It contains the following mature content: Intense Horror: The game features a dark and terrifying atmosphere, with themes of violence and danger. Players may encounter disturbing imagery and unsettling situations. Moderate Violence: Characters engage in combat with a monstrous entity, and the game depicts physical violence. Possible Blood: Blood is present in this game.

row.name: Enter The Lost Chamber
row.detailed_description: Delve into the unforgiving darkness of ' Enter The Lost Chamber ', a pixel art roguelike that challenges you to explore deadly dungeons infested with supernatural monsters. Armed with an arsenal of varied weapons, face hordes of zombies, bats, and other abominations in a never-ending fight for survival. Each descent into the depths offers new surprises and unique challenges, while the possibility of facing the final boss at any time adds constant tension. Delve into the darkness, collect mysterious artifacts, and become the master of shadows in “ Enter The Lost Chamber ”. Throw yourself into a cycle consisting of a series of three dungeons . Each cycle completed presents a unique challenge and formidable enemies to face. Each cycle completed is more difficult than the previous one thanks to new enemies, new behaviors, and increased difficulty. At the end of each dungeon, an epic boss awaits, ready to test your skills and strategy. Defeat is not an option, as failing erases the player's progress. Find, mix and upgrade over 25 items . Change weapons radically changing your experience by discovering hidden rooms. Explore the dungeons and discover them all! Reroll the wheel of luck in exchange for a few crystals to hope to find the item you need! Face more than 10 different monsters some of which have visual and behavioral changes as you progress through the cycles. 3 memorable and unique bosses challenging your skills, your reflexes and your strategy you can't wait to face and stop your progress. Deathkeeper , the powerful final boss of Enter The Lost Chamber , is accessible from the start of the game. Go without equipment if you dare or perform cycles to gain power before this epic encounter.
row.short_description: Explore dungeons, battle hordes of monsters, and defy fate in “Enter The Lost Chamber,” an action-packed pixel art roguelike. Discover new challenges, collect powerful weapons, and prepare to face the final boss at any time. Dive into the darkness!

row.name: Dungeon Full Dive: Player Edition
row.detailed_description: Game Master? Upgrade to Game Master Edition! Unlock session hosting, advanced GM tools, and exclusive content. JOIN OUR DISCORD Join our Discord community to keep updated with the latest Dungeon Full Dive news and meet other adventurers! About the Game Start Your Epic Tabletop Adventure 'DFD: Player Edition' is the most immersive way to play any tabletop RPG FOR FREE. Features of the 'Dungeon Full Dive: Player Edition': Play TTRPG Online: Dive into TTRPG sessions as a player. Play together with your friends or with new people you meet online. Character Editor: Bring your hero to life with our character editor. Create up to 3 unique characters to embark on your adventures. Map Builder: Unleash your creativity with our map editor. Design up to 2 unique TTRPG maps to explore. Plus, gain access to all DFD maps. Explore the GM Tools: Get a taste of ALL of DFD's GM tools, including soundboards and dynamic weather systems, designed to enhance storytelling. Available in offline mode. Jump into an adventure with your friends or build an entirely new party with random travelers, whether it’s using a mouse and keyboard or in VR. And, of course, cross-play is supported between PC Players and VR Players! Play any tabletop RPG that you want. Create and modify your character sheets and notes in-game. Furthermore, DFD includes game mechanics and stat integration for 5e. That means that things like initiative tracking can easily be done with just a click of a button! Place your characters or even monsters, then switch into their view to experience the adventures from their eyes. For the first time ever, interact with the tabletop adventures of your dreams: Drink in the tavern, play some instruments in the city market, or explore the dark forests. You can adapt, choose, or even create your own battle maps. DFD offers a variety of lovingly handcrafted 3D maps for you to use for your adventures or to modify with our map editor, where you can also create your maps from scratch! Choose your battles, whether it’s in the icy depths of the mountains or in an underground cave. Build an army of miniatures using DFD’s powerful character editor! Create your heroes and use our powerful customization system to make all of them unique: Be whoever -or whatever- you want to be. Join our Discord community to keep updated with the latest Dungeon Full Dive news and meet other adventurers!
row.short_description: Embark on your TTRPG adventures for free with DFD: Player Edition, where your fantasies come to life. Create up to three heroes, design your own maps, and dive into a world of adventure. The Player Edition is your gateway to an ever-expanding universe of TTRPGs.

row.name: TESD: Into the Vortex
row.detailed_description: TESD: Into The Vortex is an old school 2D pixel art style RPG game where players control a party consisting of Bryan Johnson, Walt Flanagan, and Brian Quinn. Players will fight enemies, complete quests, upgrade gear, and solve riddles. This game was developed as a solo project and total playtime should run a couple hours max.
row.short_description: After performing a mock-ritual during the 2017 Halloween podcast, Baron Von Flanagan unknowingly unleashed a power long since sealed and thrust all of TESD Town into another dimension. Take control of Bry, Walt, and Q as they venture into the vortex in an attempt to save all of TESD Town!

row.name: Winnie-The-Pooh Taste Test
row.detailed_description: Explore! Run, jump, and fight through a world inspired by the classic Winnie-The-Pooh picture books. Meet new characters and creatures as you overcome platforming and combat challenges. Collect all the honey you can find to unlock new areas and mini games. Game Features Classic platforming. Combat with four directional attacks. Dashing and wall jumping. Combat areas. Eeyore. This game is a short experience showing off the mechanics and feel of a Winnie-The-Pooh platformer.
row.short_description: Platform through a Winnie-The-Pooh picture book. Use your reaction skills and abilities to fight creatures, explore new areas, and collect honey!

row.name: Helenenkapelle VR
row.detailed_description: Um die Helenenkapelle bei Bamberg ranken sich viele Volkssagen. Sie liegt idyllisch im Wald auf einem Bergrücken zwischen Kemmern und Baunach. Inzwischen ist sie nur noch eine Ruine und wird ab und zu von Wanderern besucht. Doch das war nicht immer so. Einst war sie ein beliebter Wallfahrtsort und der Wald ein Weinberg. Erlebe eine historische Reise zurück zur Blühtezeit der Kapelle und erfahre mehr über das Leben dieser Zeit. Über mehrere Stationen wird der Spieler durch die Zeit geschickt, um mehr über die Kapelle zu erfahren. Dabei muss er verschiedene Aufgaben lösen. In kleinen, offenen Welten können dabei Fakten als auch Sagen gefunden werden, bei denen es um die Kapelle geht. Erfahre diese Geschichtsstunde in VR und Locomotion in einer 3D gescannten Umgebung mit interaktiven Objekten.
row.short_description: Eine historische Reise durch die Zeit, von der Blühtezeit der Kapelle bis zum Ende als Ruine.

row.name: Victim Complex: Part 1
row.detailed_description: Victim Complex: Part 1 is an early Demo for the upcoming full game release, scheduled for Q4 2025. Search Steam for Victim Complex to add the Full Game to your wishlist, see more demos, and get updates on progress! Victim Complex is a first person, narrative-driven horror experience. Play as hack medium Jack Lognare, who has stumbled on his first legitimate haunting. Will you try to help the spirits trapped in the haunted apartment complex, or will you rush to save yourself before whatever killed them gets you too? Use Iconic Equipment Use iconic ghost-hunting equipment to find and communicate with the lingering spirits in an abandoned apartment complex. Uncover the Mystery Follow the spirits' clues to discover what happened to the deceased tenants. Stay Alive Whatever killed the tenants is still here... can you avoid it and escape with your life? The Story Hack medium Jack Lognare has a specialty: 'cleansing' haunted locations so that they can be fixed up and sold without the stigma they once had in their communities. When he is hired to exorcise the spirits in an apartment complex in rural Wisconsin, he expects to find the same thing he usually does: nothing. But when he arrives, he discovers that this time, the rumors may actually be true, and he has found his first legitimate haunting. Initially thrilled to use his phony 'ghost hunting equipment' for real, he soon learns that the malicious Entity that supposedly killed all the residents may be real as well... and it doesn't plan on letting him leave so easily. Each chapter will have multiple endings; will Jack help the trapped spirits along the way and get the true answers, or focus on getting out as quickly as possible before he shares their fate? You decide how Jack will fare, in Victim Complex.
row.short_description: Use your wits and iconic ghost hunting equipment to uncover the mystery of what happened to the residents of an abandoned apartment complex in this narrative-driven horror experience.
row.notes: This game contains strong language, references and audio-only conversations about drug use, (non-sexual) domestic violence, and death. It has an eerie atmosphere and threatening entities that pursue and attack the player.

row.name: Destiny Online
row.detailed_description: Destiny Online is a 2D Fantasy MMORPG developed by Destiny10.com and offers free-to-play access. The game's most interesting feature is its in depth pet system. Players can capture practically any enemy in the game and customize their growth as they level up. The experience rate in game is fast paced, so players should be able to complete all of the newbie quests and have themselves nicely equipped within an hour or so after creating their character. FEATURES 1. Pet System: Capture monsters, make them pets, and have them aid you in combat. 2. Character Dressing up System: Freely DIY your favorite style with hairstyles, headwear, clothes, back accessories, and tails. 3. Marriage System: Experience romance and adventure with your loved ones. 4. Master / Apprentice System: Ally your character with a Master while leveling for added benefits. 5. Weapon Crafting: Craft supreme weapons with your name on them, and add gems to refine them with added bonuses. The game's five playable classes are: Warrior – Their key attributes are Strength and Vitality. They are the primary melee oriented character in Destiny Online and are capable of dealing large amounts of physical damage. They enjoy the highest HP in the game and high physical attack power. Swordman – Their key attributes are Strength and Stamina. They are capable of dealing of dealing long-range physical attacks. They use long swords and other weapons which have a long reach. They are very similar to Warriors. Mage – Their key attribute is Intelligence. They are the primary offensive spell casting class in Destiny Online. They have low HP but can devastating amounts of damage with their spells. Taoist – Their key attributes are Intelligence and Spirit. They play a lot like mages, except their spells curse their opponents rather than lots of damage. They rely more on their pets than other classes. Priest – Their key attribute is spirit. They are a supportive class capabable of both buffing their team mates as well as healing them.
row.short_description: Destiny Online is a 2D Fantasy MMORPG and offers free-to-play access. Pet System: Capture monsters, make them pets, and have them aid you in combat. Character Dressing up System: Freely DIY your favorite style with hairstyles, headwear, clothes, back accessories, and tails.

I am the only game developer, and the theme song is composed by a friend. All the materials used in the game are original materials (without AI or materials borrowed from others), so I spent a long time learning and producing these materials. The first time I wrote a novel, the first time I learned composition and arrangement, the first time I learned Blender to create backgrounds, etc. Since this is my first game, I decided to release it to everyone for free.Although the game still has many shortcomings, I will continue to study hard and create the next good game!
row.short_description: 《The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis-》is a short text adventure game. This game combines a visual novel and an 'adventure mode'.

row.name: Foobar Zero
row.detailed_description: Fast paced action, with dynamic movement such as walljumps and dodges 6v6 team based PvP, or 12 player free for all Customizable loadout, with 3 weapons 3 skill slots Multiple gamemodes Anime aesthetic Customizable outfits for your character Futuristic virtual world Foobar Zero is set in a world where the virtual reality has reached such a level, where it is possible to fully immerse and control your game avatar. In this game, you are controlling such an avatar, and combatting other players in a simulation. The area of the combat is replicated from old records, currently available locations, and even fictional locations, like an alien ship! Check out the in-game shop where you can purchase various outfits for your character! You can mix them together however you want, and choose the color you like, to express your own style. These are pure cosmetics and doesn't affect the gameplay to keep it balanced. You won't last long if you stand still. Use the covers, dodge the attacks, and walljump your way to victory! Practice your skills on the different maps, to learn all the jumps and tricks you can do. Nobody will be able to stop you! With the various melee weapons in game, you can find your favourite. Do you prefer faster attacks? Power Katana is the perfect one for you! Are you more tactical, you want to wait around the corner, or predict your enemy's movement? Rocket Fists will deliver powerful attacks but each one has to be charged up. Try them all out, and you will find what is best for you! Each loadout have 3 skills. One passive, one active, and one ultimate. Ultimates need to be charged up, but when it's usable, they have high impact. Use Bubble Shield to protect your party from any damage, or Tornado, to demolish anyone close to the impact! Return to the roots of multiplayer gaming! Create your own room, select game mode, map, and other settings, and start your own game! Play multiple rounds with the same people if you want, or choose a different, the choice is in your hands!
row.short_description: Foobar Zero is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter game, with anime characters. Customize your characters with various outfits, create your own loadout with futuristic guns and swords, and dominate your enemies with superior movement!

row.name: Molementum
row.detailed_description: Get ready for a Heist Party! Molementum is a 3D party action game where you assume the role of a mole criminal to rob mines of their precious gems. Grab up to 3 friends and scramble your way through industrial mines engaging in various acts of competitive mischief as you try to become the most notorious mole criminal. Upgrade yourself between rounds with different abilities that will extend your nefarious arsenal to complete constantly changing objectives. Battle your friends! Compete with up to three other players online in the ultimate heist party. Outsmart and outmaneuver your friends in order to collect the most gems! Gain molementum! Move around by swapping between digging and rolling - dig for fast reactive movement that can allow you to burrow up underneath your fellow moles to attack, or use the momentum of a roll to gain even more speed and become an unstoppable fireball that grows in reach with your speed. Upgrade your mole! Unlock a bevy of unique and wacky upgrades between rounds of play. Take to the skies, stun other players, and summon otherworldly buddies to your command. Changing challenges! Players will face different objectives round to round that tie into an evolving story. Collect the most soda, fight to stay on camera, and fight each other!
row.short_description: Molementum is a 3D party action game where you assume the role of a mole criminal to rob mines of their precious gems. Grab up to 3 friends and scramble your way through mines while engaging in various acts of competitive mischief as you try to become the most notorious mole criminal.

row.name: Pair A Dice
row.detailed_description: Roll The Dice to summon items, enemies, and bosses! Then, use what you roll to craft tools and survive the island's unpredictable challenges! Collect special gems from enemies that when combined start intense Boss Fights that will leave you and your robot friends appalled! Enjoy this crazy luck-filled adventure with up to 4 people, Free of charge! Awesome Features: Dice Rolling Bosses Crafting PVE / CO-OP Unique Upgrades Voice Chat
row.short_description: Pair A Dice is a Co-Op Dice Roller where you harness the power of magic dice to create enemies, craft items, and defeat bosses!

row.name: 勇者斗斗龙Online
row.detailed_description: 《勇者斗斗龙Online》是一款Q版仿3D回合战斗类MMORPG，游戏以3D引擎制作2D画面，画面表现更为细腻，战斗感更为逼真，爽快。游戏中的众多特色新颖有趣，如宠物孵化养成、魔法炼金术、召唤兽特技、幻宠军团、强力套装、屠龙之战等等，呈现一个宏伟、庞大、剑与魔法的西方魔幻世界。 　　这是一个诸神大战后的世界，大地女神盖亚诞下大地之神泰坦之后，创造新世界的故事…… 　　数千年前，大地之神泰坦在与黑暗女神克诺罗尼的激烈斗争中取得了胜利，并把黑暗女神永远的封印在沉睡之中。接下来，泰坦创造了亚提斯大陆，用大地无穷无尽的“孕育”力量创造了人类与其他众生灵，而人类为亚提斯世界的繁荣与和平建立了良好的秩序，泰坦对此十分满意，于是打算离开亚提斯世界。 　　在泰坦离开这片大陆之前，他决定把自己部分的力量赋予这片大陆上最强的物种，以守卫亚提斯世界的平衡与和谐。 　　在那个诸神时代，有许多巨龙，他们掌握着不同程度的强大魔法，泰坦决定从中挑选5条力量强大的巨龙来守护亚提斯世界，并赋予它们天资突破，以获得对元素魔法水平近乎“神祗”的操控力量。 　　梦境之龙被泰坦选中，并得到泰坦的部分力量，梦境之龙的最主要职责，是守卫被封印的黑暗使者克诺罗尼，让她永远沉睡。 　　泰坦把自己的力量赋予给这5条巨龙后就永远地离开了，至高神的离去让封印力量大减，沉睡了几千年的克诺罗尼察觉到，这是她突破封印再次用黑暗统治世界的好机会。 　　战争在宁静中展开了，克诺罗尼把埋藏了几千年的力量瞬间爆发，用黑暗的力量控制了梦境之龙，使其变为自己的奴仆。接着，克诺罗尼利用梦境之龙的特殊魔法，通过梦境把自己黑暗的意志传了给其它4条守护世界的巨龙，这样一来，克诺罗尼在短时间内就完全控制了守护世界的5条巨龙。克诺罗尼的野心不止如此，她号召红龙，蓝龙，绿龙分别占领了辛达尔，艾斯兰登，布莱斯特，并建立起召唤恶魔龙类的祭坛，于是，大量的恶魔龙类通过祭坛进入亚提斯世界，并开始疯狂的杀戮与破坏。 　　人类不断抗战，但是克诺罗尼让黑龙在世界的中心——愚者之原对人类进行大规模的压制与屠戮，以便保护三个黑暗祭坛，也让人类首尝最惊心的失败。于此同时，克诺罗尼更携同5条巨龙以及其他恶魔龙类，对整个亚提斯世界进行更疯狂的报复，致使元素力量溃散、自然之力不断减弱，整个亚提斯世界濒临毁灭。 　　为了躲避战争，为了用更强大的力量把克诺罗尼打倒，人类退居到云中之城，不断抗击着来袭恶龙。他们深信，既然是泰坦创造了世界，人类必然有义务去守护这片大地。他们打响旗号，在全世界各大城市商会中广招屠龙勇士，准备展开一场源自人类愤怒的逆袭。 　　于是，一场激烈的斗龙战争打响了……
row.short_description: 《勇者斗斗龙Online》是一款Q版仿3D回合战斗类MMORPG，游戏以3D引擎制作2D画面，画面表现更为细腻，战斗感更为逼真，爽快。游戏中的众多特色新颖有趣，如宠物孵化养成、魔法炼金术、召唤兽特技、幻宠军团、强力套装、屠龙之战等等，呈现一个宏伟、庞大、剑与魔法的西方魔幻世界。

row.name: Mid-Death Crisis
row.detailed_description: Mid Death Crisis: A strategic, turn-based couch co-op game for three players. Command skeletal minions aiding Zeborius Zelgon, a lich battling the amphibious Rana Empire. Redirect Zeb's waning magic to empower allies, conquer foes, and reignite his evil fervor amidst a cryptic adventure. Strategic Collaboration Mid Death Crisis is a strategic, turn-based couch co-op game designed for three players. Play with two friends to strategically redirect, and empower the lackluster spells sent out by Zeb. Each of the three players commands a skeleton with a unique set of skills, adept at their own tasks. Just one can’t take on an army, but with many your might can grow to even surpass that of the Lich himself! Unique Roles Each of the three skeletons, the Zealot, Thief, and Warrior, have learned abilities from Zeb. The zealot is a master of damage, amplifying spells to the fullest of their potential with deranged genius. The thief is all about positioning, a magic-juggling aficionado who never misses their target. The warrior is a master crowd controller. Choose your favorite and work directly with your teammates and discover which loadouts mesh well with others to perfectly defeat the waves of enemies that come your way! A Lich Who Lost His Way Embarking on this adventure, players take command of skeletal minions serving Zeborius Zelgon, a once-powerful lich now plagued by sorrow. Zeb's crypt has fallen under the invasion of The Rana Empire, a formidable species of frogs intent on claiming his domain. As Zeb's sorrow saps his magical abilities, players, serving as his most loyal minions, must harness, empower, and strategically redirect his spells to their comrades, enhancing their collective strength. By overcoming hordes of frog enemies, escorting Zeb through his crypt, and rekindling his malevolent passion for evil, players confront the trials of the Mid Death Crisis.
row.short_description: Mid Death Crisis is a strategic, turn-based couch co-op game designed for three players. Harness, empower, and strategically redirect spells to your comrades, enhancing your collective strength!
