row.name: 1000 Cuts: Jomaku
row.detailed_description: ⛩️ WISHLIST AND FOLLOW THE FULL GAME ⛩️ 🏯 FOLLOW ON KICKSTARTER 🏯 About the Game Jomaku (除幕) 'Curtain-raiser' a short act or monologue to introduce a longer kabuki play. A preview. 1000 Cuts: Jomaku is a 60-90 minute proof of concept experience of One-Thousand Cuts, with a short tutorial, plenty of exploration (over a dozen hidden pettable cats, an optional boss, bonus lore drops, three alternative video modes), unlockable upgrades, a three-phase final boss , and multiple endings based on which moral route you choose. Combine instant-death combat with unique special abilities and environmental hazards to devastate your enemies, or die trying. Strategize efficient solutions or overwhelm with brute force as your slice your way through the Army of One-Thousand , one cut at a time. Discover and fight a deadly collection of challenging bosses on your journey. Master each of their martial art styles to unleash powerful combat techniques on your enemies. If you can defeat them, that is. Find hidden lore throughout a rich, dark fantasy Edo Japan. connect the shattered pieces of this expansive world, inspired by real Japanese history and folklore. The time of the samurai is coming to an uncertain end. Exiled as a child by his father Hidetsugu , young Hiroyuki has grown up training at his Uncle Jiro's secluded dojo, hoping one day to prove himself worthy enough to return home. Now caught at the center of a hostile takeover within his clan, Hiro is torn between loyalty and honor. Hiro has to choose: side with his father and kill his friends and Uncle Jiro - the only real family he's ever had - or side with Uncle Jiro and attempt to face down the fearsome army under his father's control. It only takes one cut to kill, but what is one man against the Army of One-Thousand?
row.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer with brutal one-hit-kill combat, consequential choices, and a lore-rich story set in the dark fantasy world of Kurogawa, Japan. Inspired by Sekiro and Blasphemous, Jomaku is a free preview of One-Thousand Cuts, 'raising the curtain' for the full game coming soon!
row.notes: A nonstop phantasmagoria of dark fantasy violence, gore, and high-pressure arterial blood spray piping hot from the classic chanbara films that inspired it. Brief and infrequent references to tobacco and alcohol consumption.

row.name: ARC TCG
row.detailed_description: ARC TCG is a strategic 3D card game set in a fantasy universe full of magic and challenges. Choose your hero, build unique decks with over 350 cards, and engage in intense battles with an automatic combat system that challenges your strategy and planning, in single-player and multiplayer modes. With more than 15 heroes to choose from, every game is different. Every decision makes a difference, every move can change the course of the battle. The semi-automatic component means that the player can focus exclusively on when and how they can play one or more cards. Creatures on the battlefield will attack automatically, however, the many abilities the game offers can turn the fate of combat around. The order of attack always starts from left to right. Creatures that fight take damage equal to their attack value, and fighting happens most of the time when two creatures are facing each other (except for dedicated abilities that alter this behavior). Combat is therefore very simple, immediate, but at the same time it offers a very high strategic depth, as the position of the cards on the battlefield determines the order of attack, which can be altered, however, thanks to the presence of some card abilities. Each creature has a default set of abilities up to a maximum of 4 per creature. Each ability is unique and always offers new strategies, and combining certain abilities also makes it possible to create powerful combos. The game offers more than 50 abilities. Some of them are present only in specific factions because they are strongly contextualized, while others are shared in most creatures because they are more generic. Each ability activates according to certain conditions: summoning, destruction, end/ start of turn, etc., thus increasing the strategic depth of the game Each Hero has a specific ability, activated only 1 time per turn and under certain conditions. Take advantage of their characteristics with the available cards to increase your chances of victory. There are more than 15 heroes in the game, offering more than 15 different and unique play styles! Trigger conditions make their abilities play out in a reasoned manner further increasing the strategic depth of the game Play with 3 different factions: Humans Nature Dimensional Each faction brings with it a unique abilities set, heroes, and cards, offering new game strategies Singleplayer: Relaxed : play without worrying about scores or leaderboards. Test to your decks and try pre-built ones. Standard : play with your decks by challenging different levels of AI, gain experience and rewards Draft : play by choosing a random pair of cards from the two proposed until you build your deck Ranked : play against AI, win games, climb the rankings and earn rewards at the end of the season Infinity Tower : play against the AI in a series of matches where your hero's health persists between matches. Can you conquer all the floors of the Tower? Dark Maze : Play against the AI with one of the three decks available and choose the right paths through the maze. Pass through the rooms, defeat the bosses of the various realms, and reach the end of the maze. Can you become the Lord of the Dark Maze? Multiplayer: Private : play vs another player in a private match, test your decks or play with pre-built ones Standard : play vs another player in public match, win rewards based on opponent 'strenght' League : play against another player and climb the leaderboard, advance in rank and get new rewards In addition, the game in its current state offers: 3 playable Factions +350 unique cards +50 unique abilities +15 Heroes 9 pre-built decks Deck Editor : Create/Edit your decks and share them with the community! Progression System Online Services Ranked matches Singleplayer Seasons Sound Effects High Quality graphics Multiplayer
row.short_description: ARC TCG is a strategic 3D card game set in a fantasy universe with over 350 cards and 15 heroes. Build your deck and engage in battles with an automatic combat system, where every choice and every move determines victory. Get ready to forge your legend

row.name: Meteor Havok
row.detailed_description: Jump into the asteroid fields to make space safe from random collisions. Overview: Fly your ship through fields of asteroids, and others objects, as you fire your laser blaster, change directions, even fly in reverse to avoid incoming objects. There are currently 6 random levels to play thru with random cycling between levels. Levels get progressively more difficult as you complete each level. As you play you can earn extra lives. Controls: Control your ship through simple keyboard controls or Gamepad in game. Autofire option added in version 1.4.1.
row.short_description: Meteor Havok is a take on the classic Asteroids arcade shooter. Enter the asteroid fields to blast a path to safety with your agile ship and powerful lasers.

row.name: [Test Subject Name]
row.detailed_description: [Test Subject Name] is an FPS Platformer that sees you descend through layers of test chambers, fighting multitudes of robots along the way, and coming in contact with intelligent machines that want you dead. Use your robotic implants and marksmanship to combat the hordes of hostile machines, and try to figure out if the voices you keep hearing through the speakers are friends or foes, or both. Keep swapping and dropping guns as they start to overheat, and decide whether to use a laser-powered sniper rifle or a radon-fueled minigun, or simply return to your trusty revolver.
row.short_description: [Test Subject Name] is an FPS Platformer that sees you descend through layers of test chambers, fighting multitudes of robots along the way, using weapons taken from enemies, and coming in contact with intelligent machines that want you dead.

row.name: ReCoil
row.detailed_description: ReCoil is a 2D Top-Down Shooter with a unique twist to it's genre. Your armour is too heavy for you to manage, but you need it to survive. You will have to use the recoil of your weaponry to navigate each level. Gameplay: Recoil: The recoil acts as a double edge sword. It allows the player to have complete control in movement. However, when using your arsenal, it may become challenging to balance the need of ammunition for facing enemies, and escaping dangerous situations. When firing your weapon, your player character will be thrown directly behind him with a great amount of speed and acceleration. But this will use your depleting supply of ammunition, which will be needed to survive. There are also 3 different weapons in ReCoil, each with there own gimmicks and variations of knockback. This allows for even more freedom whilst playing. Levels: There will be 12 uniquely designed levels in ReCoil to play. Each level has a timer at the bottom of the screen counting down until the clock reaches 0, allowing progression to the next level. Some levels are not only harder to beat, but also require a larger period of time that the player needs to survive in before accessing the next level. ReCoil is a short, free game created by Sisyphus.
row.short_description: ReCoil is a 2D Top-Down Shooter with a unique twist to it's genre. The recoil of your weapons launches you back.

row.name: Arcane Archer
row.detailed_description: Arcane Archer's gameplay revolves around shooting and detonating explosive arrows to make your way through the game's 12 stages as fast as you can! Take on increasingly difficult levels, and then test your skill against the online leaderboard! Experiment with different strategies and routes to give yourself an edge! The game also features a build-in speedrun timer and level select to help you practice certain levels and become the best archer you can be!
row.short_description: Arcane Archer is a 3D platforming FPS speedrun game where you must use explosive arrows to blast yourself across gaps and up walls to reach the goal! Use the power of your explosive arrows to parkour your way through an assortment of stages, and shoot for the top of the leaderboard!

row.name: Chrono Recorder
row.detailed_description: The player is trapped in an unknown space. In the player's hands is a clock that controls time and a camera that controls the state of objects. Clocks can stop or slow down time. The camera can turn back time or change the gravity of an object. The player must use these two objects to clear the stage. This game was created by 4 developers. There are not many stages in the game, so please enjoy it lightly. (Maps may be added in the future. Good responses encourage developers.)
row.short_description: 'ChronoRecorder' is a 3D puzzle game. Players can manipulate time and gravity. And you have to use that ability to solve problems. You might think this game is difficult if you don't use your brain.

row.name: The Dust of the Violet Crystals
row.detailed_description: The Story: After a flesh-eating dust blows through your small town you are left trying to survive alone against hordes of Listless humans. Starved for social interaction you find yourself questioning your sanity when a voice speaks directly into your mind begging for your help. Game Features: Navigate an apocalyptic world full of Listless humans while managing your health and toxin levels. Collect items and choose travel locations that you feel will most aid in your survival. Can you choose correctly and survive until you solve the mystery of the anonymous voice? Or will you fail and drag others down with you when you die? Multiple endings, and almost every choice will have some impact, sometimes immediately. Good luck! Excerpt: NARRATOR Huddling in the corner of our modest shop I can see them. I can see them through the glass, weaving to and fro as if only held upright by the merest of threads invisibly dangling from the hazy sky. The light that had previously consumed their retinas has faded to a dull glow. For hours I have hovered inside my shop. Waiting. Watching. My wife and I had chosen the reflective lettering on the glass of our shop in an attempt to catch the eyes of passerby to peruse our wares. I do not understand why, but it seems to confuse them. Almost immediately on turning to the glass the light in their eyes will fade, and they will either stand idly, waiting, or join the ranks of the others. A sudden scream shatters my thoughts and I slowly stand and walk toward the glass pane. A lone woman runs screaming through the street. YOU (horrified) No…No! NARRATOR As soon as I speak one of the Listless turns toward the window and I press myself against the wall in terror. It weaves to and fro in indecisive consternation, its ears aware of sound but the mirrored letters confusing its vision. After a few moments it turns back towards the woman. By the time I work up enough nerve to return to the glass and try to help, it is too late. But the Listless aren’t even the worst part. The dust. The dust is always worse.
row.short_description: A flesh-eating dust leaves you to survive alone against hordes of Listless.

row.name: Mausoleum of Memories
row.detailed_description: Travel through an ancient puzzle-filled pyramid as the ghost of Aaru, a man who has been denied entry into the Egyptian afterlife for being neither good nor bad. The gods of the afterlife, Anubis and Osiris, have charged you with the task of reflecting on the life you led when you were alive to balance your soul on the Scales of Justice and gain entrance into the Field of Reeds, a place of eternal rest. You must investigate your tomb while thinking about your human life and the choices you made when you were alive in the hope that this act of reflection will lead to eternal peace. As a ghost, you cannot physically touch objects and thus must possess specific items, such as boxes and statues, to move them around and solve the puzzles. The fate of your soul hangs in the balance. Will you be able to earn your way into the afterlife? Explore an Egyptian pyramid filled with ancient statues and walls decorated with hieroglyphs. Solve puzzles based on various stages of your life and discover artifacts that may have meant something to you when you were alive. Play as a ghost and possess things like rotating statues and boxes and manipulate them to solve puzzles in an immersive environment. Enjoy a touching and reflective story with fully-voiced dialogue and multiple characters. Investigate your human life and ponder how the choices you made may have impacted the lives of others. Balance your soul on the Scales of Justice and earn entrance into the Field of Reeds where eternal peace and a restful afterlife await you.
row.short_description: Mausoleum of Memories is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure game based on Egyptian Mythology. You play as the ghost of a man named Aaru who has been denied entrance to the afterlife and now must reflect on his human existence and any lessons he may have learned so he can finally rest in peace.

row.name: Operation Marakudja
row.detailed_description: Follow me ! About the Game Operation Marakudja is a fast-paced FPS where you can play both in single player mode and with other players online. Choose your character and go on a heated battle for the incredibly delicious fruits of Marakudja! Each of the characters is armed with their own unique weapons. Hone your play style, find useful items and collect as many fruits as possible. Explore a variety of environments, from deserts to lush jungles and futuristic landscapes. Raid of Marakudja: Collect and steal Marakuji fruits from other players in this competitive mode where every loot counts. Destroy your opponents in exciting battles and try not to lose your loot to gain the upper hand over the other players. Marakudja Giant: Stand up to protect the Giant Marakudja and earn Marakudja every 5 seconds for as long as you hold it. Be vigilant, though, as your opponents will try to shoot you down to take control of the precious Giant Marakudja above your head. Balloons and Marakudja: This mode is all about survival. Protect your three balloons, which represent your lives, while collecting and stealing Marakudja from other players. If you lose your three balloons, you won't be able to reappear, so play smart to stay in the game. Unlock a multitude of costumes as you progress with your character, gaining levels and unlocking new appearances for ultimate customization.
row.short_description: Mmm... It's Marakudjaaaa! Operation Marakudja is a dynamic multiplayer first-person shooter. What can you do for the divine fruits of Marakudja? Choose your hero and fight against many players around the world to collect the precious fruits and win!

row.name: Bed and BEAKfast
row.detailed_description: Bed and BEAKfast is a DEMO of Sincerely, Robin , our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game set in a world of birds! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow the bed and breakfast left to you by your late grandfather. Cook meals for your guests, engage with the community, and forge lasting relationships with the birds that come to stay! The full game is currently in development! By downloading this DEMO, you can expect a proof of concept of the upcoming game. While traversing the tree, you will be able to interact with a variety of characters, create dishes to serve your guests, expand your B&B, and support your community. Follow our social media to keep up with our development journey!
row.short_description: A DEMO of 'Sincerely, Robin' -- our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game currently in development! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow your late grandfather's bed and breakfast. Cook meals, connect with the community, and forge lasting relationships!

row.name: Jumping Steve
row.detailed_description: Jumping Steve is a 2d arcade style indy game with lots to discover. No tutorials, no cut scenes, very little reading, extremely fast loading times and lots of action. Features: 1. Fast arcade action. 2. Global leader boards. (No one has beaten the Dev yet and hes acting REAL smug about it) 3. Mini Games (And more planned). 4. Retro style with modern unique design. 5. Many achievements with hints throughout the game. 6. Several challenges for the hardcore gamer. 7. Simple gameplay with lots of stuff to do. 8. A longer description, WOW! Control Steve and jump to stay on the crows, collect the thingys and stay alive for as long as you can to increase your score. Complete random tasks and less random tasks like staying alive for 2 minutes to tick the boxes in your achievement list to increase the power of your log book. Unlock power ups in classic mode or use the M.O.D machine for some randomised madness. Its arcade style of play is perfect for taking in turns with friends. A score board so you know whos better. Player 2 can drop in or drop out at almost any time for some 2 player madness or go to the 2 player only VS mode. A 'unique' indie style of its own. Visit Camp Aign on the search for The Main Thingy and collect more Thingys. Find items like the Upgraded shirt to improve your jumping and score or other items to do other stuff. Over 25 minutes of original music to discover. Compatible with touch screen devices. The first game ever made by Steves Games. Created using Construct (The demo version is not up to date and has many bugs)

row.name: My Little Cemetery
row.detailed_description: My Little Cemetery seeks to juxtapose themes of death with a cute and cozy atmosphere. Become the new groundskeeper of the long-neglected Midwich Valley Cemetery and restore it to a state of beauty and tranquility. You'll find that some ghosts still linger there, and you can befriend them by tending to their graves, speaking with them, and fulfilling their requests. Complete daily maintenance tasks to earn money to spend on tools, seedlings, and decorations to beautify your cemetery. Grow plants to attract a variety of animals, allowing you to create a sanctuary for both ghosts and critters alike. By the end of your time here you can hope to learn the stories of the deceased and give them a peaceful afterlife, perhaps even gaining the attention of the Grim Reaper himself. EXPLORE THE GHOSTS STORIES AND BUILD CONNECTIONS. CUSTOMIZE THE GRAVEYARD TO YOUR LIKING. UNLOCK MORE CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS.
row.short_description: Become the groundskeeper of a neglected graveyard. Find friends amongst the deceased, learn their stories, and give them a peaceful afterlife. Experience the juxtaposition of death in a cute and cozy atmosphere.

row.name: Altered Bloodlines
row.detailed_description: In Altered Bloodlines, you will play as a 37 year old FBI Agent based in Boston. You just rescued six kidnapped young women, with the help of your partner, Sarah, and a pair of BPD Detectives, Luke and Hannah, but the case is far from over. You will be drawn deep down the rabbit hole as you uncover vast conspiracies and a shadowy criminal enterprise previously believed to be nothing more than myth and legend and will have to rely on your friends, both old and new, to uncover the truth and protect those closest to you. Will your fledgling relationship with the lovely Luci survive all that you will experience and learn? Will you be able to protect all those close to you from harm? Only you can determine your ultimate fate as you search for the truth behind Altered Bloodlines. Experience a gripping story full of mystery, romance, and passion as you strive to close the largest and most labyrinthine case of your career.  FEATURES A gripping story in the visual novel format. Make choices to determine the path of the story and your relationships with several beautiful love interests. As you progress through the story, unlock sexy images of many of the gorgeous women of Altered Bloodlines and view them in the gallery. Experience steamy scenes with the captivating ladies of the game, unlocking them in the replay gallery. Earn Steam achievements as you make your way through the story. Additional chapters will be made available to purchase as affordable DLC as they are ready, expanding the story until it reaches its conclusion. MEET THE CHARACTERS THE MC, JAMES ACKERMAN James is the main character of our story. He’s a 37 year old FBI agent working out of the Boston office with his partner Sarah. The story begins with James waking up in the hospital after suffering an injury while rescuing several kidnapped young women, what turns out to only be the beginning of an epic case involving a vast criminal empire. You will take on the role of James and can rename him if you so choose. You will develop your relationship with the captivating young Luci as you begin the case, but will your budding romance survive everything you learn? LUCI COOPER Luci is an 18 year old Freshman at the Massachusetts College of Art and Design. She was the sixth kidnapping victim and you felt an undeniable connection to her the instant you saw her photo in the case file. SARAH LOCKWOOD Sarah is a 35 year old FBI agent and has been your partner for eight years. The two of you are extremely close and have had a friends with benefits situation going on for most of your time as partners. HAYLEIGH GRAHAM Hayleigh is one of Luci’s closest friends and a freshman and Boston University. HANNAH POWERS Hannah is a 33 year old former Army Ranger and current detective with the Boston Police Department. Since partnering with your close friend Luke Robinson, she has also become a good friend of yours. LUKE ROBINSON Luke is a 37 year old detective with the Boston Police Department. You met on a case shortly after you were assigned to the Boston office and have been close friends ever since.
row.short_description: A troubling missing persons case soon snowballs into an investigation of a shadowy criminal enterprise and vast conspiracies that even affect your own family. Will you be able to solve the mystery while protecting those dear to you? Will your fledgling romance survive full knowledge of your past?
row.notes: Altered Bloodlines contains mature language, nudity, and graphic depictions of oral, vaginal, and other sexual activity. All sexual situations are depicted as occurring between consenting adults. The antagonists of Altered Bloodlines are a vast criminal organization that is involved in kidnapping and will resort to assassinating their own members to protect their secrets. This leads to many depictions of violence throughout the game, including the suicide of a corrupt FBI agent in future DLC. This game includes adult themes, and is intended for adults 18 years and older. The characters, story, and events are works of fiction.

row.name: Final Dash
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Final Dash, the electrifying platformer that takes you on an unforgettable journey through extraordinary worlds! Dive into a fast-paced experience filled with unique obstacles and breathtaking landscapes. In Final Dash, not only will you face meticulously designed challenges, but you'll also have the chance to create your own levels using our intuitive editor. Unleash your creativity and build amazing worlds that will challenge your friends and the community at large! Explore captivating environments, from futuristic landscapes to vibrant fantasy realms. Each level is meticulously crafted to provide visually stunning experiences and engaging gameplay that will test your reflexes and skills. Moreover, in Final Dash, the community is at the heart of the experience. Share your creations with other players, play community-made levels, and compete for top scores on global leaderboards. The fun and excitement never end in Final Dash! Are you ready for the ultimate challenge? Get ready to run, jump, and soar to greatness in Final Dash!
row.short_description: Introducing Final Dash, the thrilling platformer where you'll embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through stunning worlds! Jump into fast-paced challenges, create your own levels, and compete with friends. Are you ready to dash to victory?

row.name: Path of the Tank
row.detailed_description: Path of the Tank is an action-RPG where you can only play as a tank. But why? Why a tank and nothing else? Find out in this linear, glorified flash game that is easy to pick up. It might remind you of a bygone era... Key mechanics of the game: -2 gamemodes to choose from: Campaign and Survival Mode! -Real time combat -Simple yet deep skill tree, with 5 powerful late-game options to freely choose -Hunger mechanic; scavenge for food to survive! -Fairly wide variety of enemies from different factions -Upgradeable armor, potions and weapons -Tons of secret areas that may contain more than simple loot -Basic experience earning system. Defeat enemies to earn xp! -Conversations with differents characters, some with a philosophical questioning. -Travel through different scenarios like dark crystalline caves, villages, ruins, dungeons, and, mostly, lushful forests! -Long boss fights (you're a tank, you will not do much damage!) -Multiple endings and cinematics -Terminals with lore and forgotten memories to relive Gameplay: Tanking the angered forces of nature is no easy task. While your resilience is impeccable, you're still a mortal being, and you will need all the tools you can get. Armor, potions, defensive spells, and even unique special objects or other sources to make yourself tankier are all very needed. Hordes of enemies will try to surround you, and will slowly but surely will try to tear you apart. The gameplay may be in real time, but is not fast paced. You will need to manage you health, hunger, mana and cooldowns of your abilities at a moderate pace. The best way to survive is to manage these resources accordingly. Survival Mode: A secondary, arcade gamemode where you fight enemy waves that become increasingly difficult! Your only breaks are right after 6 waves, that's when you can spend all your money to upgrade your gear! How far can you get? Story: Something went terribly wrong. Nature is completely altered; earth itself is coming to life, animals are scared and the spirits are restless. The balance of existence itself, which is key for the stability of life has been altered beyond recognition. It's not the first time that this has happened, and it won't be the last. The price that the rational and the non-rational beings are paying in this world is heavy. Will you be able to stop this disaster? Of course you can. Otherwise no story would be told. But you're here to discover a lot more than that. Remove the nightmares of the innocent beings in this land, tank. Travel the path. Eat the path. In every story, the path must be travelled. Heroes must do their part, otherwise, oblivion will take it all, leaving nothing in its path. Not even a single memory in the mind of thousands, alive and those who are not here yet. Fortunately for us, our mere natural existence makes all the difference in the world to shape it however we want. That's why we have to fight. One day, when you finally understand the implications of all of this, you will become a illuminated soul. The natural deterioration of the universe must be fought by the illuminated. Entropy is always present everywhere, so we have to be the ones who chose order. There's a lot of places to discover while traveling the path. Perhaps you could dig out some information out of your past too...? The hidden secrets in these lands are key to understand this world. You will have to hunt them down to discover what really happened! But most importantly... Can you challenge oblivion itself?
row.short_description: Can you challenge oblivion itself?

row.name: Essence Bloom
row.detailed_description: 'I will show you a path to happiness.' Essence Bloom is a linear story-focused Visual Novel that is centered around the MC (the player) living in a peaceful world where he spends time with friends: Hikari - Aka, 'The Sunshine Girl,' is always smiling and happy. In fact, she seems obsessed with it and wants everyone else to be as happy as she is. Yuna - She runs the coffee shop, is number one in her class, and still finds time to take care of her younger sister, Saeko. She's bossy and blunt, but she has a gentle heart deep down. Saeko - She is the opposite of her older sister, Yuna, in almost every way. She's clumsy, timid, and very reliant. She also seems confused most of the time and worries everyone, but she is well loved.  Kagome - She's a well-disciplined martial arts champion who will defend anyone she cares about, no matter the sacrifice. She can also, surprisingly, be a bit bashful. The friends spend their time in school studying, working at their local coffee shop, and doing fun activities. Everything is peaceful until things start to happen that threaten the serenity of this world... Features: A story-rich experience with aesthetic visuals, energetic characters, and ~4 hours of dialogue.  This game is meant for 18+ audiences. Some viewers may find the content disturbing or offensive.
row.short_description: Essence Bloom is a linear, story-focused indie visual novel that allows the player to experience a world with beautiful cherry blossoms and fun times with friends....
row.notes: Crude Language, abuse, depictions of self harm, suicide, blood and violence.

row.name: CloudStudy
row.detailed_description: Find a Study Buddy CloudStudy is an innovative multiplayer game that blurs the lines between traditional learning and entertainment, creating a unique virtual learning and living community for global players. In this limitless virtual campus, you'll encounter like-minded individuals from around the world, exploring the vast ocean of knowledge and sharing the joy of learning together. Virtual Campus Upon entering CloudStudy, you'll step into a carefully designed virtual campus. Here, spacious classrooms await, where you can listen to lectures and interact with classmates from all over the globe. Cosy dormitories provide a place to rest and unwind, while vibrant gyms and game halls offer outlets for stress relief and physical exercise during breaks. Grow Together In CloudStudy, you'll never feel alone. Connect and interact with players from around the world, encouraging and supervising each other to maintain healthy schedules, work, and learning progress. We understand that staying motivated can be challenging when doing it alone, but in CloudStudy, you'll find companions who will walk alongside you on your journey. Learning Environment CloudStudy offers various smart assistance mechanisms to help you better plan your study and life. Feeling stiff after long hours of study? The reminder system will prompt you to take a break and move around, maintaining your optimal learning state. Want to organize your daily schedule? Our time management system allows you to easily set and track your plans. Enter the Focus Mode, where the screen dims, displaying a clock, while curated music accompanies you through each concentrated moment. Custom Decorations CloudStudy encourages creativity, allowing you to customize your space through the DIY mode. Whether it's your classroom seat or dormitory layout, you can decorate it according to your preferences. Maintaining a regular schedule and active participation will quickly earn you points, which can be redeemed for various ornaments and decorations, making your space uniquely and warmly yours. CloudStudy is not just a game; it's a vibrant learning and living community with endless possibilities. Here, you'll grow and progress alongside global players, experiencing the joy and sense of achievement that come from learning. Join us now! Embark on your new learning journey in CloudStudy!
row.short_description: An online study room shared by players around the world. Those who work hard for their dreams are welcome to join.

row.name: Earthling of Gaia
row.detailed_description: *******important note******* Learning the earthbending system used in this game is not easy. It is advised to focus while playing the tutorial. Also you should watch bending tutorial videos on my youtube channel. If you don't want to commit to this intense learning, then I do not recommend you to play this game. If you ignore this note, then you will complain, that the hitboxes don't work, while you don't even throw an attack on the enemy. This is my first finished and published game so far. Although I did my best, you should not expect AAA quality. *******important note******* Earthling of Gaia is played in the first person perspective in VR. It does count as action game, because the core game mode is to defeat waves of enemies. It's a simple wave defense game. It is important to know, that this game is just a small game. Your main weapon against the incoming enemies will be your earthbending skills. You can manipulate the earth around you by using the motion of your hands. Once an enemy is hit by a stone, he will be stopped. There is even waterbending. The goal of the game is to defend your precious goddess Gaia. You will win, if you stop all incoming waves. The game comes with different difficulty settings. If you are just here for role playing, you can play on easy mode. If you are here for a challenge, you can play on the impossible mode. There are many different ways how to use your earthbending skills! Watch the trailer for additional information about the earthbending system used in this game. About Me: I am a young solo developer. I developed this game in my free time, while working a full time job. I did not study game development. All my knowledge comes from online tutorials. Although I give my best to to deliver you the most impressive gaming experience, I cannot promise that I am able to fix all bugs or keep a high quality standard compared to other games. Technical Infos: This game can only be played with a virtual reality headset and associated controllers for each hand. The VR-device should have a joystick for moving. For Rotation the game supports snap turning.  There is only a single player mode.
row.short_description: Save your goddess Gaia from all incoming enemies by manipulating the earth around you!

row.detailed_description: Average feedback I get for this game: 'Yo, what OMG, this is a masterpiece!!! Thank you holy God, that I was born in a time, where these unbelievable pieces of art exist!!!' Small Jump and Run, where you control a head and try to find your lost body. An emotional and heartbreaking Story! Unforgettable and unique enemy design! 3 challenging levels + a final boss! Collectibles in all of the three main levels for an incredible bonus challenge! WOW!!!
row.short_description: Breathtaking jump and run with an incredible story and unforgettable gameplay, in which you control a severed head! Don't forget to vote this masterpiece as Game of the Year.

row.name: Ribbit Rampage
row.detailed_description: Ribbit Rampage is a fast-paced top-down shooter about a frog eating bugs. The frog can only do one thing: extend its tongue. But this one action is simultaneously how you move, damage enemies, eat enemies, and deflect projectiles. You will soon be frantically clicking all over your screen to hold back the endless waves of fearsome bugs, all of which require you to defeat them in different ways. And you'll constantly need to manage which enemy to prioritize - because it's one hit and you're croaked. Each new difficulty level is gated behind a score threshold. So get those good runs in to advance to the more hectic parts of the game. Take down the coveted Super Heavy enemies to prove yourself. Chase after the elusive Earthworm for bonus points. And find the perfect opportunity to deflect a Bee's stinger into a crowd of enemies for a massive multiplier.
row.short_description: An arcade-style top-down shooter where your only weapon is your froggy tongue. Eat hoardes of enemy insects in frantic, high-precision fights that demand clever decision-making. Don't get surrounded - it's one hit and you're croaked.

row.name: Smash and Bash Monsters: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Prologue for Smash and Bash Monsters Experience the first bosses of Smash and Bash Monsters. Beat waves and waves of monsters to get stronger, in this clicker-like adventure! Before entering each new wave you have to beat the boss from the previous one! Buy new weapons, on the shop, smash stronger monsters with your new weapons to get stronger loot! Buy upgrades from the shop to go even further into the waves Equip your new loot and gadgets to get the edge you need to Smash and Bash the Monsters!
row.short_description: Prologue for Smash and Bash Monsters. An addicting Clicker-Looter game where you defeat Thousands of monsters to loot equipment and get stronger, that can be as Relaxing or Frenetic as you like!

row.name: 驱煞
row.detailed_description: QUSHA is a teaching program in the -UE5 Full Process Course for Indie Game Creators by VaMP He and MOTZIFY. It’s a course project, not a full-fledged commercial release. We welcome you to play and provide feedback! Through continuous cultivation and upgrades, players enhance their spell abilities, enabling to remain fearless even when surrounded by demons. By combining various spells, increase strength and slay monsters on journey. Vast Arsenal of Spells for Unleashing Demonic Annihilation QUSHA boasts an extensive spell system, immersing players in a journey of magical mastery. As you progress, you'll refine your spellcasting prowess, becoming adept in wielding a diverse array of talismans and spells to effectively combat the forces of evil. Through continuous upgrades and demon slaying, you'll ascend to the pinnacle of power, becoming the ultimate vanquisher of all things demonic. Experience the thrill of slaying all kinds of demons Powered by the UE5 engine, QUSHA can host a large number of demons. With every swing of your blade and every spell cast, you'll revel in the visceral thrill of decimating hordes of malevolent creatures. Are you interested in game development? Join us and learn to make games together! QUSHA is a teaching program in the -UE5 Full Process Course for Indie Game Creators by VaMP He and MOTZIFY. Due to its nature as a course project, the game is smaller in scope. We encourage you to try it out and share your thoughts! In this course, we will teach you to make QUSHA step by step: starting from software download, we will take you to unlock the development and release of indie games. There is also a large developer support fund,which can make your game stand out! Are you interested in game development? Come and scan the code to to learn more!
row.short_description: QUSHA is a Chinese-style roguelike survivor game where you take on the role of a novice Daoist disciple in a world overrun by demons. As you progress through the game, you'll master a variety of talismans and Daoist techniques, unlocking powerful spells to combat evil forces and defend the peace.

row.name: River Town Factory: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Attention Workshop Masters, the official version is available here! About the Game River Town Factory: Prologue vs. Official Version Differences *Special Note: Prologue save data can all be transferred to the official version. In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all romanceable NPCs up to 4 hearts. In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all regular NPCs up to 4 hearts. In the Prologue version, players can access up to T1 node in the Oracle Temple. In the Prologue version, 15% of buildings and technologies are available. In the Prologue version, players can explore the Central Region, including martial arts and relic caves within the region. In the Prologue version, players can reach a maximum of Level 2 on the SwordWay Sect and River Town Bounty Board (Somewhat Famous). In the Prologue version, players can participate in the Spring Festival, including the Flower Festival and Qingming Festival. Create automated production assembly lines, from wooden planks to circuit boards, design every step of your production line. Unlock future technologies gradually, from silicon purification to photovoltaic power generation, and build your futuristic workshop. Use inter-district teleportation stations to receive products at various levels, expanding your factory's territory to the entire continent. From brewing and oil pressing to manufacturing ovens, even producing watches and antibiotics, astound ancient people with your futuristic goods! Reinforced concrete, rubber, and large-scale computers, these will be the mass-produced materials you use in the ancient times, a thousand years ago!!! There are 12 characters that can be pursued in the game - the royal, the martial arts world, the merchant, etc. Unlock the secrets of each character and pursue the friendships and romances you desire. Choose your partner and discuss marriage, and together move into the workshop where they will provide powerful assistance. Make connections with nearly 30 historical figures, each with their own changing schedules throughout the four seasons. Participate in their lives and use modern knowledge to solve their problems. In the River Town, everything happens naturally, and you have the final say on when to work, explore, and engage in romantic pursuits. A fast-paced combat system that is easy to pick up, combining evasion and offense to defeat your enemies through strategic maneuvers. Whether through formal training or adventures in the martial arts world, master more than 40 martial arts techniques including external skills, internal skills, light skills, and hard skills, allowing you to dominate the martial arts world. Explore the four major villages on the map, complete village quests, and uncover their secrets. Explore the mystical realms left behind by ancient predecessors, delve deep into them, and defeat bizarre creatures. Explore the entire continent, discover treasures, explore bat caves, and punish bandits for the people. Sign contracts with mine owners throughout the entire map, allowing ancient people to work for you. Be a skilled craftsman or a social butterfly? Become the top martial artist or a versatile expert in everyday life? It's all up to you to decide. Craft spiritual medicines, weapons, and clothing, becoming a master of ancient craftsmanship. Create over 20 different dishes with various enhancements, such as Five Treasures Stew and Snowy Sunset Soup... Make them in your kitchen! Fill the Heavenly Workshop with the products you create, allowing ancient people to visit and witness modern technology. Utilize the power of future technology to repair the time machine and fulfill a mission that only you can accomplish.
row.short_description: If possible, would you like to go back to ancient times to start a factory, refine oil, or even build a large computer? With the accidental fall of a meteorite, you traveled back to River Town a thousand years ago and became a workshop owner. And the story will begin from here……

row.name: A Living Room
row.detailed_description: You are a man in a room. A puppet in purgatory. Simulated flesh in a digital prison. There is no escape. You won't scream, because you're not programmed to. Your choices matter as much as anything matters, so the bar is fairly low. 'A Living Room' is a short point-and-click non-adventure that you should be able to finish in less than an hour. Hurry up, please. It will all be over soon. The nothing never felt so much like something.
row.short_description: You are a man in a room. Something feels off. Or maybe it's on. A short existential comedy point-and-click non-adventure about the limitations and imitations of human existence – or, really, whatever you want it to be about.
row.reviews: “A Living Room is mental, and I love it.” Vulgar Knight “A morbidly funny philosophical one-shot mini-adventure.” Adventures in Moon Logic “A virtuosically executed gut shot of interactive nihilism.” The Systemic Elitist

row.name: Reborn: An Idle Roguelike RPG
row.detailed_description: Overview Reborn: An Idle Roguelike RPG blends the long-term satisfaction of idle games with the challenge of roguelike progression and the charm of classic RPG storytelling. You play as Katie , a Reborn—an immortal warrior sent to protect a quaint, slowly unraveling village nestled on the edge of a dangerous cave. While you're off battling waves of increasingly powerful Creatures, the village moves forward: relationships evolve, secrets bubble to the surface, and a darker truth about your origins begins to emerge. 💤 Idle, But With Purpose Set your character to auto-fight through an ever-deepening cave and check in when you're ready. Level up your stats, craft and enchant your gear, brew potions, and plan your next run. ⚔️ Die. Rebuild. Go Deeper. Each run ends in death, but to a Reborn, death is growth. Keep your experience, and customize stronger builds with every rebirth. Tweak your stats, push one floor further, and uncover a little more each time. 🏡 A Village Worth Protecting Meet 19 unique villagers with evolving relationships and personal storylines. Help them grow, uncover the truth about your shared pasts, and change their futures. 📜 Systems With Depth Six core stats to build and balance. Crafting & gear upgrades with randomized bonuses and enchantable crystals. Potions brewed with a mix of ingredients for temporary, stackable boosts. Questlines that unlock more of the world and the people within it. 🌱 Built For The Long Haul This is a game designed to be played in short bursts across weeks or even months. No daily login requirements. No monetization. Just a chill, thoughtful loop you can come back to whenever you want. 🎮 Join Our Community Reborn was shaped by player feedback, and it continues to be. Join the Discord to share ideas, report bugs, and help shape what's next. Whether you're in it for the lore, the strategy, or just a cozy background grind—thank you for playing. To everyone who’s left a review (yes, even the negative ones), reported a bug, offered feedback, or just chatted with me during development, thank you. Your support, humor, and ideas have kept me going through the highs and lows of building this game over the last 18 months of development. I never expected such a warm and thoughtful community to form around Reborn, and I’m incredibly grateful for it. You’ve made this more than a solo project, you’ve made it something we've created together..
row.short_description: A tactical idle roguelike RPG where you progress through auto-battles, gather resources, craft gear, and brew stat-boosting potions. Build your character, shape a village of evolving NPCs, and uncover hidden truths in a story-driven world that rewards curiosity and time.

row.short_description: Skill Up is a colorful 3D jump and run game where you progress through a large variety of unique stages. Just reach the goal; and don't fall down!

row.name: Soulbind: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Start the journey .The prologue is set before the story of the main game Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld. You will learn where your hero's journey began, how he met his indispensable companion and other characters. Assemble yourself piece by piece .Yes, you are an ordinary skeleton, an outsider, but you have a specialty - you can replace your body parts with body parts of defeated enemies. A couple of successful battles and you are already half an invincible monster, a third a zombie and a third a witch on your grandmother's side. Found and knocked out body parts have different rarity, which depends on the main characteristics and unique passive effects. To put it simply, if you like to change the strategy of the game, to be a tank or a mage - there is something to play with. Get special skills .How about breathing fire, turning to stone, or summoning a swarm of disgusting flies to your aid? Easy, all you have to do is defeat an enemy and get his head or torso on you. Although a little luck is needed here too. Mutate .By defeating enemies, you accumulate internal power and voila, you can choose a special mutation of your character. For example, strengthen the skills you use, improve basic attacks, add a stun chance, and more. Get to know the mysterious world The action of the prologue takes place in the library. It's a confusing location with its own traps and secrets, and of course dust, magic and books not handed in on time. Perhaps the library is the perfect place to learn more about the world of Allaar. And say that again .Death is commonplace in the world of Allaar. Yes, you'll lose everything you've gained, but you won't lose your experience as a player. The second attempt will be better than the first, and on the fifth time you can even get one eyeful of the boss. The main thing is that the attempts can be different from each other and if you like it, it is worth paying attention to Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld, there you will find new enemies and new mechanics.
row.short_description: Soulbind: Prologue is an action platformer in the Roguelike genre. The hero is a common skeleton and an outsider. But there is one special feature - you can replace your body parts with parts of your opponents' bodies. Learn the backstory and start your journey in the world of Allaar.

row.name: Riptide
row.detailed_description: Outfit your Ship Prepare with the perfect blend of weaponry! Choose between heavy weapons to ravage turrets or lighter weapons to spray down scouting enemy parties. Change stats with ship components! Tank up to take on the whole army or become so offensive that they won’t be even able to see you coming. Experiment and make your perfect ship! Naval Fleet Combat Dive into the universe of naval space combat. The enemy is well established in your sector with scouting parties, defense turrets, and heavy ships that vastly outperform your own. That being said, you’re now the captain of your own unique battlecruiser and a tried and tested crew. With your skill and their experience combined, victory is almost guaranteed! Narrative As a recently promoted captain, you’ve been relocated to be at the forefront of the revolution. Lead a special operation – one that has the power to turn the entire conflict on its head. It is up to you to prove that there is still hope for an end to this war. Learn the details through your military briefings and slowly put together the full context of the Catolia civil war and its rich history. Learn and untangle the stories of your crew and your enemies to get to the heart of the rift tearing this system apart. Your mission? Fight for freedom or die trying.
row.short_description: In Riptide, gear up your ship, customize your loadout, and fight for the fleet! Riptide is a spaceship combat game with an emphasis on powerful customizations and utility. Accomplish your mission by loading up and taking out the enemy.

row.short_description: Adapt and survive against an ever increasing menace! Castaway Soul is a casual Isometric 3D rogue-lite game, with elements of mystery and bullet-heaven like action that combines wave-to-wave upgrades with meta-progression builds.

row.name: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is the proof of concept for Kriegsfront Tactics, an upcoming procedural turn-based mecha squad tactics game for military sim fans where we combine elements from classic tactical strategy RPG games, roguelikes, and lowpoly retro-style visuals. In this prologue chapter, you'll get to experience the game's opening story and roughly the 1st hour of gameplay. Set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia, you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Manage your squad, resources, and mechs. Complete your mission and survive the front while facing hard decisions that will test your morality. Metal Crunching Cinematic Combat Watch the mayhem and destruction unfold, metal against metal. Customize Your Mech Customize your mech’s livery, salvage or swap parts, and equip weapons. Survive 1970s Southeast Asian Jungle Explore the jungles of Southeast Asia during an era of conflict, encounter events, and uncover secrets in this alternate 1970s world. Execute Tactical Mecha Operations Plan ahead, strategize, and use your tactical prowess to outsmart your enemies.
row.short_description: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is the proof of concept for the upcoming procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s Southeast Asia. In this prologue chapter, you'll get to experience combat, exploration, and the opening story of the game.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work.

row.name: Your Turn to Disembark
row.detailed_description: Notice : Base game only includes Chapter 1 of the game, more chapters will be added in later updates. You've awakened inside of a train with no memory of ever boarding... Something appears to be weird about this train. Maybe it's the surprisingly clean environment, maybe it's the windows that are just a bit too hard to see out of. Or maybe it's the fact that the train appears to be never ending, constantly looping back on itself enough to drive any passenger mad! Something is weirding me out about this place.. But I can't put my finger on what? Welcome to Your Turn to Disembark , a episodic narrative adventure game about finding your way out of this strange and unnerving train with the help of 8 other bizarre passengers. In this mystery adventure game you will be talking to the various passengers who are also stuck upon this train and trying to escape together. Learn about their pasts and futures, their struggles and their strengths. Some will become your friends, some may snap... Walk around the train to try and discover it's secrets! And maybe, finally figure out what really is going on in this locomotive...
row.short_description: Your Turn to Disembark is an episodic narrative game about a weird train and the passengers that are trapped inside of it. Will you make it out of the train or will you be trapped onto it's route for the rest of days?
row.notes: This game contains content that may be disturbing for certain audiences. Scenes of death, emotional reactions and fear are common. Please be advised.

row.name: Fatal Falls
row.detailed_description: Fatal Falls is an indie horror adventure that plunges players into a sinister, twisted world within the walls of a seemingly ordinary hotel named The Grand Elysium . Uncovering the mysteries of this place involves a journey through multiple chapters, each one peeling back a layer of deceit, horror, and the darkness hidden in plain sight. You must find clues and unlock puzzles to delve deeper, eventually confronting the hotel’s true nature — a place designed to ensnare those struggling with mental health. Every interaction shapes your path and can lead to multiple possible outcomes. While most roads end in despair, only one path offers a chance to bring justice, if players uncover the right clues and avoid the clutches of a patrolling receptionist. Suspense builds as the protagonist faces unsettling therapy sessions with a strange psychologist, whose probing questions on mortality and depression blur the lines between sanity and madness... Players must solve puzzles to access hidden rooms and unveil shocking truths about the hotel and its corrupt management. Tension heightens as you evade the ever-watchful receptionist. Will you expose the criminal organization pulling the strings, or will you find yourself ensnared by their dark secrets? With an immersive atmosphere, complex choices, and intense psychological themes, Fatal Falls explores the horrors of the mind and the terrifying consequences of falling too far into despair.
row.short_description: In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of 'The Grand Elysium', a posh luxury hotel in the middle of nowhere. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you don't get entangled in the hotel's dark deeds...
row.notes: Fatal Falls contains strong adult themes such as mental illness and suicide and contains occassional strong use of gore which can be turned off. It is recommended only for players over 18.

row.name: Wyvern Studios Solitaire: 30th Aniversary Edition
row.detailed_description: Wyvern Studios Solitaire: 30th Anniversary Edition is a tribute to the original game released in the 1990's by Wyvern Studios. It features both Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire . It includes 9 different deck styles to choose from and features joystick support for the full experience. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever. We will also be offering a Solitaire Construction Set DLC that will allow you to create and share hundreds of unique solitaire creations. The 9 deck styles in the base game include three(3) traditional playing card decks and six(6) photo decks guaranteed to be 'Family Friendly!' TRADITIONAL DECKS Traditional Face Cards Easy Read Alphanumeric Cards Wyvern Memories Face Cards FAMILY FRIENDLY PHOTO DECKS Fireworks Fungi Insects Minerals & Gems Natural Textures Space Exploration

row.name: Neutralized: Dark moon
row.detailed_description: 生存挑战 在帷幕之下的超自然世界中生存下来！这些世界充满着危险和未知。探索6个未知的异常场景，每一个场景都存在着无法彻底解释异常现象与巨型异常实体。面对它们的威胁，您必须想尽办法来突破重围，直到来到引发这一切幕后黑手的面前，将其成功收容。如果您长时间持续一局游戏，您将面对更加恶劣的环境和凶残的敌人。独特的动态调节系统会使得您和异常个体的力量在每场游戏中不断增长。 异常物品 收集超过100件威力强大的异常道具，会让每次的游戏都充满新鲜感。随着收集的物品越来越多，您可以依赖的力量越来越多，您也会变得越来越强大。叠加达到一定数量的异常道具有时会产生惊人的力量。查阅超自然理事会档案部的记载，您可以找到更多的异常物品使用说明，并了解他们的来历，更有针对性的制定策略，不断提升自己的生存技能。 解锁玩法 解锁7位机动特遣队调查员，每一位调查员都有自己独特的战斗风格和技能。探索来自未来科技——“切线装置”的秘密，这些装置将带来诸如随机敌人、物品调换等颠覆式的游戏体验。还有随机生成的关卡、敌人、宝箱和异常道具，每一次冒险都是独一无二的。 单人及合作模式 您可以选择独自踏上收容之旅，或最多与三名好友一同进行线上合作任务。征服超自然的异常世界，迎接各种战斗考验。外勤特工克丽丝、圣诞诡灵的头目Mr·Night、奇术专家凯瑟琳博士等角色将陪伴你共同面对未知的威胁和挑战。
row.short_description: 在毁灭级世界末日来临前夕，扮演人类延续保障组织“全球超自然理事会”的机动特遣队成员，前往异界锚点，浴血奋战杀出异常个体的重围，武力收容强大的异常怪物首领。您可以选择做一位孤胆英雄，也可以与好友并肩作战。通过各种手段搜罗异常道具和异星科技装置，并依靠它们的力量，直到您对决帷幕之下最为可怕的世界真相。

row.name: Scrambler
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Scrambler , where adorable characters and menacing enemies collide in a whirlwind of action! In this rogue-like wave survival game, you’ll control a group of lovable yet fierce cartoon heroes, each with unique abilities and powers. Your mission? Survive endless waves of quirky, unpredictable enemies—ranging from mischievous little critters to giant, menacing bosses—all while unlocking new upgrades and weapons. Each run is a fresh adventure, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two experiences are the same. Collect power-ups, discover hidden treasures, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies! With every wave, the challenge grows, but so do your characters, leveling up in delightful and unexpected ways. Scrambler combines charming visuals with frantic gameplay. Will you be able to outlast the adorable onslaught and become the ultimate wave survivor? Get ready to fight, dodge, and level up in this action-packed rogue-like survival adventure that’s as cute as it is chaotic!
row.short_description: Scrambler is a fast-paced rogue-like wave survival game where you control adorable cartoon characters fighting off endless waves of quirky enemies. Level up, collect power-ups, and survive as the challenge intensifies in procedurally generated levels.

row.name: Cyan's Snow House
row.detailed_description: 'Cyan's Snow House' is a heartwarming short indie game that transcends language to provide a universally enjoyable experience. Without a single line of dialogue and requiring only simple mouse clicks to play, players step into the shoes of Cyan, a lone girl in a snow-covered village, who daily feeds and spends time with animals shivering from the cold. Despite its brief playtime of around 10 minutes, it leaves a lasting, wonderful impression on anyone, anywhere in the world. The gentle moments shared between Cyan and the animals convey a warm message: 'Your place is here.' Recommended for anyone seeking a moment of solace on a cold winter's day, this game promises to melt your heart with its soothing embrace.
row.short_description: 'Your place is here.' - 'Cyan's Snow House' is a dialogue-free, short indie game set in a snowy village, offering a universal, heartwarming experience in just 10 minutes. Enjoy tranquil moments with Cyan and her animal friends, leaving a lasting impression.

row.name: Obilia
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR COMMUNITY! About the Game Obilia is a casual episodic open-world RPG, an open-ended odyssey in a vibrant archipelago tailored for you. Following widespread societal collapse, Vigor Pike, visionary founder of Legacy, envisions a fresh start. With his friend Kai Hudson, they unveil Obilia – a beacon of hope and rediscovery. As a latest generation Legacy envoy, you'll step onto a world of possibilities, adventures and secrets, and find where you belong in the Obilia's rich, evolving tapestry. Your journey will lead you far and wide – from the presence of a philosopher in a city of wisdom to the vengeful rage of a demonic god, or discovering the extraordinary fauna, unearthing ancient songs lost to history, and navigating through environments rich in forgotten lore. From lush forests to misty mountains, serene waters to dreamy caves, each island will offer its unique adventures and challenges. Obilia warmly invites you to weave your own story where you will never run out of things to do. Welcome Home, Future Obilian In your travels across this new habitat without end, you'll uncover both new and familiar landscapes, you'll assist and befriend companions, solve puzzles, confront foes, and engage in cooking, crafting, fishing, and more. As you gain the trust of the inhabitants, you'll uncover what it means to be an Obilian. You Lead the Journey Choose how you want to explore and experience Obilia – fish in ever-changing waters, cook unique dishes, cultivate crops from your travels. Craft yourself tools and weapons, build a home filled with artifacts from your adventures, and explore the richly-varied regions of Obilia, where puzzles and quest unlock secrets and rare treasures. An Ever-Unfolding Odyssey Rediscover humanity's legacy in Obilia, built away from the remains of a world in disorder, a place to remember humanity, reenact history, and reshape a future. Interact with colorful and enigmatic inhabitants, each with their own rich histories and secrets. Find companions to progress your story and expand your world. Master your skills in fishing, crafting and puzzle-solving, earn the trust of the community, and uncover the depths of Obilia. Craft Your Personal Paradise Turn your personal island in Obilia into a reflection of your journey! With limitless customization options, you can cultivate your own land, build and decorate the home of your dreams. Whether it's a Victorian cottage, a Viking longhouse, or a simple thatched hut, your island will be the canvas for your imagination. Expand it, blend styles, and create a space that represents the unique Obilian you are.
row.short_description: Embark on a journey in Obilia, an archipelago of tomorrow dedicated to humanity's legacy and imagination. Explore this evolving world, get to know its legendary figures, and find your own place in this expansive open-world RPG.

Become Miku Hatsune and turn the earth into a planet of green onions! Hatsune Miku .Hatsune Miku has completed her long, long journey in a green onion-shaped spaceship. Let's terrorize the humans in order to rule the earth! Grow your hair ! Destroy buildings ! You can invade as you see fit. . Explore !As you proceed with your invasion, you will discover humans. row.name: Helbreath Nemesis
row.detailed_description: Version 7 Helbreath is an MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game) that combines elements of action, strategy, and fantasy. Set in a dark medieval world, players choose between two warring factions: Aresden or Elvine. You can explore a vast world, battle monsters and other players, complete quests, and participate in epic battles. The game is known for its intense PvP (Player versus Player) gameplay, trade-based economy, and strategic alliance-building to dominate territories. Get ready to immerse yourself in an exciting and challenging adventure in Helbreath!
row.short_description: Helbreath is a dark medieval MMORPG featuring intense PvP, strategic alliances, and a trade-centric economy. Choose between two warring factions and immerse yourself in epic battles and quests in a vast fantasy world.
row.notes: "In Helbreath, players will encounter frequent instances of violence, including combat between characters using various weapons and magic spells. Additionally, the game features mature themes such as warfare, conquest, and political intrigue within a fantasy setting. Players may also encounter mild instances of suggestive themes and language during interactions with NPCs and other players. It's important to note that while the game does not contain explicit nudity or graphic sexual content, the overall tone and atmosphere may not be suitable for all audiences."

row.name: Count to Ten: Infinity
row.detailed_description: Key Features: Simple and Easy to Learn: Just tap the target number. Progressive Difficulty: Each successful tap increases the game's challenge procedurally. High Score Focus: Aim for a new personal best with every playthrough. Intuitive Design: Easy to pick up, no tutorials needed. Skill Mastery: Perfect for players who enjoy mastering their reflexes and reaction times. Be the Best: With leaderboard integration and plenty of achievements, you'll be able to see just how well you play compared to others. Engage in a simple yet increasingly difficult challenge: tap shapes in numerical order as quickly as possible. The game is a straightforward test of focus and reflexes. As you hit each target, several difficulty factors will increase, pushing you to keep pace and making each level more and more challenging. There's no complex backstory or convoluted things to learn; it's just you and the numbers in a race to see how long you can keep the sequence going.
row.short_description: In this arcade-style game, chasing higher scores becomes an addictively fast-paced quest for precision. Count to Ten challenges you to tap numbered shapes in sequence, ramping up the challenge with every success. Pure, quickfire fun!

row.name: The Storyteller
row.detailed_description: In the game you can create your own world in a worldbuilder mode and tell your story as a Storyteller. After you finished the worldbuilding, you can host it and play with your friends in a Turn-based combat RPG. Here are the features you can access: Play as a Storyteller: Create Worlds: Easily paint terrains and add buildings, trees, and decorations. NPCs and Shops: Add characters that players can interact with, including shopkeepers. Interactive Storytelling: Tell your story and engage players with interactive elements. Epic Battles: Challenge players with turn-based combat and powerful enemies. Triggers: Change chapters or music on the fly. Rewards: Place chests with loot for players to find after battles. Set the Mood: Use music and sounds to enhance the atmosphere. Dice Rolls: Add a TTRPG feel with dice roll challenges. Custom Rules: Adjust the game’s difficulty and other settings to your liking. Host and lead your friends through your creation online, or let everyone explore the world that you created. Play as a Hero: Create Your Character: Pick an avatar and distribute stats. Battle: Fight in strategic turn-based battles. Level Up: Grow stronger and choose your path as a warrior, mage, or rogue. Learn Spells: Master different classes and spells. Loot and Gear Up: Find treasures, buy gear, and get ready for bigger challenges. Adventure: Dive into the story and interact with the world. TTRPG Checks: Use dice rolls for key moments like persuasion. Be the Hero: Complete the campaign and become a legend.
row.short_description: The Storyteller is an online game where you can build your own turn-based RPG game without any programming and graphic knowledge. Play your world with your friends online, challenge them in turn-based battles, and let them loot and level up after a fiercefull battle while they go through your story.

row.name: Egregore
row.detailed_description: They wish to summon an Egregore, to shape reality as they see fit. Egregore is a first-person adventure where you uncover an occult conspiracy in modern Cairo. Using a unique graphing mechanic, you’re empowered to connect the dots and discover a web of intrigue and possibility. Egregore questions what constitutes “truth” , immersing you in a deep and uncertain world. What would you do to uncover the truth? Reshape reality by drawing connections with a mystic astrolabe. Summon people, objects, and rooms as you explore the world around you. Create your own truth with the knowledge at your disposal, forming new realities, spaces, and associations. Question dynamic characters to uncover the truth. Follow your own path through the story using the information you've uncovered. The residents of Café Ramses are more than they seem, with histories and motives all their own. Connect them to concepts, people, and objects around Ramses to discover their connections, personalities, and anxieties. Traverse a vibrant cafe in modern-day Cairo. Explore an authentic, radiant portrayal of modern Egypt. Make your way to Café Ramses, a respected traditional coffee house that prides itself on its culture. Egregore is an AGP/MFA thesis project developed in collaboration between USC Games , Berklee College of Music , and Otis College of Art and Design . Inspirations include NORCO , Riven , and The Case of the Golden Idol .
row.short_description: Embark on a first-person adventure to a mysterious café in Cairo. Adopt a new perspective and shape reality to your will as you unravel an occult conspiracy hidden in plain sight.

row.name: The Veiled Ones
row.detailed_description: Warning: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. The Veiled Ones is a stealth horror game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. Inspired by the invisible entities from Islam, the players must rely on a magic artifact and their hearing to survive the jinn haunting their son, and unravel the mystery behind their son's disappearance. LOOK INTO THE JINN WORLD Use the black magic artifact called the Looking Glass to peer into a haunting realm, and navigate the invisible enemies that are haunting you HIDE FROM INVISIBLE ENEMIES Look for clues about your son's possession while hiding from invisible jinn. Listen to their footsteps, use the Looking Glass, and avoid the crying whispers UNRAVEL THE POSSESSION Piece together the clues and exorcise your son. Who is possessing him? And why? The Veiled Ones was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Advanced Game Project (AGP) in collaboration with students from Otis College of Art and Design, Berklee College of Music, and Laguna College of Art and Design. For more information, please visit our publishing page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, please visit the website listed on the right side of the store page.
row.short_description: The Veiled Ones is a horror stealth game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. In this game players will reveal the story behind their son's possession, while avoiding the jinn that haunts them.

row.name: Bugnauts!
row.detailed_description: In Bugnauts, players take on the role of Chloe, a young entomologist determined to save her island home from the giant Phantom bugs wreaking havoc across its shores. Armed with her trusty net, swing, jump, and battle your way through hordes of magically corrupted insects in this fast-paced 3D projectile action game! Explore rich environments, collect fascinating insects, and delve into the vibrant world of Bugnauts! Gameplay Features Engage in fast-paced combat Use Chloe’s net to catch projectiles hurled by her overgrown enemies and swing them back with force! As Chloe you will face hordes of Phantomized bugs, all transformed into mindless fighting machines. Face an array of enemies with unique attacks waiting to be turned against them. Traverse the world and collect hidden items From the lush island forests to the unfinished resort, Chloe's journey is filled with opportunities to explore. Using her jump and dash abilities, Chloe is able to reach new parts of the island. Use the net to catch hidden collectible bugs just waiting to be found. Collect them all to complete the field guide! Save the environment and save the island See your impact! In Bugnauts, every action counts towards saving your home. Take down Phantomized enemies to return their natural forms and witness the surrounding environment heal in real time. Restore the island one bug at a time. About Development Bugnauts was developed as one of the University of Southern California's Advanced Game Projects (AGP). For more information about the USC Games Program, check out their website.
row.short_description: Embark on a thrilling 3D projectile action adventure in Bugnauts! Swing your net to battle giant bugs and save your island home from an evil resort tycoon. Fight, collect, and explore in this action-packed game for all ages.

row.name: Brinkmanship
row.detailed_description: Brinkmanship is a first-person sci-fi mystery about a colony ship that has secretly changed course. The ship has 30,000 people on it and has been traveling for 20 years, your entire life. Now the future you’ve been promised is slipping away. The player must investigate the ship to find out what’s going on and confront the ship’s captain to get it back on track. Brinkmanship emphasizes conversation over violence, but leaves the gun on the table. Investigate a Thrilling Sci-Fi Conspiracy Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative as you uncover hidden truths, and decipher the cryptic motives steering the vessel off-course. With each revelation, the stakes heighten, and the fate of everyone you’ve ever known hangs in the balance. Dynamic interactions influence character dialogue Arm yourself with the option to draw, stow, or fire your weapon during critical conversations, the power of choice extends beyond words and adds a layer of tension. Influence the narrative with the subtle threat of force or the restraint of diplomacy, shaping the evolving story in unexpected ways. Choose Violence or Eloquence to Guide the Fate of Your Crew The destiny of the 30,000 souls aboard the colony ship lies in your hands. Will you tread the path of violence, asserting dominance and control, or will you rely on eloquence and negotiation to sway the course of events? Maybe you’ll even take a bribe to make your accusations disappear… Brinkmanship offers a unique blend of strategic decision-making, where your choices echo across the vast expanse of space, dooming the ship you were born on delivering it to the world you’ve been promised. Brinkmanship was made by USC students and published through the USC Games Publishing Association. For more information, please visit our publishing page. Each choice you make shapes your experience in this enthralling cycle of everyday trials. Will you uncover the path to perseverance or succumb to the pressures of this warped existence? Explore the depths of LaughterLost and discover if you can survive. Will you break this dystopian cycle of life? Engaging Narrative Story Engage in narrative decisions that will make or break you, in your journey through family and work life. Can you defend your livelihood in this cruel, unforgiving world? Solve Intricate Puzzles Navigate intricate puzzles that challenge your problem-solving skills in this surreal and dystopian world. Solving puzzles advances you through the narrative while you discover the mysteries of this cycle of everyday existence. BECOME the Final Boss Confront unique and intense confrontations that epitomize the distinctive challenges of your character's dystopian journey. Test your skills against unexpected foes, introducing dramatic twists in an already twisted world Message from Mix Studio: 'Exploring the diverse facets of laughter inspired by the theme, our team discussed various ways and meanings of smiling, embarking on a journey to dissect its complexities. We pondered the nuances of genuine laughter born from humor and joy, juxtaposed with the façade of artificial smiles often worn in social settings or to mask inner turmoil. Our exploration led us to the perspective of a middle-class worker facing the imminent threat of job loss. In this narrative, we unveiled different kinds of smiles: the obligatory smile in the presence of superiors, the strained smiles concealing stress, and the genuine moments of joy shared with loved ones, such as his daughter. Our main goal is to discover the multifaceted nature of smiles and delve into broader societal themes. Through gameplay, we aim to provoke contemplation on labor challenges and the pervasive drinking culture prevalent in China.'
