row.name: Cycles
row.detailed_description: Cycles is a procedural music composition about appreciating a forest through all parts of its life cycle. What Is This? Cycles is an audiovisual composition. When you launch Cycles, you can view a performance of the piece. If you let it run, it will create a new performance, then another, infinitely; these are completely different generations of the piece. This is because Cycles is procedurally generated, every time (like a Minecraft world). Each generation is related, and may sound kind of similar, but might sound totally different. There are billions of possible generations—you don't have to watch every one, of course, but it's nice to think that the one you're watching has probably never been seen by anyone else. You can even share a nice one with a friend if you'd like. What Is This not? Cycles is non-interactive—there are hotkeys, if you'd like to view a specific generation, or ensure a specific visual mode, but the piece generates automatically. You can watch the performance, but you won't perform it yourself. Why Does It Exist? Two reasons—one practical, one philosophical. First, I am a composer, and suddenly game engines have become an extremely legitimate tool for composing music. Not just writing music for games—actually composing with the procedural tools inside an engine (in this case, Unreal Engine 5). Despite this, few composers are doing so. The second reason goes back to what the piece is about . Having lived in California for about a decade, I've found it challenging to see places I love burn in wildfires. I was excited to have the opportunity to create a work touching on this for Big Basin Redwood State Park (much of which burned in the 2020 CZU Lightning Complex fire), and immediately I thought that a procedural composition would be well-suited for this topic. Cycles continually generates new compositions, one after another—each iteration of the piece derives from the same source material and compositional rules, but the generation incorporates enough environmental chance that no two renderings are the same (and some are in fact very different). Surprisingly, this algorithmic, 'digital' feature represents the natural world quite closely. A forest that grows back after a fire is created from many of the same common inputs as the forest that came before it (species, weather, sun exposure, etc.); however, it won't grow back in exactly the same way. Recognizing these two aspects—the uniqueness of the moment in time, and the relationship to the same moment in other cycles—was helpful to me in appreciating fire as a natural part of a forest. I hope you'll enjoy the music I've created with this process.
row.short_description: Cycles is a procedural music composition about appreciating a forest through all parts of its life cycle. Experience billions of unique generations of the piece.

row.name: Otto's Escape
row.detailed_description: In Otto's Escape you fly a jetpack with just two buttons: one for your left booster and one for your right. There's no simple move up or move right button - that'd be too easy. To steer, you'll need to balance the thrust from those two boosters to get you moving in the right direction, all while fighting with gravity and an ever-shrinking fuel supply. The aim of the game is simple: reach the top of the tower and escape without running out of fuel, or you'll be sent right back to the ground. Piece of cake, right? Key features Ascend the tower 🚀 To escape the tower you'll need to clear 20 unique floors filled with an increasingly challenging assortment of hazards which will slow you down and drain your fuel if you fly too close. And some say the tower's so tall it reaches into outer space... Controller support 🎮 Otto's Escape's unique control scheme is best experienced with a controller featuring analog triggers - such as an Xbox or PlayStation controller - which will allow you to more finely control the thrust from your two boosters and steer with greater precision. Attempt stats 📊 Track your attempts with detailed stats screens as you edge closer to your first triumphant escape. And after that, why not try for a faster time? Achievements & leaderboards 🏆 Your first escape is only the start - Otto's Escape's achievements offer some of the game's hardest challenges, while in-game leaderboards allow you to see how your fastest time compares with others around the world.

row.name: Project Cottontails
row.detailed_description: Project Cottontails is a short interactive story set inside the Civic Museum of Manduria. You play as Alessio, a thoughtful young man exploring a faithfully recreated 3D version of the museum, where forgotten fragments of his grandfather’s past — a former Allied pilot in World War II — begin to surface. This isn’t a gameplay-heavy title, nor a long adventure packed with challenges. It’s something smaller, more personal. A first step in blending technology, storytelling, and historical memory. It lasts about twenty minutes — just enough, we hope, to leave a quiet impression. The story is simple and subdued, designed to stir emotion without relying on spectacle. One of the core goals of the project is to preserve and share a real cultural site , offering virtual access to a piece of history that many might never be able to visit in person. In this sense, Project Cottontails is also an experiment in digital preservation — a way to open the doors of local heritage to a wider world. This is just the beginning. The project is intentionally minimal, but built with the idea of growing over time — with new content, deeper historical layers, and new places to explore. If you decide to take this short journey, thank you. We hope it leaves you with something — and maybe, in time, it can become something more.
row.short_description: 'Project Cottontails' is an interactive narrative adventure in the Manduria Civic Museum. Step into the shoes of Alessio, explore the museum, interact with characters and objects to piece together the story of your ancestor, a famous Allied aviator in World War II.

row.name: Mana Cycle
row.detailed_description: Introducing Mana Cycle, the ultimate puzzle party game experience! Dive into a digital world of strategic block-dropping madness where strategy and reflexes collide. Mana Cycle offers a fresh twist on the classic falling block puzzle genre, combining elements of Tetris and Puyo-Puyo with its own unique mechanics. This game introduces the 'Cycle' mechanic, presenting players with an order that the pieces must be cleared ('spellcasted') in. Strategize your moves carefully as you clear pieces according to the ever-rotating cycle in the center of the screen. Features 7 playable characters, each with unique abilities. Settle into a variety of engaging game modes: - Story Mode , where you embark on a journey through puzzle-filled landscapes. -Challenge your limits in the Endless gamemode, dropping pieces for as long as you can. -Test your skills in the Arcade mode against a continuous onslaught of opponents. -Brave the unpredictable depths of the roguelite-inspired Gauntlet gamemode. -Hone your PvP skills against challenging AI opponents in local Player vs. CPU versus matches. -Challenge your friends in local multiplayer, either via the same keyboard or via controllers. Prepare for the ultimate puzzle showdown with Mana Cycle. Are you ready to master the art of the cycle?
row.short_description: Mana Cycle is a fast-paced puzzle party game with a unique twist on falling block mechanics, featuring strategic cycle-based piece-clearing. Compete with friends locally in thrilling multiplayer matches!

row.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch Playtest
The Time Game
row.detailed_description: The Time Game is a complex strategy card-game where you can bend the rules of time to outsmart your opponents!  Play solo or online with friends! If you love Magic: The Gathering, or complex card games with card stacking mechanics, this is for you. Join our weekly multiplayer events on Discord. Background Play cards each turn, trying to survive deadly weapons and bombs. Cards stack up creating a complex chain of events, requiring you to predict future outcomes. Certain spaces on the board can give advantages while others will send you on an impromptu space-walk. Time is bent and logical strategy is created in the moment depending on the game state. The depth is seen in the course of rounds you survive in, resulting in a fight over abundant parts of the map while avoiding dangerous locations. Features Multiplayer, 2-4 Players. Singleplayer puzzles. Dynamic Board that changes each game. Plan out how the future will unfold by creating rifts in time and deploying time bombs as future explosives. Utilize futuristic technology such as time machines, rocketships, as well as cryogenic chambers. Collect Busted Cards From Spaces In Time, use them to tilt the scales in your favour.
row.short_description: The Time Game is a complex strategy card-game where you can bend the rules of time to outsmart your opponents! Play solo or online with friends!

row.name: Inline: Out of Time
row.detailed_description: 'Inline: Out of Time' is an adrenaline-fueled 2D platformer packed with high-speed deliveries, urban parkour, and rail-grinding. Join the ranks of the Inline Initiative as the newest recruit of the logistics company Parcel Dynamics. Immerse yourself in a thrilling race against the clock as you roller-skate through a retro-futuristic cityscape. Master every twist and turn as you optimize your delivery route with one goal in mind: SPEED. Experience fast-paced roller-skating action as you deliver packages through a variety of vibrant city environments. Embrace the challenge of mastering your routes by practicing maneuvers such as wall-jumps and long-distance package throws. Remember, speed is your #1 priority, so 'THIS SIDE UP' and 'FRAGILE' are just light suggestions! Enjoy our complimentary music player featuring a full soundtrack designed to enhance the relentlessly thrilling gameplay. Spanning genres including dance, techno, funk, and electronica, there is something for every speed demon. After completing your deliveries, feel free to pet any cats you find in the city. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Complete your delivery routes as fast as possible to appease your corporate overlord while still finding time to enjoy the sights of the retro-futuristic city and your banging tunes.

row.name: Number Factory
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Number Factory - where numbers are your business, and infinity is just the beginning. Manage a cutting-edge facility dedicated to one purpose: producing the biggest numbers in the universe. Start small, automate everything, and watch your production soar to unimaginable heights. 🏭 Core Gameplay Pure Idle Progression - Your factory never stops working. Generators automatically produce numbers every second, even while you're away. Return to massive offline earnings and keep pushing toward the next milestone. Strategic Upgrades - Invest your numbers wisely in generators and multipliers. Each purchase compounds your growth, creating satisfying exponential progression that rewards smart planning. Prestige System - Hit your limit? Reset everything for powerful Prestige Points and Formula Energy. Unlock permanent bonuses that make each run faster and more rewarding than the last. ✨ Key Features 🌳 Extensive Prestige Tree Unlock dozens of powerful permanent upgrades across a sprawling prestige tree. Each node opens new strategies and multiplies your potential. Will you focus on raw production, prestige point gain, or unlock game-changing mechanics? 🎯 Challenge System Test your skills with special challenge modes that restrict your abilities for massive rewards. Complete challenges to unlock unique bonuses and prove your mastery. 🏆 Achievement Hunter's Paradise Track your progress with comprehensive achievements. From your first million to your billionth prestige, every milestone is celebrated with rewards and bragging rights. 💎 Crystal Economy Earn premium Crystals through gameplay and compete for monthly rankings. Spend them on powerful production multipliers or quality-of-life upgrades in the shop. 📊 Global Leaderboards Compete with players worldwide across multiple categories: - Highest Numbers - Who can reach the biggest number? - Most Prestiges - Speed and optimization mastery - Total Purchases - Complete dedication to the factory Monthly seasons keep competition fresh and give everyone a chance to climb the ranks. 🎮 Skills & Specialization Unlock and upgrade skills that define your playstyle. Boost production, increase prestige gains, or unlock powerful automation features. 📈 Deep Statistics Track everything from total playtime to production rates. Analyze your progress with detailed statistics and personal records. Every number tells a story. 🛒 Shop & Boosts Purchase permanent production multipliers, crystal packs, and supporter packs. All production boosts include bonus crystals and stack multiplicatively for exponential power. 🎨 Features ✅ Satisfying Number Growth - Watch numbers climb from single digits to values with dozens of zeros ✅ Beautiful UI - Clean, modern interface designed for clarity and ease of use ✅ Smart Notation - Automatic formatting from thousands (1.5K) to vigintillions (1.5Vg) and beyond ✅ Offline Progress - Keep earning even when you're not playing ✅ Regular Updates - New content, features, and improvements ✅ Achievement System - Hundreds of goals to complete ✅ Cloud Saves - Never lose your progress (Steam Cloud) ✅ No Forced Ads - Pure, uninterrupted gameplay experience 🚀 Perfect For - Fans of idle and incremental games - Players who love optimization and strategy - Achievement hunters and completionists - Anyone who enjoys watching numbers grow - Casual players looking for a relaxing experience - Hardcore players seeking deep meta-progression 📱 Gameplay Loop 1. Generate - Passive production creates numbers automatically 2. Upgrade - Purchase generators and multipliers to boost production 3. Prestige - Reset for permanent bonuses when growth slows 4. Unlock - Expand your prestige tree and unlock new mechanics 5. Compete - Climb global leaderboards and complete challenges 6. Repeat - Each cycle is faster and more rewarding than the last 🎯 From Zero to Infinity Start with a single generator producing 1 number per second. End with dozens of maxed generators producing numbers so large they require scientific notation just to display. The journey from humble beginnings to mathematical godhood is filled with satisfying milestones, strategic decisions, and exponential growth. Every second counts. Every upgrade matters. Every prestige makes you stronger. 🎮 Start Your Number Empire Today The factory awaits. How high can you go?
row.short_description: Build the ultimate number production empire! Automate generators, unlock powerful upgrades, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Compete on global leaderboards and watch your numbers grow to infinity in this addictive idle incremental game.

row.name: Cats, Guns & Robots Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST NOW! About the Game In this action rogue-like game, survive evil robot attacks, gain XP by killing them and upgrade your weapons and character for the next room. It's all about strategy, reflexes, and smart choices. Gain XP by killing evil robots and upgrade your character! Buy and upgrade your weapons and equipment! Exciting Action-Packed Roguelike Gameplay! Careful choice of weapons and character abilities will be the key to winning! THE STORY Humans and advanced robots have been living in peace and harmony for centuries. But everything was about to change with a group of powerful and evil robots declaring war on humanity. The evil robots, who began to think they no longer needed humans, gathered in the Net Building and produced mini robots to serve their wicked purposes. Then they launched a very devilish war on humanity at the most unexpected moment. The situation was awful… Only Paw Lab, the most advanced laboratory in the Catarsis universe, could stop them. Scientists of Paw Lab had been fearlessly trying to develop a new type of robot that could be their savior that could be controlled by mental power, but the tests had been failing and failing... The war was coming to an end and humanity was on the verge of extinction. Then something happened that no one expected! One night, the laboratory's cat, Nyx, while handling its catlike duties of eating, sleeping, and knocking things over , entered the pre-robot prototype. Those who came to the laboratory in the morning could not believe their eyes. Nyx was controlling the pre-robot that they had been testing for months but had failed to operate! Could the pre-robots prepared by the scientists, along with the cats, succeed in defeating the evil robots and their devilish army?
row.short_description: Step into an exciting journey in Cats Guns & Robots, a rogue-like action game where you are the last hope for the world. In this outlaw-like action game, surviving enemy attacks in each room will require careful choices of upgrading your character abilities and features of weapons in your inventory.

row.name: Timber Tales
row.detailed_description: Timbers Tales is about exploring a vast open world full of various tree's, biomes, and wonderful people to meet. As you explore you complete puzzles, challenges and quests to unlock blueprints to upgrade your plot along with your sawmill, aside with unlocked new axes that can chop greater woods! Timber Tales is really about vast open world exploration and getting play in a peace full environment while you do so.
row.short_description: Explore, upgrade and chop away!

row.name: BACKROOMS NO RETURN: Prologue
row.detailed_description: SEE FULL VERSION About the Game Explore and face the dangers of the poolrooms in an immersive cooperative horror game. You play as a scientist whose mission is to explore the depths of the poolrooms for research purposes. You will soon realise that you have made a mistake and that there is no way out. Through escaping from various creatures you will have to find a way out of there. - Singleplayer & Co-op Multiplayer - Proximity Voice Chat - Host and join lobbies Play as a scientist whose goal is to explore the poolrooms. Finding a way back to reality will be your main goal. As part of their ongoing research into human consciousness, the Neuro-Bio-Psychology Laboratory (NBP) has developed a revolutionary new machine. That teleports you into another dimesion called Backrooms. It is up to you how long you stay there... With this technology, they can explore these dimensions in search for answers to this misterious dimension. This game is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and we have focused on getting the best graphics possible to give you more immersion. To make the levels more entertaining, you will have to complete a series of puzzles in order to continue. There are many different types of puzzles you will have to complete to continue your journe. The solution is not always obvious, but if you follow the trail of clues, then it should become clear what needs to happen next.
row.short_description: Explore the poolrooms in a inmersive cooperative horror game. Immerse yourself in the story of scientists who are exploring the depths of the poolrooms and end up encountering various obstacles in order to find a way back to reality.

row.name: OxRox
row.detailed_description: Welcome to OxRox, the modern remake of the 2001 classic RoX by Safrosoft, a beloved boulder dash clone that captivated players with its darker tone, engaging gameplay and challenging puzzles. OxRox reimagines this timeless experience for today's audience, blending the essence of the original with modern user experience, Steam integration and a contemporary touch. A Classic Reborn: At its core, OxRox remains true to the spirit of RoX, offering a casual experience filled with intricate puzzles, avoiding obstacles, outwitting enemies and strategizing against cascading boulders. Our goal was not to simply replicate, but to re-envision, crafting a game that feels both nostalgic and new. What Makes OxRox Stand Out? Modern Graphics and Sound: Beautifully updated visuals that bring the classic gameplay to life, accompanied by a captivating soundtrack that enhances the immersive experience. Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: The gameplay now behaves completely deterministic. We also introduced new mechanics and gameplay elements, offering a fresh challenge to both veterans of the original and newcomers alike. Expansive Levels and Challenges: Discover a wide array of new levels, each designed to present a unique challenge that tests your wits and reflexes. From easy beginnings to hour-long puzzles, OxRox delivers a rich variety of experiences. Leaderboards and Cloud-Saved Progression: Compete with players worldwide through leaderboards for each level and enjoy the convenience of cloud-saved level progression, ensuring your achievements and progress are preserved across devices. Custom Creations and Community: With a powerful, user-friendly level editor, unleash your creativity by designing your own challenges and sharing them with the community via Steam Workshop. A Tribute and a Step Forward OxRox is a tribute to the legacy of RoX, reimagined with care, creativity, and modern innovation. Whether you're a long-time fan eager to relive the classic or a newcomer curious to experience it for the first time, OxRox offers an adventure that is both familiar and fresh.
row.short_description: Revive the boulder dash spirit with OxRox, a modern remake of the 2001 classic RoX with updated graphics, improved UI, controller support and Steam integration. Tackle new puzzles, compete on leaderboards, and explore bonus levels in this nostalgic yet fresh adventure.

row.name: Puppet: Hide And Seek
row.detailed_description: Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer. THE GAME: Hide And Seek - is a multiplayer horror game in (7 vs 1) mode, where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer, and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape the killer. CAN YOU BE SAVED?? Multi-user features Take advantage of our in-game positional voice chat. Invite friends or find other players using the server browser. Hide and Seek Hide in closets, walls, bushes, houses, but remember the main thing is your life is at stake. Co-op Team up or hide alone to survive. Ship Live the allotted time and sail away into the sunset from this cursed island Play like everyone else or start stand out In the game you can choose a character to your taste. The goal of the Survivors in each game is to try not to get caught by the Killer and escape from the scene of the murders - it sounds easier than it really is.
row.short_description: Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer.

row.name: Hangul Shooter
row.detailed_description: An alternate way for gamers to learn Korean and Japanese. Shooting the enemies or playing the minigames—choose your fun starting point to learn a new language with anime aesthetic!    Here are the features:   1. The Less Boring Way  Learn the Korean alphabet (Hangul) and other alphabets in a fun gaming context. Quizzes and rote memorization aren’t for everyone because they encourage procrastination and eventually dropping out. So Hangul Shooter offers an alternative way that encourages you to learn because you used to , not because you need to.  2. Core Mechanics  Shoot the enemies with the correct bombs or sometimes avoid them. Use skills, master a class’s playstyle , or try the Practice Mode to clear all levels more easily!  Each level has four phases. The first two phases accustom you to the new letters, and the last two give you the “adrenaline boost”. The Rush Phase makes you think faster and turn your body left and right, and the Boss Phase tests your endurance. But still, you can skip these last two phases if they are too difficult!  Harder difficulty is also available for non-casual gamers and streamers who want to bang the table~.  3. Buy One, Get Two: The Minigames  Do you still like quiz-like games to learn a new language? The minigames offer classic experiences and even more alternative ways. You can also make a request if you want a specific minigame.  4. The Alphabets and Beyond (BETA)  There is a minigame to learn common vocabulary in Hangul Shooter. A way to learn essential grammar (for traveling) is also under development. But these features are experimental.  The goal is to learn the essentials to save time and learn relatively faster!    The catch:  At the current version, Hangul Shooter doesn't include a pronunciation feature. Therefore, it's good if you just want a quick start. And so, you can recognize the letters in manhwa/manga soon enough.
row.short_description: An alternate way for gamers to learn Korean. Shooting the enemies or playing the minigames—choose your fun starting point to learn a new language with anime aesthetic!
row.notes: The violence and sexual content are limited to what you get from a manhwa/manga for teens. For example, one character sounds sus and says, "Aa...", but no sexual activity or whatsoever, lol.

row.name: LightGone
row.detailed_description: Step into the darkness with Ashley, a college dropout lost in a mysterious world devoid of light. Traverse eerie liminal locales and evade lurking monsters to unravel the mysteries of this chilling 2D game with horror elements. Can you lead Ashley to safety, or will the shadows consume her before she can leave this dark world? This Game Features: Story-driven gameplay in a dark and empty world. Solve puzzles to progress to try to find someone to help you get back home. Avoid monsters in the dark and navigate through familiar, yet unfamiliar locations. Impressive shaders and lighting effects for an enriching atmosphere. Original pixel art that visually enhances and adds charm to the experience.
row.short_description: Step into the darkness with Ashley, a college dropout lost in a mysterious world devoid of light. Traverse eerie liminal locales and evade lurking monsters to unravel the mysteries of this chilling 2D game with horror elements. Can you lead Ashley to safety, or will the shadows consume her?

row.name: Astral Disorder
row.detailed_description: In Astral Disorder, you are the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station. The facility has become mostly automated, decreasing the need for human workers. As the last remaining utility expert, your state-of-the-art equipment and tools used for navigation and repairs are strewn about the chaotic facility. After a devastating crash causing the station to start running on backup power, a monstrous entity unleashed by the crash starts its relentless pursuit. Your mission is clear: find a means of escape before this horrible beast overtakes you. This is a first-person game where the player will be avoiding a monster by using a variety of mobility abilities and intelligent tactics to get to places where it cannot reach. The player will explore the station looking for items or new abilities to help them reach their goal, an escape pod to escape from the creature. With the station in backup power, traditional methods of navigating the station are unavailable and the player must find access cards, vents, or reroute the backup power to doors to facilitate their escape. Features Relentless Pursuit: A beast relentlessly tracking your every move forces you to keep on the move and utilize all your tools and cunning to keep ahead of it. Dynamic Navigation: Navigate the varied environments within the space station with a variety of navigation methods to evade the monster including sliding, grappling, and wall-running. Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve complex puzzles and obstacles by thinking quickly and strategically to reach new equipment and paths, all while ensuring the monster can't catch up. Destructible Environment: A destructible environment to open up new avenues of escape, but beware as new paths for you mean new paths for the monster to corner you.
row.short_description: As the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station, navigate the chaos unleashed by a catastrophic crash and evade a relentless beast. Armed with scattered tools and state-of-the-art equipment, outsmart your pursuer and secure passage to safety aboard a distant escape pod.

row.name: Limb From Limb
row.detailed_description: The Raymond Mitchell Association Welcomes You Limb From Limb is a card roulette game about surviving encounters against a monster with your fingers as a sacrifice for losing. Between encounters, navigate your way across a board of randomized events that forces you to consider what path you take out of this accursed experiment. Fighting Patient Zero Engage with a patient in a lethal card game of chance. Draw from a deck of 52 cards, some of which will cost you a finger to proceed. Collect Items Gather from a pool of 10 different items, each with its own personality and effect. Choose which items you want to take into the encounters, but be meticulous, as once-used items are gone forever. Escape Traverse through the hospital using a game board and your innate strategy to succeed in the RMA program. Each attempt brings a series of mixed events to define a new experience for every patient. Content Warning This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.
row.short_description: The Raymond Mitchell Association personally invites you to join our new limb regrowth program. Engage in a game of chance against another patient, risking the loss of your fingers. We have provided items to aid in your success waiting to be uncovered as you traverse the game board.

row.name: Ghost Hospital -in Thousand Horror Hill-
row.detailed_description: The main character walks around a hospital in a magical world to search for his friend who disappeared into another world. The game is a exploration adventure in which the main character roams around a hospital in a magical world in search of a friend who has disappeared into another world. The Genre Is Based On A Comical Atmosphere, A bit of horror awaits as you progress deeper into the story. How many friends will be saved is up to you[/u]. Estimated Play Time. 5 to 10 Hours For A Sweet Exploration　 15 Hours to Xx Hours to Complete All Endings. You can check the volume of the background music and play a test movie from 'Game Test' at the bottom of the menu. Please use this function before playing the game. row.short_description: It is a exploration adventure in which the protagonist roams around a magical hospital in search of a friend who has disappeared into another world. The genre is based on a comical atmosphere, with a bit of horror awaiting as you progress deeper into the story.

row.name: Fallopian Frenzy! Come Again?
row.detailed_description: An endless swimmer that life itself depends upon! Developers Note: Hi, This game ain't great. I know it, you know it. BUT if you manage to get a score above 4200 the game will reward you with a FREE Steam key*. I'm just happy I will no longer have to awkwardly try and explain to people the first game I made many years ago, they can just experience it themselves. -adamvision Simply swim up and down on your way to victory. See how far you can go before being eliminated by popular methods of birth control. FEATURES: ✔ FREE TO PLAY ✔ Simple one button / touch controls ✔ 13 ridiculous sperm ✔ 5 Power ups ✔ Avoid the effective birth control, such as the pill, condoms, and more. ✔ Includes Educational Factoids Additional Credits: Brianna Flynn - Additional Art Song: 'Monkeys Spinning Monkeys' - Kevin MacLeod * While keys last / Limit one per steam ID. Giveaways subject to being stopped any time.
row.short_description: Ten years ago (2014) I made my first game. This is that game. Mostly intact. I'm sorry.
row.notes: This game is an endless runner where you play as an unrealistic and cartoonish depiction of a sperm avoiding various birth control methods inside the fallopian tubes. At the end of each run there is a box showing a random variety of researched factoids about sex and related education, things like "Contraception does not encourage promiscuity" and "The HPV vaccine isn't just for women".

row.name: 孤独之旅 Lonely journey
row.detailed_description: This is a 2d side-scrolling game similar to (Ori and the Blind Forest) and (Hollow Knight), embark on an adventure in this fantasy land, collect key items, buy powerful equipment, gather pets to fight together, 100+ elves will participate in the battle, and 30+ costumes to help in the battle In the second half of '19, I quit my job as an indie game developer. Since graduation, I have used JS, JAVA, RUBY, etc., W7, W8, W10, Linux, etc. for PC, Apple, Android, and even Windows Phone for mobile phones, and Eclipse, VS, VSCode for coding, etc. I once heard that 'Zelda is the first in the world', the most played is LOL, I have bought a switch, most of the well-rated games in the steam warehouse are not developed by Chinese, and most of the national games have been scolded very badly, and the krypton is serious. At that time, I was thinking about why we couldn't develop our own programming language and be at the forefront of the world, why most games only wanted to change kryptonite and were scolded for being garbage, why we didn't have our own operating system. It happened that the Taiwu picture scroll came out before, and it received a lot of praise, and I realized that it was not that it could not be done, but that no one could do it, and as long as I worked hard to do it, I would definitely be able to do it. So, I decided to quit my job and develop games on my own, and as a game enthusiast and programmer, I felt that I could make a game. After resigning,Learn Unity and C# from 0,Start making games,4 years have passed in a flash.,In these 4 years, except for their own personal affairs.,A total of 2 years of time spent in the game.,In March 2024,Forced to helplessly,In the case of immaturity, the game will be launched directly.。 > was born, it was my debut novel, and its name was like this development experience, and when the game went live, I knew that my mission was accomplished, and I died without regrets. I have never regretted my choice, like a martyr, even though he is still alive.

row.name: 深渊与地下城

The story takes place in the distant and mysterious Dancing Blade Continent. Due to the invasion of evil external forces, the entire continent is fragmented. row.name: King of Hell
row.detailed_description: Lobby Select: Choose from 6 unique animal characters, to save them from hell and secure them a spot in heaven. Movement: Jump & use your staff to reach greater heights! Combat: Charge your staff to knock your opponents further away! Items: Use Mystery Boxes to get 1 out of 10 unique random Items to secure an advantage in movement, fights and climbing! Press G to get info and tips how to use collected items.
row.short_description: King of Hell is a 6-player, online, Arcade Party Game. You play against your friends in a arena filled with random Items and Jump'n Run obstacles. Try to knock your opponents into the lava to stash points and then climb up to the top platform, to score your points and become King of Hell!

row.name: Project: Ternion
row.detailed_description: Ternion is a fast paced 3v3 First Person Shooter where the objective is to eliminate the other team. Choose between 3 unique characters designed to fit different play styles. If you like shooting and having precise aim then pick Brawn who specializes in advanced recoil control. If you have good mechanics and can move around the map with ease then Brisk is the perfect pick for you. If you like outplaying your opponents by reading their next move choose Brain with the ability to see through the walls aswell as having remote explosives at your disposal you're sure to come out on top.
row.short_description: Ternion is the perfect game for anyone looking for a fast paced hero shooter where all heroes are tailored to unique play styles.

row.name: Urban Nightmare
row.detailed_description: This is an indie-student made found footage style game where you are a Free-Running, parkour expert who finds themselves lost in a city. Upon trying to find your way out, you find very disturbing body horror around different corners. By using your knowledge of free running, you hope that you can escape from this urban nightmare. How fast can you make it out of each level? Magitech Requiem
row.detailed_description: Magitech Requiem is a modern evolution of classic arcade shooters. Build your character through leveling, perks, and Magitech. row.name: Cross
row.detailed_description: THIS IS THE FINAL VERSION OF 'Troy: The Soldier', the original is available for free on my Itch page under RedWingedHero! CROSS is a soft-reboot of the series of games made centered around immortality and time loops.  In this remade version you can experience unique dialogues for each boss you die against with every death being canon to the game's story, improved upon scaling and stat distribution as well as better drawn enemy sprites, the removal of all that edgy story stuff I made when I was still a teenager (now it's more-or-less kid friendly), better writing by far, better music by a very large amount, and more active battle animations.  Similar to the original, Cross follows Michael and his old allies from the original, as well as the allies from the second game all merged into one. The idea of purchasable skills like in the original, now are done better and more easy to interact with. The items have stayed very similar to the original, instead now being compressed to few. The story is not at all like the original, but many references are made. This acts as a complete world reset since the final game, 'Troy: The Iron Angel', and now acts as the first world since The Reset.  The goal is the same, find the king of the Oddities and save the world... Except now you have two choices. Two major choices. Would you kill Ron, the very first boss ever encountered in my series of games, or would you let him live? Would you back out like you could back then? I never understood why I felt the need to let the player skip Ron in the original, but now doing so changes the game entirely.  Killing Ron gives you one half of the game with all the different locations it has, the party members it gives, and the skills you obtain. Letting him leave gives you the other half. But all realities exist as one in the end.  The only thing staying the same since the original, is my love for the characters and for the content of the game.  So if you would please give me another chance to get this right, it would make me very happy. Thank you to all the people who gave feedback since the release of the original game. <3
row.short_description: CROSS is a turn based RPG game with upgrade mechanics, a passionate soundtrack, and art made with love in mind. This is a remake/soft-reboot of 'Troy: The Soldier'.

row.name: No Bugs On My Windshield

row.name: Syuukun in Mirror World

row.name: Stellarcraft The Prologue
row.detailed_description: This is a DEMO version of Stellarcraft . The full Early Access version is available on a separate Steam page. Stellarcraft is a sci-fi tower defense game in which you explore different planets, collect resources and complete missions. Build and upgrade defenses to fend off enemy waves and develop your character. Strategic planning and technological upgrades are the key to success. Gather resources such as minerals, energy and rare metals. Resources are crucial for building and upgrading defenses. Certain planets have special resources that are needed to produce advanced technology. Complete missions ranging from defending your base to exploring new territories. Place your defenses strategically to maximize efficiency and conserve resources. Improve your character by using collected resources and rewards. row.name: POE
row.detailed_description: POE Is a short, but difficult retro platformer that forces the player to control the paths of 2 separate stories. An interesting mix of top-down storytelling and enraging platforming causes a challenging, yet story-rich experience for the player. In POE , You assume the role of a young baby named Poe. Poe wakes up one morning to discover that his father, Bernard, is taking him shopping. An unexpected interruption causes Poe to be left alone, so he makes the decision to just meet his father at the store. On Poe's journey to the store, he is stopped by an employee who leads him to the back while Poe awaits his father. Poe falls down a hole when left alone and is helped by a mysterious stranger. As Bernard searches around the house for Poe, his attempts to find him are ineffective. Bernard proceeds to expand his search. Both Bernard and Poe go through countless obstacles in an attempt to find each other. Even when all the odds are against them, they must remain determined and vigilant. In this short, but difficult retro platformer, you must optimize the use of both Bernard and Poe in order to reunite the father and his son.
row.short_description: In this fast-paced difficult platformer, you assume the role of Bernard and his son Poe in an attempt to find each other. Enjoy the short, but sweet story of their paths to each other that are filled with friends, enemies and other obstacles.

row.name: プリンセス×オーディエンス
row.detailed_description: ストーリー 1年中雪の降り続ける国、ホウミト。 あなたはホウミトの王女ゆきに取材しに行きます。 しかし………… この国の王女はとても サディスティック！ あなたは取材の質問をするどころか逆に彼女に質問責めされてしまいます。 はたしてあなたは無事取材を成功させて帰れるのでしょうか？ ゲームシステム 質問の回答によってはなんと速攻でエンディングに！？ エンディング数は 10通り ！ そしてなんと すべて描きおろしスチル つき！ クリアを優先する？ それとも全てのおしおきをあえてみにいってみる…？

row.name: Annoy This Guy

Key Features: - Talk to this guy WHO does NOT WANT TO BE BOTHERED. - Multiple Dialog Choices (~250 of them). - A Secret ((Final)) Ending!! - Funny. He hopes you enjoy this game🤪 His other game, Moving Jigsaw Puzzles is available on Steam and is also very fun.

row.name: Say
row.detailed_description: Say what's on your mind! Freely create memories or dreams in this narrative sandbox. Build sceneries that become the canvas to write your story onto, whatever you wish to share with other players: from fragmented thoughts to whole novels, just build and speak your mind. Create what you wish or explore what others have made, wander through and read their stories. Say is about sharing and communicating, about expressing who you were, are, or wish to be. Say cares! Say is a game that cares about how you feel, what you want to tell, what you've been through, what your wishes are. Players in Say share these with others in the firm believe that it is in sharing our thoughts and feelings that we can connect with them and others. No person is a monad - it is in the eyes of others that we exist. Say knows that. Join the community! Say lets you create atmospheric dioramas that reflect a memory, a mood, a dream. With the help of you, of the commuity, Say will become an endless vault of stories, fragments thoughts and prayers. Say invites you to join in and build a tribe of creative minds, builders, writers, and everyone who longs to share themselves. Be part of the Say Community and speak your mind.
row.short_description: A game about expression. Build a world, tell your story as you write thoughts into the world you've created and set the atmosphere to fit your mood. Build, write, share and explore. Come be part of the Say Community, and speak your mind!
row.notes: While there is no mature content in the base game, Say is a platform where users share the narrative worlds they are building with other users. While we strive to make the experience suitable for people age 15 and above, it is possible for a player to stumble upon inappropriate user-generated content that has not yet been flagged. We appreciate your help in keeping the platform in accordance with our community guidelines by reporting any violations you might encounter.

row.name: Destroy Them !
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Destroy Them - the ultimate action arcade FPS in which your mission is to destroy all robots on five different maps : On each map, you'll find yourself surrounded by robots, but fortunately: you are armed with an assault rifle, a machine gun and you can move with advanced movements (Double Jump and Dash), so you will be able to escape enemies with skill and ease! row.short_description: In Destroy Them, you have to destroy all the robots on 5 differents maps using advanced movements to earn points and beat your high score !
