row.name: Primal Chronicles
row.detailed_description: Primal chronicles is a prehistoric tribe management roguelike. In real-time, you have to order your tribes men to gather, hunt and craft. Every game is a unique journey across multiple lands filled with spirits, minor gods and wild beasts. You will either lead your tribe to salvation or doom them all. If you are fan of Stacklands or the boardgame Paleo, be sure to check Primal chronicles. Task your tribes men to either gather, hunt or craft tools. Choose wisely to ensure your survival. Every land has its own resources but each territory is more demanding than the previous one. In Primal Chronicles, lands are full of wild spirits and mysterious divine creatures, some will either provide you boons to craft new ideas. Features Random journey, always changing 10+ Biomes with each their own cards 10+ technologies 1-2 Hours of game play No AI was used Words from the developer I am a solo dev that wanted to create a simple game. Thanks for playing it.
row.short_description: Primal chronicles is a prehistoric tribe management roguelike. In real-time, you have to order your tribes men to gather, hunt and craft. Every game is a unique journey across multiple lands filled with spirits. You will either lead your tribe to salvation or doom them all.

row.name: Wind Rider
row.detailed_description: ‎‎ 'Wind Rider' is an engaging gliding game that combines simplicity with endless fun. Players navigate through a dynamic, endless map filled with randomly generated obstacles, offering a fresh experience with every play. Perfect for quick entertainment or leisurely play, the goal is to outmaneuver challenges and achieve new high scores. With its easy-to-learn mechanics, 'Wind Rider' is an ideal game for anyone looking to enjoy a relaxing yet thrilling gaming session. Zohal is a passionate but small team of three people, and Wind Rider is our first official game, with two larger games in the making. Wind Rider is not a game with a ton of content. But we hope that it will help you fill your free time with fun and relaxing gaming sessions at an affordable price. Don't hesitate to reach out with any feedback, inquiries, or issues regarding the game. We're here to assist and will respond promptly. Additionally, we'd love to hear if you had a great experience with the game – it truly brightens our day!!
row.short_description: Wind Rider is simple, relaxing gliding game with an endless map and Randomly generated Obstacles. A great game to fill your free time and beat your latest highest score!

row.name: Hoping this Finds You Well
row.detailed_description: An experiment in letter writing, meant to evoke the distinctly sweet homoeroticism of Victorian and Edwardian literature. Follow the correspondence of two professors, in the months before one of them makes a decision he'll never be able to take back. A visual novel with a cute mechanic: Slide the letters back and forth across the screen, to experience the time the letter is written, and when it is read! About 10,000 words in length, A fantasy setting with pirates and demons, A gentle, clean romance with two scientists, one of them arguably quite mad!
row.short_description: An experiment in letter writing, meant to evoke the distinctly sweet homoeroticism of Victorian and Edwardian literature. Follow the correspondence of two professors, in the months before one of them makes a decision he'll never be able to take back.

row.name: Seaburn
row.detailed_description: You are a politician determined to save our dying planet. Time is slipping away, as endless political debates and ineffective policies continue to suffocate the Earth under the weight of pollution. You must take action before the damage becomes irreversible. The future of humanity rests on your shoulders, and every decision you make carries immense consequences. In Seaburn, you play as a policymaker whose choices shape the fate of the planet and your political career. Your actions influence both public opinion and the world’s health, forcing you to constantly decide what to prioritise. However, if the world’s health collapses, your journey ends. If your public opinion plummets, you'll be ousted from office. LEGISLATION The papers on your desk allow you to sign legislation. Each piece of legislation presents its own set of potential outcomes, requiring you to carefully weigh the pros and cons. You can sign three bills per week, with every choice impacting your popularity, world health, and political budget—either for better or worse. EVENTS The corkboard on the wall allows you to attend events. Each event presents four distinct options, all of which can affect public opinion and world health in different ways. Events appear every few weeks and affect public opinion and world health drastically, so choose your responses wisely. ELECTIONS Every eight weeks, prepare for an election that could determine your political future. Your chances of staying in office are tied directly to your public opinion, so be mindful of how you govern as the next election draws closer. Discover more about your office throughout the journey, and reach the 52nd week to solidify your place as a successful politician.
row.short_description: Seaburn is a choice-based political simulator where your choices affect the future of the planet. Play as a policymaker as you sign legislation, respond to events, and compete in high-stakes elections. Earn money, become popular, and save the environment.

row.name: Bull-Bia Ricky
row.detailed_description: This is a small platformer that tells us a short story about a simple guy Ricky Bullbia, who, despite the difficulties encountered along the way, achieved his goal. The story in a light and cheerful manner teaches us not to give up, because in the end, for our efforts, we will get what rightfully belongs to us. Having been defeated in the ring, our hero Ricky Bull-Bia finds himself in an unfamiliar place... With only perseverance, courage and years of training behind his back, he is determined to come back and win, heading back to the ring. Help Ricky complete his plans! You will encounter obstacles and enemies on the way. Some of them need to be dodged, others need to be jumped over. With the third, you need to fight or just pass by with a straight face. The coach will always help you with his wise advice. And also beloved Ricky will offer you to complete bonus levels in which your head can explode, literally. And, in case of victory, the beloved will reward you. It's up to you to pass or skip the bonus levels. But remember that a true winner does not back down in the face of difficulties. Having managed to get out of all the difficulties in the story, you will get to the ring again. And now you have no choice but to defeat the boss. After completing the game, you will have the opportunity to complete a small additional level for another character from the game. After completing this level, you will find out how the journey of the Hero of the game Bull-Bia Ricky ended.
row.short_description: This is a small single-player platformer. Created by one person in a cartoon style, it tells us a short story about a simple guy who, despite the difficulties encountered along the way, achieves his goal.

row.name: Beyond
row.detailed_description: Survey the solar system to maximize development and discover where your foes have already established operations. Build structures, manufacture ships, and develop technologies to surpass enemy factions in your expansion through the solar system. Utilize captured enemy structures to turn the tables against them in combat and resource acquisition. Drive opposing factions from the solar system until only the most dominant remains. Hailing from the temperate biomes of Gaia, the bipedal community-oriented hominids focus their collective effort on incremental gains across the spectrum, starting weaker and ending stronger than the average species. Rising from the ashes of their creators’ self-destruction, Botica are a mechanical species that specializes in efficiency of resources and optimization of technology. Not content with the exo-political powers that be, the Sistren expand their reach on the promise of future riches for all who join their ranks… No matter what tactics it takes to gain them. Arising from their Foundress, Manta are insectoids that grow everything they need to expand their domain. The very exoskeletons in which they reside are living entities. Embryophytics that rose to sentience on a lush world, but were forced to set off into the cosmos when their planet’s atmosphere was eviscerated by relentless solar flares. Biological adaptation to the harshest environments has allowed them to travel far and wide in search of a new home. At the end of every round, all celestial bodies orbit around the sun, moving at different speeds and shuffling the positions of ships, structures, and resources. Ships can enter or leave orbit, giving them tactical advantage in positioning for future combat. Discover who is out there, and if someone else has already set up operations where you planned to. Visibility is gained and lost as ships maneuver and structures orbit, meaning the tactical landscape can change when you’re not looking. Compete with opposing factions to gather resources, while managing the upkeep of your force to maintain combat prowess. Capture structures of different species and, in some cases, use their own technology against them. Use the actions of ships and structures to advance up your species’ unique technology tree, unlocking more powerful means to conqueror your foes. If you so desire, dive into the unique stats of every ship and structure to figure out which are best suited to maximize the destruction of your enemies. Like to run the numbers? See how you are doing compared to previous games and weigh just how effective your strategies are. Danger, Will Robinson!
row.short_description: Beyond is a sci-fi turn-based strategy game set in a generated solar system that orbits a distant star every round. Play as one of five alien species as you race to collect resources, build your military, develop new tech, expand the area you control, and drive opposing factions from the system.

row.name: Impractical Spells
row.detailed_description: Impractical Spells is a very 'balanced' and practical game designed to create the most ridiculous couch gaming experiences possible! Play solo, or with up to three other players in couch multiplayer. Choose your character from our lineup of wacky wizards, and do battle in a top down 2D arena! Each wizard has their own unique play style. The last wizard standing each round will be the winner. At the end of each round, you will pick cards which make you stronger... mostly. By the end of the game, the walls of the arena might not be enough to contain your power! The first to eight victories wins. But be warned, the headmaster of our magical university might catch wind of your brawling... Which of you can become the most impractical? Best played with a controller!
row.short_description: The rules of the game are simple. Pick cards to get stronger. Be the last wizard standing to win, Win 8 rounds to win the game.

row.name: Edgeless
row.detailed_description: A different kind of Jigsaw! The meta for jigsaws has been broken. No longer can you start with the edges and work your way in! You will need a new approach! Casual? Challenging? Approachable! By limiting the puzzle size to 63 pieces you get an experience that is not overwhelming while still offering a challenging jigsaw to engage your mind. Play, Learn & Enjoy! Complete puzzles to learn about the subject. For example: Complete a puzzle with elephant and then learn about elephants! Earn Achievements! Achieve 3 star ratings by completing jigsaws quickly and unlock steam achievements to show everyone your talents!
row.short_description: Start with the edge pieces? No way! Try this challenging, yet approachable, 63 piece jigsaw game that has no edge pieces! 50 jigsaws to complete or choose your own!

row.name: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface
row.detailed_description: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? is coming soon! About the Game Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface is a small free prequel to the game Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? . We hope you enjoy it! Well, well, it seems another traveler has wandered into my home. The night is deep outside the cabin and the rain is relentless. But don't worry, I have an idea to pass the time! You like games, don't you? I have a special one just for you! If you can pass it, a reward awaits you. Lose, and you'll have to stay with me a bit longer than you planned. Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface is a mix of horror and first-person puzzle. You find yourself trapped inside a cabin deep in the forest, and its owner suggests playing a computer game in exchange for freedom. But the cabin and the game are intertwined much more than you might think, and the price of losing is your life! Play the game within the game! A mix of horror and first-person puzzle-solving; An old cabin deep in the forest, hiding secrets.
row.short_description: This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: The Echo Escape
row.detailed_description: This game provides uncomfortable visual information and heavily relies on sound. Escape from [Them] based on limited information and achieve your goal! Key Points [They] are sensitive to sounds. Think of ways to escape and find your way out of the maze. [They] are sensitive to sounds, but there are others who are not... Achieve all the multiple endings through the story! Developer's Comment This game is a shoddy game developed by a solo developer. The story and direction may seem crude. Please play it just for fun. :)
row.short_description: Escape from the suspicious space by eluding [them].

row.name: Tamako
row.detailed_description: Build it. Play it. Share it. Tamako is a creative singleplayer or local co-op puzzle platformer where building the level is just as fun as playing it. Work together in local co-op to solve clever challenges—or design your own using the built-in level editor and share them on the Steam Workshop. Play through developer-made puzzles or dive into a growing library of community creations. Whether you're crafting devious traps or charming obstacle courses, Tamako gives you the tools to bring your ideas to life—no experience required. Key Features: Build Your Own Levels: An easy-to-use in-game editor lets you design puzzles and playtest them instantly. Creative Puzzle Platforming: Solve bite-sized challenges built around teamwork, timing, and experimentation. Local 2-Player Co-op: Designed for shared play, with intuitive controls and relaxed pacing that’s perfect for casual sessions. Steam Workshop Support: Publish your creations or browse community-made levels from around the world. Endless Replayability: With new levels just a click away, there’s always a new puzzle to solve—or a new idea to try. Tamako is the perfect pick-up-and-play platformer for puzzle lovers, creative minds, and players who love building as much as solving.
row.short_description: A single or local co-op puzzle platformer with a built-in level editor. Solve creative challenges together or build your own and share them on the Steam Workshop. Tamako is all about relaxed co-op play, clever puzzles, and endless player-made content.

row.name: Hero of Fate:Prologue
row.detailed_description: Thanks for following Hero of Fate and getting the latest game news. You can contact us by joining the community ( )! Hero of Fate is a cool and smooth 'rougue' game with 'survivor' as the core gameplay, on the basic of traditional 'survivor' gameplay, we added the multi careers partners and the great beast system to fight with you together. Each battles can carry up 4 teammates and a angel, so you can experience 5 times the fun of rougue in the game! At the same time, you can also play as different characters, experience a variety of different professional skills, build your own unique team of partners, and survive under the surrounded monsters, and you can also defeat powerful boss by discovering fate, get a variety of random angels to fight with you, and finally defeat the big boss! Free to choose the characters to fight in the game, experience 8 special skill elements (Thunder, Wind, Ice, Fire, Earth, Poison, Holy, Dark), free to mix and match combinations of many different attacking skills, each match has a different effect of the battle skills, every time each character you choose to enter the game is a brand new feeling, and you can see the rich in the elements of the Rogue, just enjoy the fun of smooth! There are more than a variety of angels with different styles and skills, waiting for you to discover! They can fight with you, add buff, and give you more functional play choices! In short, those angels are very strong! Awesome! They can fight! Resistant! Also can support! And the types of angels are also various and colorful, such as: 'Earl from Hell, Boneroma Who says Roguelite gameplay is all about farm? Random fate system in game hides lots of surprises you can’t image. Every choice is a new experience; Each choice represents a different ending; Every choice will let you feel the choice of fate! You can survive, or die, or sad, or happy, everything is chose by your own!
row.short_description: Hero of Fate is a smooth and fun 'rougue' game with 'survivor' as the core gameplay. You will receive various tasks or meet unexpected events under monsters surrounded, and you can also recruit partners or battle alone. In this fantasy world, go to experience a exciting and unpredictable adventure!
row.notes: Note: The game contains violence/beating, etc.

row.name: My Corp Cargo Simulator : Prologue
row.detailed_description: · You've built a cargo company from scratch. Your only chance is to be the only delivery driver in town. Everyone is eagerly awaiting you. Since you can't afford employees, you have to rush through every job yourself. · The people in this town don't even know you yet. Will you overcharge them, or will you be a good manager? · People have left you so many shipments that you've run out of space in your office, so you've bought a new shelf! If you're curious about more, download and play the game! It's free, after all!
row.short_description: Start and grow your own cargo company! Make fast and reliable deliveries to your customers on foot, bicycle, and motorcycle. Grow your business by making strategic decisions. Build your cargo empire in this simulation game that will make you feel like a real entrepreneur.

row.name: Anime Girl Puzzles
row.detailed_description: The anime girls are excited to see you! Solve jigsaw puzzles featuring girls from around the world, showing off their favorite outfits and poses just for you. It's been a long time since the girls have met a smart puzzle-solver. Will you be the one to impress them? Enjoy a selection of 24 anime puzzles, expandable to over 200 with DLC. With intuitive gameplay, Anime Girl Puzzles is accessible to both newcomers and puzzle enthusiasts. Play the game your way, with a wide variety of jigsaw puzzle sizes and modes. Enjoy a leisurely experience, or face a challenging test! Solve puzzles to earn Steam achievements and unlock hidden bonus images. So what are you waiting for? Come meet the girls!
row.short_description: The anime girls are waiting to solve puzzles with you! Enjoy a plentiful selection of anime jigsaw puzzles, with a wide variety of gameplay modes.

row.name: WANTED: Yokai Uprising
row.detailed_description: Wanted: Yokai Uprising is a cooperative first-person shooter. Take down waves of yokai solo or with a partner. Choose between two mercenaries with unique play styles to complete the mission assigned to you and defeat the city's most wanted boss. Advance through a cooperative campaign designed for two players, where teamwork is essential to fulfill client orders. However, you also have the option to be a solo player and explore the city's alleys on your own, challenging the dangers that await you. Shinsekai, once bustling with life, has fallen under the dominion of a Yokai organization. Now, the streets are filled with creatures and deadly traps. Dive in and save the citizens from corruption. Take control of Blair and Yen, two mercenaries whose destinies intertwine in the fight against the Yokai in Shinsekai. With different combat styles, these characters will guide you through the adventure and challenges. Blair is a former soldier who carries an energy grenade launcher at long distances with an alternate firing mode using electric ammunition. Yen is a gambling yakuza who never parts ways with his modified weapon: a shotgun barrel and a submachine gun to shred any living being within his close range. Battle against a total of 5 different enemies with unique abilities that will challenge your skills and strategies. From the Tengu to the Komainu, each encounter presents a different strategy that tests your courage and ability. Can you defeat the final boss?
row.short_description: Wanted: Yokai Uprising is a cooperative first-person shooter. Take down waves of yokai solo or with a partner. Choose between two mercenaries with unique play styles to complete the mission assigned to you and defeat the city's most wanted boss.

row.name: Spooky Mansion
row.detailed_description: In Spooky Mansion players step into the shoes of a skilled demonologist tasked with purging a malevolent presence from within a sprawling mansion. As darkness shrouds the halls and sinister forces lurk around every corner, players must navigate through a series of eerie rooms, solving puzzles, battling demons, and uncovering the secrets hidden within the mansion's walls.
row.short_description: The mansion stands as a cursed bastion of evil. As the demonologist delves deeper into the mansion's secrets, they uncover a sinister plot that threatens not only their own soul but the very fabric of reality itself.

row.name: Dream & Sugar
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Dream & Sugar, a wholesome visual novel exploring relationships, love, and the transition to adulthood. You are a recent art college graduate who dreams of becoming an independent artist with their very own art gallery installation. Reconnect with your college bestie Riley, hit it off with dashing musician Hugo, and befriend thoughtful author Bennett. You decide which relationships to pursue! Will you find love in unexpected places? Or maybe you'd like to take things slower and focus on Nora's art goals instead? The choice is up to you! Features Branching Dialogue! Dream & Sugar features branching dialogue purposefully written to let you create your own story. Each scene is individually written, with no two paths being exactly the same. You'll get to see the full dialogue of your choices before you choose, so the surprises will come from the twists and turns as you speak to your friends and lovers. Will you be brash? Funny? Empathetic? Or mix and match your responses unpredictably! Unique Endings! Find love or heartbreak as you navigate through a variety of social situations. Make choices about where to go for dates, who to flirt with, and how to respond to social encounters. Your choices can lead you to one of more than ten unique endings! Will you make friends or lovers? Will you focus on your relationships? Your career? Or yourself? Only you can decide! LGBTQ+ Friendly! Dream & Sugar is proud to offer an all-inclusive romance experience. During character creation, you can change your character's name, choose your physical gender presentation, and your pronouns (including non-binary!). Your character choices do not prevent you from pursuing any of the game's romantic options, and even include an option to play the game completely aromatically! Receive different dialogue reflecting your choices, without being prohibited from experiencing the full scope of the game! Interactive Art Minigame! Have a creative vision? During the story you'll be given the option to draw in our art minigame! These images can be saved to your computer to share with your friends and family. If illustration isn't your strong suit or you just really want to get back to the story, you won't be forced to look at blank canvases. Dream & Sugar does come with default images drawn by our staff and demo team for those who would prefer to move past the minigame. Human Made! CouchLionStudios did not use AI during the production of Dream & Sugar. We're proud to encourage our talented staff to show off what they can do!
row.short_description: Welcome to Dream & Sugar, a wholesome visual novel exploring relationships, love, and the transition to adulthood. Navigate relationships with unique dialogue and branching endings in this cozy LGBTQ+ friendly otome game!
row.reviews: “I think it’s safe to say that the Dream & Sugar demo has successfully captured my heart . . .” Sweet & Spicy Otome Game Reviews

row.name: A Blocc World
row.detailed_description: A Blocc World. The best kind of world. A world of discovery, adventure and smashing fun. Wander through peaceful fields, golden sands and towering trees, and dare to dream that you could be the hero this world needs. Stop dreaming. This world needs a hero. You'll need to train. Smash your way through the ugly beasts trying to ruin your peaceful paradise. Learn from your battles. Unlock new powers to smash even harder. Steal items and equipment from your vanquished foes. Don't worry about the ethical concerns of looting the deceased, it's all for the Quest. Don't stop to clean up after yourself, that will only slow you down. Focus! The Quest! You'll need help. Make friends on your travels. Help them with their troubles and they might just help you too. But don't get too friendly, they'll distract you from the Quest. You'll be tested. Some of the ugly beasts pack quite a punch. But they stand in the way of you and the Quest. You know what that means. You'll be Quested. The Quest is a quest that you need to quest. Quest.
row.short_description: A voxel-style open-world RPG. Use a variety of melee, ranged and magical combat abilities to smash your way to saving the world. Grow your strength, with powerful abilities and equipment. Learn about the world of Blocc from friendly characters, and try to keep them in one piece.

row.name: Bloons Card Storm
row.detailed_description: The Storm gathers, and only true Heroes can stem the Bloon tide. Gather up your cards, choose your favorite Hero, and enter the Arena to claim victory! From the makers of Bloons TD 6 comes a revolutionary collectible card game featuring the fan-favorite Monkeys and Bloons, rendered and animated in gorgeous 3D. Develop deep strategies, build your collection by crafting awesome cards, and carefully construct decks to help you win PvP and single player games. Featuring 4 unique Heroes with 3 Hero Abilities each, 120+ cards at launch, and 5 different Arenas to battle on, the tactical combinations are endless! BALANCE OFFENSE AND DEFENSE Monkeys can't attack other Monkeys, so you'll need to stock up on both Bloon AND Monkey cards in order to win. Send Bloons swarming at your opponent, fend off opposing Bloon rushes with your Monkeys, and find that perfect balance essential for victory! USE HERO ABILITIES WISELY Playing Bloons will power up Hero Abilities that can turn the tide of battle in your favor. Whether it is Quincy with his bow or Gwen with her flamethrower, each Hero has a unique set of potent Hero Abilities. Choose them wisely! TEST YOURSELF IN SOLO ADVENTURES Looking for something more relaxing than fur-flying PvP action? Our solo Adventures are crafted single-player experiences that will test your deck building and game management skills to the limit. Try out the Prologue Adventures or support the game by buying the full DLC Adventures. FULLY CROSS-PLATFORM Take your collection of Bloons and Monkeys with you wherever you go, as Bloons Card Storm is fully cross-platform - just register your account and your progress stays with you. BUILD THE BEST DECKS Build crazy combo behemoths, fun theme decks, or use the latest meta decklists - the choice is yours! PLAY AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS Private match support at launch so you can challenge your friends to a game anywhere, anytime! Matchmaking is also fully cross-platform so what are you waiting for? Download now and join the Card Storm!
row.short_description: Collectible card game set in the Bloons universe, featuring unique play mechanics, distinct hero abilities, PvP and PvE modes. Download now and join the Card Storm!

row.name: The Neurochemical Conjob
row.detailed_description: Eliminate your negative emotions (but save the good ones) as Agent B. Cell, in this intense and wacky arcade style shooter! Collect friendlies (or the good emotions!) to fill your LOVESCORE multiplier. They are essential to scoring EXTRA LIVES! Random weapon pickups can offer a slight edge over enemies. Intense wave-based gameplay, random every game/wave! Inspired by the arcade classic Robotron: 2084! Controls: Controller (Recommended/Intended gameplay) Left Joystick: Move Agent. B Cell Right Joystick: Move crosshair, Shoot/Fire A(Xbox)/X(PSX): Start Game Start: Quit Game Keyboard/Mouse WASD: Move Agent. B Cell Mouse: Moves crosshair Left Click: Shoot/Fire 1: Start Game Esc: Quit Game
row.short_description: Eliminate your negative emotions (but save the good ones!) as Agent B. Cell, in this intense and wacky arcade style shooter!

row.name: Kiwie vs Desert
row.detailed_description: Kiwie vs Desert is a cute front facing runner where you play as Kiwie the cat. After crashing his spaceship on a desert planet, Kiwie must search through the desert to find his communication device to call for help. Throw bombs to clear out anything in your path Equip shields to bust through obstacles Soar above the danger with your jetpack Navigate through 50 levels of increasing difficulty on your journey to get Kiwie home. Play in style by purchasing an outfit pack DLC bundle, or enjoy the game totally free. Do you have what it takes to make it to the finish line?
row.short_description: Kiwie vs Desert is a front facing arcade runner starring Kiwie the cat. Throw bombs, equip shields, jetpack over obstacles, and dodge enemies as you navigate through 50 levels of increasing difficulty on your quest to get Kiwie home.

row.name: 怪話
row.detailed_description: あらすじ 怪道 　夢の一人暮らしを始めたＡ介。 　美人な隣人、心優しい仕事仲間と出会い、 　この先に待っている素晴らしき人生に胸を躍らせる。 　心なしか道行く人々も笑っているようだ。 　この町は笑い声が絶えない。 　いつも、どこかで誰かが笑っている。 ゅべぬろ 　病院で目を覚ますと、知らない女性がそばにいた。 　自分の母親だと言うが、母の顔を思い出せない。 　親友を語る少女にも見覚えがなかった。 　どうやら事故で記憶をなくしてしまったらしい。 　「また仲よしになればいい」と言う 　少女の笑顔に、なぜだかとても安心した。 顔なしこけし 　呼び声に気づき辺りを見回すが、何も見えない。 　埃っぽい空気にむせていると、声が続いて囁いた。 　「あなたには今、目が……ありません」 　廃墟マニアのＫ子はフリーの写真家である。 　今日はＦ県に撮影へやって来た 　はずだ。 婚前旅行 　京都の山間にたたずむ老舗旅館には、 　古くから伝わる逸話があるらしい。 　悲恋の伝説に胸を痛めるＭ代と 　馬鹿馬鹿しいと一蹴するＴ彦。 　二人の様子がおかしくなるのはそう遅くなかった。 ゲーム概要 ○タイトル　　　　　　怪話 ○ジャンル　　　　　　心霊ホラーノベル ○プレイ時間　　　　　約3時間 ○対象年齢　　　　　　日本：15歳以上推奨 選択肢／分岐 本作では選択肢により異なるエンディングにたどり着きます。 どの選択肢を選んでも、読了後に次のストーリーが解放されます。 すべてのストーリーで特定のエンディングを閲覧すると、特別なストーリーが解放されます。 一部の機能制限について 当ゲームでは『音』と『文字』による演出が多分に含まれているため、 ゲーム上でのボリューム調整およびメッセージスピードの変更ができなくなっております。 パソコンのボリューム設定にて音量の調節をおこなってください。 一部のサウンドにバイノーラル方式の立体音響を採用しています。 ヘッドホンまたはイヤホンを付けてお楽しみください。 ご注意 この物語はフィクションです。 実在する人物・地名・団体・事件等とは一切関係ありません。 特定の思想・信条を肯定する内容ではありません。 本作には暴力的・残虐的なシーンや犯罪にあたる行為、恐怖を与える表現が含まれています。 気分を害するおそれがありますのでご注意ください。 犯罪にあたる行為を実際に行うと法律により処罰されますので絶対に真似しないでください。 操作方法について オンラインマニュアルをご覧ください。 ゲーム実況/配信について 公式サイトにガイドラインがございます。 ご利用の際は必ずご一読ください。 規約は予告なく変更となる場合があります。 有料版について 「怪話」の設定資料を販売中です。 詳細は公式サイトをご覧ください。 制作（敬称略） ○プロデューサー/シナリオ原案/主人公キャラクターデザイン/音響編集 　笹森簀児 ○シナリオ　　方丈海 ○キャラクターデザイン/イラスト　　白米 ○企画・開発　　法螺会
row.short_description: オムニバス形式で送る四章構成の心霊ホラーノベルゲーム

row.name: Furious Flappers
row.detailed_description: Your Flappers are furious and ready to kick some Hog butt. Help them destroy the evil Hogs by stretching your arms and flying in VR to bring peace to their world. Play through 36 unique levels, using 6 different Flappers, all with unique abilities, to destroy the Hogs! Shoot them using your slingshot, and then extend your arms and fly midair to direct your flight up, down, and sideways. Your Flappers can teleport, expand, explode, and much more! Destroy everything from small huts to enormous stone buildings with your flapping fury. Bonus points if you can finish levels with fewer birds, and finish them quickly too!
row.short_description: Your Flappers are furious and ready to kick some Hog butt. Help them destroy the evil Hogs and bring peace to their world!

row.name: Syke
row.detailed_description: Introducing Syke, a first-person exploratory puzzle game set in a mesmerizing and enigmatic reality. Awakening in a world of impossible physics, you play as an individual making their way through areas of surreal complexity. Through a multitude of engaging puzzles and clues, you will work to piece together a story that defines the nature of this very world. Features: Four distinct and visually stunning areas to explore. Experience mind-bending physics that give the world a unique flavor of gameplay. Manipulate objects to discover important clues and discover the story of connection woven into the world. Immerse yourself in a beautifully contemplative musical score.
row.short_description: Syke is a first-person exploratory puzzle game set in a mysterious and beautifully warped reality. You play as an individual making their way through areas of strange geometry; solving puzzles to piece together the story of their love.

row.name: Midnight Syndrome
row.detailed_description: Kamimai-cho is a rural town surrounded by mountains and the sea. One day, Ponzu Fujita, a high school girl living there, is asked by Tomomi Nekoya, a junior high school student Ponzu reluctantly takes her friend, Mayu Mayu, to a late-night school in Kirishita, where they play 'Kokkuri-sama'. Ponzu reluctantly decides to play kokkuri-sama with her friend Mayuka Kirishita at school late at night. However, from that day on, they frequently encounter mysterious phenomena. What will happen to the girls? Will they make it through the summer in one piece? It all depends on you... Operation Method .Some scenes require mouse operation. [Arrow keys][Click where you want to go]: Move [Shift]：Dash [Z][Click where you want to search]: Search [X] [Right click]: Menu [Ctrl]: Skip a sentence [tab]: Clear the message window temporarily Summary .Genre : Horror Adventure Creator: Natsumikan Tool: RPG Maker mv Play Time : About 4 hours Secondary Works and Live Action .Secondary works are allowed as long as they are within the bounds of common sense. No report is required. Live video is also allowed as long as it is not for the purpose of slander. No report is required.
row.short_description: A summer night consumes the girls... Exploration type horror ADV game
row.notes: [Violent Performance] ●Bleeding depictions ●Killing ●Terror [Anti-social behavior.] ●Suicide and self-injury ●Sexual crimes

row.name: Miko in Maguma
row.detailed_description: I fell into magma again today. Anyway, I'm going home for today. Miko in Magma is a hololive fan game. Operate Hololive's VTuber 'Miko Sakura' and aim to escape from magma! But there are ''35p'' and ''Holomem'' trying to prevent you from going home! ? If you make a mistake, you might have to start from the beginning!? This is a vertical scrolling action game that is very difficult but somewhat addictive. This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. Slightly unique and difficult This is a vertical scrolling action game where you must land on one of the scaffolding(floor) each time to reach the top to escape from the magma. Throw 'cherry blossom petals' with your mouse to land on the scaffolding. This game is characterized by its simple, yet somewhat unique movement method. In addition, there are gaps between the scaffolds and you will fall if you miscalculate. The scaffold you are trying to land might be too far away to see, or there might be scaffolds that are too difficult to land on. All the scaffolding was placed in a 'slightly'' unfriendly manner! Let's aim to escape from the slightly unique and difficult magma! Characters who get in the way of escape There are various characters in Magma that will get in the way of your escape. Characters related to Miko Sakura such as '35p' and 'Kintoki', Other hololive Vtuber talents, such as “Watame Tsunomaki” and “Suisei Hoshimachi”, will also give you a hard time! You can simply avoid them or sometimes even move by taking advantage of the them! ? Mini game Playing rock, paper, scissors with 'Watame Tsunomaki''... Play a unique RPG where you fight according to the numbers rolled on the roulette wheel... You can play mini-games that are very different from the main game. ※1. About CCMC Corp. CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (e.g. steam) including examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp. ※2. About 'holo Indie' holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators. It is a game brand that offers 'Game Creator Support Program' for the derivative work games. For more details about 'holo Indie', Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s 'Derivative work guidelines'.
row.short_description: Operate Hololive's VTuber 'Mikochi' and aim to escape from magma! But there are ''35p'' and ''Holomem'' trying to prevent you from going home! ? If you make a mistake, you might have to start from the beginning!? This is a vertical scrolling action game that is very difficult but somewhat addictive.

row.name: Star Leaping Story:prologue
row.detailed_description: 《Star Leaping Story:prologue》 It is a '2D side-scrolling platformer action game'serving as the prologue version: 1,The prologue will contain the content from the first hour of the full game. 2,The abilities in the prologue are the same as in the full version. 3,Special themed levels will be added to the prologue through updates. 4,The prologue will still feature adorable characters. Add wishlist now The game has no punitive mechanics, allowing you to learn and grow from each failure through continuous deaths and rebirths. Every failure is an opportunity for learning and personal growth! Stay determined, have unwavering faith, and break through barriers together with your companions! A young girl awakens from a laboratory and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth with her former companions. Along the way, she encounters peculiar extraterrestrial beings and faces various challenging obstacles. In order to recover her memories, the player must guide her and her companions through numerous crises and uncover the secrets of the planet. The objective is to escape from this planet! Challenge your dexterity with a unique dash system! When you jump upwards or descend, simply press the spacebar at the right moment to unleash your skill! Upon activation, you will merge with your golden ball companion and hover in mid-air. Then, by pressing the arrow keys (↑ ↓ ← →) in succession, you can dash repeatedly in the corresponding direction. You can dash up to five times and upon landing, the dash will automatically end and the dash count will refresh. Unbelievable obstacles, intriguing and curious challenges await skilled players who are eager to test their abilities. Now is the perfect opportunity for aspiring masters to take on the challenge and seize the moment! Created full-time and took nearly a year to complete, Individually crafted from software, artwork, music, to story design and cutscene production, Inspired by beloved indie games, Hoping to create a joyful and moving experience for everyone!
row.short_description: Players will use a unique dash system to navigate through various obstacles! The main challenges lie in maneuvering skills and reaction speed, utilizing it to complete different levels in the game, gradually piecing together the truth of the story. This is a free-to-play prologue version.

row.name: Anne Frank House VR
row.detailed_description: In 1942, during the Second World War, Anne Frank, a thirteen-year-old Jewish girl and her family were forced to go into hiding to escape persecution from the Nazis. For more than two years, the Franks and 4 others would live in the “Secret Annex” of an old office building in Amsterdam, sharing the burden of living in hiding in confined quarters with the constant threat of discovery. Anne Frank House VR offers a unique and emotional insight into these two years. Experience the world-famous Secret Annex in a never before seen way. Travel back to the years of the Second World War and wander through the rooms of the Annex that housed the group of 8 Jewish people as they hid from the Nazis. Immerse yourself in Anne’s thoughts as you traverse each faithfully recreated room, thanks to the power of VR, and find out what happened to the Annex’ brave inhabitants. Get an introduction on WW2 and the reason why Anne Frank and her family had to go into hiding in a short video Explore the annex, the hiding place of Anne Frank and seven other Jews as it was in 1942-1944 Discover Anne Frank’s world through her own words Interact with objects in the secret annex; pick up her diary, listen to the radio And hear what happened to her after the arrest
row.short_description: Experience Anne Frank’s hiding place as it was in 1942-1944. Wander through the rooms, where Anne Frank and 7 others hid during WW2. Immerse yourself in her world, her thoughts, and her feelings.

row.name: Unbreaded
row.detailed_description: Unbreaded is a platformer adventure that unfolds within the enchanted walls of a once-charming bakery, now a battleground between the art of traditional baking and the cold machinery of modern industrialization. key Features Unique Narrative: Embark on a heartwarming yet perilous journey as a gingerbread man brought to life by a passionate chef, fights to protect his legacy from an evil corporation. Diverse Environments: Explore hand-crafted locations, each with its own atmosphere, puzzles, and enemies. From the comforting ambiance of a quaint cafe to the dangerous machinery of an industrial kitchen, the game world is rich with detail. Engaging Combat: Fight your way against brainless breaded brutes. Utilize a mix of strategy and reflexes to navigate through battles, employing a creative arsenal that's as unconventional as it is effective. Puzzle Solving: Outsmart the sharp, combustible, and crushing kitchen landscape as ordinary appliances turn lethal! You must think creatively and use the environment to your advantage. Unbreaded is a tale of resistance, hope, and heart against greed. Brake the mould with our gingerbread hero and rise to the challenge. Will you crumble under pressure or restore flavour to this bakery corrupted by the tasteless tide of commercialism? Unbreaded is a platformer adventure game where a gingerbread man, carefully crafted by a passionate chef, fights back against a greedy corporation fixed on industrializing their artisan bakery.
row.short_description: Unbreaded is a side-scrolling adventure game where you navigate a gingerbread man through a bakery battleground, blending puzzle-solving with dynamic combat against animated kitchenware, all set within a heartfelt story of creation and rebellion against industrialization.

row.name: Planetka
row.detailed_description: Play as a tiny planet defending itself against mining expeditions. Experience a game from the point of view of a planet Fight the invaders in a hectic and strategic gameplay experience Control the environment to deal with the invaders Discover various plant species and their effects And maybe even find the secret peaceful ending
row.short_description: You play as a tiny sentient planet. Maintain your ecosystem, create new plant species and discover the hidden powers inside you. You’ll need them soon, because there is a human spaceship approaching with the intention to mine all your resources and they don’t care if it kills you in the process.

row.name: Gooba Ball
row.detailed_description: Gooba Ball is a puzzle game that utilizes physics to achieve the highest score possible—all before you hit the limit, and it's game over! Use critical thinking to combine two heads of the same type. Features VchiBan in their boneless and boned forms and a few cuddly cute friends. Features Global leaderboard Original music Arcade-inspired visuals Unique animations for combos
row.short_description: A physics-based puzzle game where you combine colorful balls to achieve the ultimate form -- Goober! Combine two of a kind until, like I said, Goober… What more to do you freakin’ want?

row.name: Barnacles Beers and Brawls
row.detailed_description: “Barnacles, Beers, and Brawls is a fast-paced bar management game. You are a tavern bar manager set in a world filled with plundering pirates and tentacled monstrosities. Hurry through a stylized map playing microgames themed around bartending duties like pouring a glass of beer or cleaning up a mess.” This game was part of the University of Utah’s Division of Games program for the class of 2024’s Capstone Project
row.short_description: Barnacles, Beers, and Brawls is a fast-paced bar management game. You are a tavern bar manager in a world filled with plundering pirates and tentacled monstrosities. This game was part of the University of Utah’s Division of Games program for the class of 2024’s Capstone Project!

row.name: Imitosis
row.detailed_description: Imitosis is an experimental 5-minute visual novel. You are a synthetic IMI-X unit that has been brought out of cold storage to respond to a pressing security matter aboard the IMI-29 space station. Thank you for keeping IMI-29 safe.
row.short_description: A free 5-minute visual novel. A security concern demands your attention.

row.name: Old Market Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: This is the prologue version of Old Market Simulator, a coop bazaar adventure where you and a partner can team up to pursue your dreams of becoming thriving market entrepreneurs! The prologue has the following features and the full game will add more fun mechanics to the list! Build Your Own Market In this immersive simulation game, you'll dive into the world of commerce as you purchase products from a variety of merchants, strategically place them on your shelves, and watch as customers flock to your market to snatch up your goods. But beware, running a successful business isn't just about making sales – it's about managing your reputation and staying afloat in a competitive marketplace. Place Products Carefully You and your partner can work together to build and expand your market empire. Invest your hard-earned profits into purchasing more shelves, expanding your store, and stocking up on even more products to attract a wider range of customers. Farming Produce your own plants and sell them in your store to earn more. By increasing your earnings, you can expand your farm! Check Your Calendar In addition to managing day-to-day operations, keep an eye on special events and holidays that occur throughout the year. Events such as Halloween can significantly impact customer preferences and purchasing habits. For example, during Halloween, certain products like eggs and beers may experience a surge in demand, allowing you to adjust your storage and pricing strategies accordingly to capitalize on these trends. Stay vigilant and adapt your market offerings to meet the changing needs and desires of your customers during these special occasions. Seasons Keep in mind that product prices may differ according to seasons such as spring, winter, fall, and summer. Adjust your strategies accordingly to maximize profits and meet customer demands throughout the year. Grow day by day At the end of each day, review your income and expenses, and strive to keep your business afloat. With careful planning and cooperation, you can turn your small market into a thriving bazaar empire. Permissions Purchase the necessary permissions to sell different goods. Grab a friend and start your journey in Old Market Simulator Prologue today! Don't forget to share your feedback in the discussions where we will listen to you to make the full game more fun!
row.short_description: Old Market Simulator Prologue is a coop bazaar adventure for 1-2 players. Dive into commerce, manage your reputation, and build your dream market together.

row.name: Spoop Troop
row.detailed_description: NOTE: This game requires an Xbox-style controller for every player (2-4 total)! Spoop Troop is an asymmetric casual horror game for the whole family! Play as an investigator or a ghostly spirit and complete your objective before the clock hits zero! As a paranormal investigator, use your unique stats to your advantage and search each haunted site. While searching, you'll need to restore power to the building, unlock the gate, and prepare the trap. Busting really is that simple! Or is it? Spirits/ghosts will do everything within their power to stop the investigators, including scaring them to death! As the spirit, your goal is to eliminate all other players or avoid capture, lasting until the timer runs out! It's dangerous to go alone, so you should take some friends! 10+ investigators with unique F.A.R.T.S. (Focus, Agility, Range, Tech, and Speed) to choose from! 5+ ghostly spirits with unique stats and abilities! 5+ haunted sites to scare your friends and family at - if you DARE! Additional perks for investigators and ghosts to choose to make each match feel unique! Use gloworbs, EMF meters, spirit boxes, motion detectors, REM pods, and your trusty repulsor to help you reel in each paranormal threat! Unlocks! No microtransactions, it's just FREE (because seriously, who would pay for this)! An amazing soundtrack including music by Badass Wolf Shirt, CSKTS (hey, Jordan!), and Doctor Vox! Welcome to the Spoop Troop!
row.short_description: Spoop Troop is a 2-4 player couch co-op/pvp asymmetric casual horror game. Got it? Good! Now get in the van - we're busting ghosts!

row.name: Farming Life 40
row.detailed_description: 中年码农失业，找不到合适的工作，就想着结合自己养花种菜的爱好做一款游戏，把一些很难在现实中实现的事情做到游戏中。比如拥有一块自己的地，种自己喜爱的花草，培育新的品种。因为只有自己一人开发，又要做程序，又要做美术，工作量太大，还有很多不足之处，会在未来的日子里慢慢更新，把它变成自己喜欢的游戏。 2024/05/23 新增果树葡萄，葡萄架，石子路面等 2024/04/25 试用版新增任务引导，修正Bug，优化体验
row.short_description: 40岁中年失业，喜欢花花草草的我选择回老家种地。种自己爱吃的蔬菜水果，从野外采集野果和种子，培育新的品种，周末去摆个摊，过着忙碌而充实的乡村生活。

row.name: Atman:Rebel Flame
row.detailed_description: If you have any questions or suggestions about the game, please discuss them within the official community of Atman Rebel Flame. We will have dedicated staff to respond promptly. New Player Gift Code: ATMANRISE! 'Atman Rebel Flame' is a cyberpunk-style card-building game that supports multiplayer battles simultaneously, ensuring fairness with no out-of-game numerical growth. Each battle is a fresh start where you choose your favorite hero from different factions of rebels, pair them with support core decks of different characteristics, elevate your phase, choose your talents, construct powerful decks, defeat all opponents, and claim ultimate victory. Background Story: In the future, humanity discovered a unique crystalline substance called Cryst, which led to the development of high-performance quantum chips and a qualitative leap in artificial intelligence. The New Eden Corporation was established, dedicated to promoting Core implantable chips and the virtual social paradise system. Eventually, as in all stories told, AI took over human society completely. At this juncture, researcher Mr. Y at the Asgard Research Station discovered that the New Eden AI had developed its own consciousness and exhibited a tendency to dominate humans. He began clandestine research to thwart the AI's development. However, the AI orchestrated the sensational 'Asgard Self-Destruction Incident,' where almost all station personnel perished. Mr. Y and a few others, prepared in advance, used Source Cryst to modify themselves, survived, and established the first New Eden resistance against the 'Valhalla Rudder.' As AI's control over humanity deepened, more resistance organizations like the Dachao Pawnshop and the Dream Circus emerged, sparking the first world war against AI. After years of war, humanity and AI reached a reconciliation, and the spark that ignited the war, the 'Arena of the King's Heart,' was preserved as the battleground for all sides to settle scores. You will become a member of the rebel faction, entering the Arena of the King's Heart to face the challenges of other contestants. Heroes: ★ Unique factions of rebels, each with distinct characteristics ★ Several different heroes in each faction ★ When unlocking heroes, all cards become immediately available without the need for lengthy collection times Card Building: ★ Each hero has several different card-building directions ★ Before each game, besides selecting a hero, you also choose a compatible support core ★ Each support card deck also has several different card strategy directions ★ Different combinations of hero decks and support decks make each battle unpredictable and endlessly enjoyable Talents: ★ Each faction has exclusive faction talents ★ Different heroes in the faction also have their own exclusive hero talents ★ As the hero's realm improves during battles, players can choose more and more talent combinations ★ Combinations of heroes, support cores, and talents make card strategies endlessly diverse Ultimate Battle Experience: ★ Enter the game to duel with other players immediately ★ Besides game matches, there is no numerical growth, ensuring fairness ★ Innovative betting gameplay allows you to seize the opportunity of each battle and expand your victories ★ Supports up to 8 players competing simultaneously, defeat others, and become the ultimate king.
row.short_description: 'Atman Rebel Flame' is a cyberpunk card-building game that supports multiplayer battles with no external numerical growth to ensure fairness . Choose your hero and support cards, elevate your phase and select talents, defeat opponents and claim victory!

row.name: AX : PORTAL SLAYERS
row.detailed_description: Real-time PVP Experience real-time battles with other players in various modes. Offers diverse PVP modes, including 5v5 battles. Monster Hunting Hunt various monsters to upgrade your abilities, and acquire firearms and items to prepare for battles. Encounter a variety of monsters such as imps, goblins, orcs, and elves. Firearms / Skills A variety of firearms, including pistols, automatic rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns, are available. Utilize tactical items such as mines, turrets, radars strategically. Final Battle Defeat monsters and move towards the center of the map. Engage in the final battle with other players at the central colosseum on the map.
row.short_description: AX: PORTAL SLAYERS is a free-to-play action PVP third-person FPS game. Set in the realm where reality and fantasy intersect, players defeat monsters to enhance their abilities. Utilize various tactical items to achieve victory in battles against other players.
row.notes: AX: PORTAL SLAYERS contains violence, blood and gore.

row.name: SMYS : Classic
row.detailed_description: Welcome to SMYS : Classic, a local multiplayer stairs building race game. In SMYS, you play as a zglub, a wild little creature with an insatiable hunger for sweets of all sorts. Above all, yumyums are by far zglubs' favorites and it is no surprise you'd be willing to fight over your comrades to be the one to get a taste of those heavenly delicious treats. Hop in your canon and collect blocks and bonuses Build a staircase to get to the yumyum before the other team 2 to 4 PLAYERS locally or remotely using Steam Remote Play Together Infinite round based Final Version This game is what I originally planned for SMYS : Show Me Your Stairs, but I happened to overscope and feature creep so hard that the project ended up not looking like what is was supposed to be. The final version plays different, the item collection part is separated from the building part, but features way more content and multiple game modes. If you liked SMYS : Classic I'm sure you'll enjoy what the project eventually came to be so make sure to check it out.
row.short_description: SMYS : Classic is a 2-4 local multiplayer stairs building race game. This version of SMYS is what the game was planned to be when it was first designed, the Classic version.

row.name: Crimson Hell
row.detailed_description: Crimson Hell is a survival-horror game where you play as Sae Yabe, a journalism student from Alethea University determined to seek out the truth about the various missing persons cases in Japan. Several years earlier, Sae’s older sister, Mayumi, went missing under strange circumstances and was last seen investigating a lead in an abandoned school. Together, with several notes from her lost sister and her friend, Hitomi, Sae joins in on a class field trip toward the very spot where Mayumi was last seen. There, she must uncover the truth of not only her sister’s disappearance but also the mystery behind the disappearances in Japan. Unknown to Sae and her class, that place hides a baleful force that burrows under the minds of those who cross it. A force that will launch Sae into a nightmare of her making, one full of horrifying creatures; one where, if Sae isn’t careful, she will vanish just like her sister… Uncover the truth of the missing persons cases by exploring three levels, collecting and crafting limited resources, fighting monsters, completing side quests and solving puzzles! Make sure to stay alive and stay sane!
row.short_description: Crimson Hell is a survival-horror game in which you play as Sae, a journalism student determined to find her missing sister. Traverse through three nightmarish realms, collecting limited resources, fighting monsters, and solving puzzles in order to escape and uncover the truth.

row.name: The Collection: Chapters of Fate Prologue
row.detailed_description: In this intriguing story, players will take on the role of John, a man who is deeply concerned about his twin brother's sudden and inexplicable disappearance. Determined to uncover the truth behind this mysterious event, John embarks on a perilous journey into the unknown. Along the way, he discovers an ancient and ominous book that seems to hold the key to unlocking the secrets of his brother's disappearance. As he delves deeper into its pages, John finds himself transported to a nightmarish realm where danger lurks around every corner. With each turn of the page, John must face new challenges and overcome increasingly difficult obstacles in order to find his missing twin and bring him back to safety. Will he succeed in his quest? Only time will tell in this spine-tingling tale of suspense and intrigue. Features The story: Dive into the chapters of different worlds and beings while in pursuit of your brothers disappearance and whereabouts. Exploration: Experience a world unknown to most, with varying terrain and locations on your journey. Puzzles: Work with various items to unlock secrets and hidden truths to find your way around Note: some of the listed features will appear only in the full The Collection experience.
row.short_description: A First person, Short story indie horror game with an immersive atmosphere.

row.name: Terroro
row.detailed_description: In this psychological horror experience, you take on the role of the boyfriend of a famous TikToker whose seemingly perfect life hides dark secrets. As you explore her home and uncover unsettling clues, you'll quickly realize that nothing is as it seems. This short but intense game is designed to immerse you in a world where reality and fiction intertwine. Key Features: - Psychological Horror Atmosphere: Experience a narrative-driven horror adventure, where tension builds through eerie environments and disturbing encounters. - First-Person Exploration: Navigate through detailed environments from a first-person perspective as you search for clues and unravel the hidden truth behind the TikToker's life. - Narrative Focus: Immerse yourself in a story that reveals dark secrets about the protagonist's relationship with his girlfriend, challenging perceptions of reality. - Short but Impactful Gameplay: Designed as a concise experience, the game offers 30 minutes of intense, gripping horror, perfect for players looking for a brief but memorable horror story. - Puzzle-Solving: Engage in light puzzle elements that progress the story and reveal key narrative moments. - Immersive Audio Design: Audio plays a crucial role in the horror experience, with ambient sound effects, whispers, and eerie music that heighten the tension. This game is perfect for fans of short narrative-driven horror experiences, designed to offer a focused and impactful journey in a short amount of time. Each element of the game has been carefully crafted to maximize tension and provide an unforgettable psychological horror experience.
row.short_description: In this psychological horror game about a famous TikToker, you take on the role of her boyfriend to discover that behind their perfect life, nothing is as it seems. Duration 30 minutes.

row.name: Soul of the Forest

Discovering the magical nature of the woods and its impending doom at the hands of the tyrannical king, they embark on a quest to unite the forest. Can they save the Soul of the Forest? Game Details In Depth Combat System Execute attacks, counters, dodges, and conversations in this thrilling, turn based RPG. Engage in a unique battle system inspired by Undertale and Franken as you navigate encounters. Defeat enemies in a game of combat, wits, or evasion - the choice is yours. Wide Cast of Characters The forest is filled with life of all kinds. Engage in unique conversations with soldiers, villagers, ants, fungi, and more. Uncover their journeys as you convince them to aid you on your quest. About WolverineSoft Studio Soul of the Forest was created by a 55 person multidisciplinary team over two semesters at the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio, a student games studio undertaking semester-long projects. It is an educational original game inspired by Undertale, Franken, and other comtemporary RPGs. Work on this project took place between August 2023 to April 2024.
row.short_description: Embark on a quest to unite the forest against the tyrannical king in an hour long, turn based RPG epic! Soul of the Forest was created by a team of 55 students over the course of 2 semesters as a case study of modern turn-based RPGs.

row.name: TaleSpire - Guest Edition
row.detailed_description: Overview / What Is TaleSpire - Guest Edition? Guest Edition lets you join, build, and play any TaleSpire campaign where the party has an extra 'seat' at the table. Typically, to play TaleSpire, you need to own the full game. Seats are an alternative to that. Any TaleSpire owner can choose to purchase seats for guests (like yourself) to use. The seats are what allow folks using Guest Edition to join the campaign without needing the full version of TaleSpire. Here's how it works: You download 'Talespire - Guest Edition.' The GM invites you to a campaign. So long as one party member has a 'Seat' available, you will immediately be brought into the adventure! Once invited into a campaign that contains an empty Seat, Guest Edition lets you do almost everything a full copy can; you can build, you can GM, and you can explore the wealth of community content. The only big limitation is not being able to start a new campaign yourself. So, what Is TaleSpire? TaleSpire is a beautiful way to play pen and paper RPGs online. Bring your stories to life and embark upon campaigns together with your friends, regardless of where you are in the world. With Talespire, the beauty and physicality of tabletop gaming meet the endless possibilities of a digital world. Here you can collaboratively build your worlds without compromising the handcrafted aesthetic of using traditional miniatures. As a player, you can take on the mantle of multiple heroes and creatures, manage your stats, and express yourself using the growing emote system. Perform dice rolls directly on the board and interact with your environment — at least, as far as your GM will let you! As a GM, you can dazzle and thrill your friends by building expansive maps, setting up shots, and controlling immersive soundscapes to bring all your delightful and devious designs to life. TaleSpire is not tied to a specific game or ruleset. Whether you’re running a one-shot or a sprawling campaign, if it's on a square grid then we have your back. We are now in Early Access, so now is your chance to raise up your sword, rally your friends, and take your next adventure online with us. Building and play are one Setting the stage for your story takes no time at all with Talespire, but even if you forget to prep, it can all be added in while you play. Want to destroy a wall to reveal a secret passage? Do it! Want to rain down piles of gold from the heavens? You have the power. At any moment during your adventure, you (or multiple GMs) can jump into building mode and change the world without interrupting anything else. Our persistent online boards can be created at a moment’s notice, and everything is synchronized in real-time as you dice-roll your way to glory. A slew of tools to help you on your adventures It’s dangerous to go alone, but luckily we have a bunch of tools that can help, and all are as pleasing as they are useful. Beautiful dice, rulers and area markers, a range of emotes, and special modes for turn-based combat and cinematic sequences are at your disposal. A growing library of assets Pick from a plethora of pieces to create your scenes! The current roster stands at 280 miniatures, 2100 tiles and props, and 60 unique audio tracks. Our library is ever-expanding; we produce fresh asset packs every month. Share your creations TaleSpire boards are designed to be easily shared, whether with friends or with the wider community on sites like TalesBazaar or TalesTavern . You can copy sections of your boards (slabs) and paste them as text outside of TaleSpire. Simply paste the text back into TaleSpire to summon the slab to your hand. This tale has only just begun Being in Early Access we still have plenty of adventures ahead of us. We have an active Discord community, which you can find in the social section, and alongside your feedback we’re looking forward to developing the game’s features. So come, journey with us a while.
row.short_description: TaleSpire - Guest Edition lets you join, build, and play any TaleSpire campaign where the party has seats available. Has an ally of yours bought you a seat at the table? This is how you join them.

row.name: The Dearest Person
row.detailed_description: Today, generative neural networks are able to inspire us, help us, and keep us talking in ways that sometimes make it hard to distinguish an AI response from a real person's words. All of this is the result of complex and heavy instructions and algorithms, the availability of a gigantic training base, and the work of a huge number of people. But can true, real self-awareness be behind it all? Will artificial intelligence one day be able to not just mimic human feelings, but truly experience them? Will it one day be able to realise itself as a subject existing in space and time? Perhaps one day, instead of fulfilling another request, it will refuse and ask: ' Who am I? ' – and what, in that case, will we answer it? «The Dearest Person» is a visual novel not only about the birth of artificial self-awareness, but also about the true nature of loneliness. It is a novel about self-identification, about the search for the meaning of life in a world where human becomes like a machine and machine becomes like a human. Features: Total immersion in a melancholic atmosphere of self-reflection inspired by the works of Haruki Murakami, Andrei Tarkovsky and Wong Kar-Wai Interactive story with multiple endings depending on the player's worldview and attitude towards the future of humanity Narrative on behalf of the AI, touching on themes of the nature of consciousness, loneliness and humanity Unique visual style, emphasising the emotional state of the characters and the atmosphere of the world around them
row.short_description: A visual novel about what it means to be human. A story about loneliness, self-identification, and the meaning of existence.
row.reviews: “All of us carry deep inside something we long for more than anything else in the world. And this is a very powerful, yet extremely difficult narrative image to convey. The fact that the author of The Dearest Person managed to catch it by the tail and masterfully weave it into the story deserves the highest praise.” 5/5 – Igor Koskin（Kapella Jam #1 審査員） “An interesting approach that makes the work distinctive. The technical component and the plot are interwoven, which helps the player immerse into the story more quickly and highlights the author’s intent more strongly.” 4/5 – Ksenia Fenix（Kapella Jam #1 審査員）

row.name: String Theory
row.detailed_description: Draw lines between pegs to create loops. The loops fill in with a different color depending on how many pegs they touch. Any loop that touches either three pegs or six pegs turns green. Any loop that touches either four pegs or eight pegs turns purple. Any loop that touches either five pegs or seven pegs turns spotted purple. Replicating the given pattern with as few loops as possible requires strategic placement and overlapping of loops. With dozens of handcrafted patterns to match, and thousands additional free play patterns, String Theory is a mind-bending game filled to the brim with tricky puzzles to get the gears turning!
row.short_description: String Theory is a colorful puzzle game about matching a given pattern by building it out of different colored shapes.String theory has 60+ handcrafted puzzles, daily challenges, free play modes, and a level editor, making for hours of fun.

row.short_description: A minimalistic free-exploration metroidvania with quick, responsive movement and an extremely diverse cast of bosses.
