row.detailed_description: タイピング×ノベルゲーム「ファントピア」 ・あらすじ 主人公であるあなたは、見慣れない家で目を覚ましました。 ここは何者かによって作られた世界　「ファントピア」 あなたはもともと居た現実世界に帰るためこの世界を旅することに。 その旅の中であなたはこの世界の正体を、ここで暮らしてきたもの達の軌跡を、少しづつ知ることになります。 ・ゲーム内容 ノベルゲームパート タイピングゲームパート(ステージ20数種類) クリア済みのストーリーやタイピングステージは後から別途遊ぶことができます。 ・難易度について easy,normal,hard,expertの4種 タイピングが不慣れな方でも安心 ・スコア機能 タイピングステージ、難易度ごとにスコア及びランクが記録されます。 目指せsランク ・エンディング エンディング2種 基本は一本通行のストーリー ・他 ゲームプレイ中にたまにシーン遷移が上手くいかず操作ができなくなる現象を確認しております。 その場合はお手数ですが、ゲームを再起動してください。 尚、ゲームはオートセーブなのでそれでデータが失われることはありません。 実況、配信に関する許諾は一切不要です。煮るなり焼くなりしていただくと喜びます。 作者はゲーム開発のプロ・フェッショナルではありませんのでシステム上の不具合が散見されることが予測されます。 ゲームの不具合、他誤字脱字、表現の問題等の報告は歓迎しますが技術的に修正困難なケースもあるかもしれません。予めご了承下さい。
row.short_description: タイピング×ノベルゲーム。「ファントピア」という謎の世界に迷い込んでしまったあなた。あなたは元の世界に帰るためにファントピア中を旅することになります。ノベルパートとタイピングパートに分かれたオリジナルゲーム。
row.notes: 一部暴力的な言葉遣い 自殺描写 殺人描写 が含まれます

row.name: DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action Playtest
HyperBody
row.detailed_description: Welcome to HyperBody dungeons, an experimental open-world VR game space with six intense gameplay levels: Pinkray, Seventeen/Sixty-One, Vampire Squid, Stratholme.GoStop, Typhoon Lionrock, and Garden Portal. Immerse yourself in an aesthetised trance world that showcases the anime, comics, games, and novels of European and Asian fandoms. The VR experience is 'passive', requiring only basic movements such as walking, flying, rotating, and touching. It will help if you search for the portal with a shining eye shape that will take you to a new level. The experiment encourages players to use their entire bodies to explore the VR space and provide feedback on its aesthetics, movement, and overall feelings! Are you ready to embark on this psychedelic, rhythm-fueled adventure and imagine an alternative VR cosmos? PLAYER INSTRUCTIONS For HyperBody's experimental nature, please check system requirements first, view the quick reference and start playing. If you are interested, browse the manual and join our Discord community! LEVEL 1: PINKRAY Pinkray is a result of a collaborative effort that celebrates queer 'tuning' through vidding, shipping, interviews, and architectural mods. It showcases a new 'game-fandom' that constantly emerges as 'intra-actions'. It features non-collision NPCs, architectural ruins, visual novels with 3D animated texts, and affective NPC dialogues! LEVEL 2: SEVENTEEN/SIXTY-ONE Seventeen/Sixty-One is co-created through research and interviews with Chinese science fiction writer Tang Fei. It offers an alternative vision of queer, feminine, and technology in the Chinese science fiction world. It features 2D illustrations, animations and 3D texts as interactive paths, accompanied by various soundscapes and atmospheric objects. LEVEL 3: VAMPIRE SQUID Vilem Flusser's book of the same name inspires the abstract cosmos of Vampire Squid. Explore multiple worlds created by remixing 3D scans of spaces, cartographies, and surfaces from London and Berlin. This complex spatial autoethnographic archive showcases Flusser's ideas on skin, space, and sexuality. It features non-collision 3D-scanned architectural ruins on a cosmic scale and surreal NPCs. LEVEL 4: STRATHOLME.GOSTOP Stratholme.GoStop presents a unique combination of physical and virtual elements based on my best childhood friend, Boxiao's short novel. It has modding and crossover elements between a Chinese post-industrial ordnance factory welfare zone and the Warcraft 3: The Frozen Throne universe. It features visual novels based on dodecahedron objects and various Chinese urban space 3D-scanned ruins. LEVEL 5: TYPHOON LIONROCK Typhoon Lionrock is highly speculative about a VR game space's movement, direction, scale, and soundscape. Very difficult and for hard-core players, this level is a tribute to my time killed at the Run Run Shaw Library, City University of Hong Kong. Be careful not to get dizzy and nauseous from the multiple abstract scenes referenced in Hong Kong, Dunhuang, and Chongqing. LEVEL 6: GARDEN PORTAL Garden Portal is based on Chinese immortality cultivation. Explore a non-linear audio-visual space through the primal VR experience with intentionally incomplete and imperfect sound and architectural design. It features numerous NPCs to be found and touched with multiple hidden tokens and architectural ruins. SUPPORTED BY Hyperbody utilises the Wwise sound engine (academic license) for an immersive soundscape. The game's development benefited from valuable feedback received during various evaluation workshops at Goldsmiths Computing Department.
row.short_description: Dive into HyperBody dungeons: an experimental VR walking simulator blending architectural ruins, cult themes, sensorial vibes, and queer narratives. Navigate mysterious realms and affective tales, and immerse in a psychedelic, rhythm-fueled cosmos. Experience a meditative, aestheticised trance!
row.reviews: “Your VR game Queer Maximalism HyperBody, for me, is a performative declaration of being unapologetically queer, maximalist, and body-centric.” Rhizome “A performative practice that creates new forms of intra-action of culture, technology, and queerness, resulting in new modes of intimacy, affect, and subjectivity.” CURA. “In HyperBody Qiang develops a strategy for revitalisation in order to create discourse around resistance and the rebuilding of worlds — a needed political gesture within our present political moment.” transmediale

row.name: I commissioned some invisible people 0
row.detailed_description: You may also like About the Game A hidden object game where you must find all the invisible people to complete each level. If you look really carefully, you might see them. Release date: April 1st (but the display varies depending on what region you're in). Key features: 🖼️ 5 Unique artworks 👤 Hundreds of invisible people to find 💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck ♻️ Hide a small number of hidden people so you can find them again! 🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork ⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel 💾 5x save slots 🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again 🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level Context: The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many invisible people as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 5 art pieces to choose from, you will have a lot of searching to do. Controls: Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden person, click and they will appear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. Difficulty: A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. Get immersed: Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everyone. Replayable You can restore a small number of invisible people back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few invisible people left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 5 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.
row.short_description: I paid more artists to hide invisible people in 5 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

row.name: Void Whispers
row.detailed_description: What if the reason for our universe being so vast and yet so silent is darker than we think? What if we are destined to perish, hunted by an ancient civilization that destroys every new life that thrives and attempts to reach out to the cosmos? In Void Whispers you play as Mike, a newcomer to Cosmo City working as a broadcast engineer. Your task is to master the use of radio equipment to broadcast the latest news to the town folks, all while mysterious events unfold in the sky. Key features: 30 to 40 minutes of gameplay 3 different endings to discover Work as a broadcast engineer, learning how to operate all the machines, interact with the public, play some old music, and more. Intriguing narrative Immersive sound design A true horror experience Aliens (but not the gray one)
row.short_description: Assume the role of a broadcast engineer in a tranquil city. All seems peaceful until the sky above starts to reveal something deeply unsettling.

row.name: Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition
row.detailed_description: Celebrate Halloween night with cute capybaras with orange! Find all the hidden capybaras in their Halloween costumes and light up the town on this magical night. A fun-filled adventure awaits you! Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition include Hidden capybaras in a variety of spooky costumes. 100 hidden capybaras, 5 cats and some special guests in a city full of Halloween vibes. Hint system Relaxing Halloween music, perfect for searching for capybaras with orange!
row.short_description: Celebrate Halloween night with cute capybaras with orange! Find all the hidden capybaras in their Halloween costumes and light up the town on this magical night. A fun-filled adventure awaits you!

row.name: Devils Wind Mine
row.detailed_description: The Devil's Wind Mine is an indie minigame where you play an engineer from the mine's pump control room, seeking to save the son of a desperate mother. You are the decider of this story, inspired by Baldomero Lillo's tale. In 1904, the Lota coal mine in Chile captured the attention of the country's miners. Because food was scarce, and their needs were increasing, entire families sacrificed their lives inside the mine. In this game, you have a second chance at redemption, by twisting the fate of those who passed. It is your duty, as an engineer, to save as many miners as possible, or just one; the devil waits to be fed inside these passages. Features Radar, pumps, electricity; all that to let you decide the miners fate Four different scenarios to play and re-play to save them all The full short story of “El Chiflón del Diablo” shown through telegrams Baldomero Lillo portrayed the atrocities of the mine, telling stories that came from inside the earth's core. “El Chiflón del Diablo” narrates life and death stained with coal, a mother's love and hope, exploitation, and collapses.
row.short_description: Devil's Wind Mine is a game where you play as an engineer controlling the pumps, seeking to save the son of a desperate mother. You are the decider of this story. It is your duty, as an engineer, to save as many miners as possible, or just one; the devil waits to be fed inside these passages.

row.name: Geisterbahnhof
row.detailed_description: What is it that defines the dreams that truly terrify us and then haunt us long after waking up? Is it a situation we cannot escape? Perhaps it is being surrounded by a place that is isolated and alienating? Could it be the feeling of being exposed to something or someone that seeks inflict unimaginable torments on us? One example that captures all of this is the place you will be taken to, should you choose to accept this challenge. As the player you will take on the role of an unsuspecting commuter taking the subway who gets side-tracked from their mundane activity and wanders into a part of the system that has been abandoned. However, this is no accident, this is a place to which you have been lured, the Geisterbahnhof, or ghost station. Your task is to survive and escape, but in order to do so you will need to move carefully through the endless tunnels evading your pursuer and seeking out the items that you will depend upon for your escape. Even so, the items alone will not be enough, you will also need to employ your memory and all your concentration and of course you will need to keep your nerve. Features: Player is immersed in continuous atmospheric tension, interrupted by jump scares from a pursuer who can strike at any time. The player must begin solving puzzles that utilize the subway’s dilapidated infrastructure to provide clues. They then must harness their memory to navigate their way to freedom. Replayable- the station maps are procedurally generated in a number of different styles varying the experience with each play Geisterbahnhof promises to deliver a chilling adventure, where every step into the unknown could be your last. Are you brave enough to face the darkness?
row.short_description: Geisterbahnhof promises to deliver a chilling adventure, where every step into the unknown could be your last. Are you brave enough to face the darkness?
row.notes: This game does contain some mild violence and occasional explicit language, there is also a depiction of sedatives being administered. Caution is advised with respect to younger players. Photosensitivity: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Mokoko X: The First Date
row.detailed_description: Buy Now About the Game Mokoko X: The First Date features the first chapter of Mokoko X for free! Gameplay The main goal is conquering the bigger portion of the screen. While you are in your own area, you are safe from the enemies until your shield depletes. You conquer new areas by drawing out of your area. Drawing, however, deactivates your shield and exposes you to danger. Your shield decreases constantly. If you do not conquer at a certain frequency, your shield will burn out and you will not be safe on your own areas as well. There are 3 difficulties in the game. The difficulty affects enemies, your shield, and the required conquered area percentage for the victory.
row.short_description: Nostalgic arcade gameplay remastered! Conquer the bigger portion of the screen and save the unlucky girls from the various absurd troublemakers.
row.notes: This content includes nudity and sexual references suitable only for mature audiences.

row.name: 蒸汽麻將社
row.detailed_description: 無論你是初次接觸麻將的新手，還是技藝高超的高手，《蒸汽麻將社》都能為你提供量身打造的遊戲體驗。這裡有豐富的挑戰、緊張的對局，以及與志同道合玩家交流的機會。 快來《蒸汽麻將社》，加入全球麻將愛好者的行列，展開一場場激動人心的麻將對決吧！ 遊戲特色 隨機撮合金幣對戰 ：快速匹配全球玩家，體驗即時對戰的刺激。同時配備完善的防弊措施，保障公平遊戲環境。 免費好友開房 ：輕鬆邀請好友組局，不論是休閒娛樂還是技術切磋都方便至極。更支援外部貨幣結算與帳本記錄功能，增添互動性與便利性。 昇段檢定賽 ：從「9級菜鳥」挑戰至「九段大師」，每一步都是對技巧與智慧的考驗，展現你的麻將實力！ 大牌房專屬體驗 ：蒐集「一色卡」、「四喜卡」、「三刻卡」等十餘種大牌卡，進入專屬的大牌房，感受做大牌的極限挑戰與緊張氛圍。 完整國標麻將番型實現 ：最普及的中國麻將規則，不用再打不習慣的外國麻將規則了。 豐富排行榜與統計數據 ：多元化的排行榜系統和詳盡的個人數據分析，讓你隨時掌握自己的成長軌跡，挑戰巔峰排名！
row.short_description: 撮合金幣對戰、免費好友開房、外部貨幣與帳本記錄功能、昇段檢定賽，還可蒐集「一色卡」、「四喜卡」、「三刻卡」等十餘種大牌卡，在大牌房中感受做大牌的極限挑戰與緊張氛圍。完整國標麻將規則。

row.name: Bud Masters - Peace Edition
row.detailed_description: WHAT IS THE PEACE EDITION? Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is the free 'NO DECK BUILDING' edition of my somewhat nostalgic indie weed lifestyle deck building card game. It is for casual card game players who like fun card games and weed, without the complexities and time that it takes for 'Building Decks' Draw cards, and play your cards to deplete your opponent's bud bowl while defending your own bud bowl. The Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is a easy to pick up and play card game with all cards included. All other unlocks are earned through playing the game. There are no in-game purchases or micro-transactions of any kind. Choose to play against a stoned (yet surprisingly adept AI), or engage in PvP with a (probably) stoned human opponent.... No additional developer or publisher game accounts or sign ups required. The core game on Steam is all you need to find / connect / play with your pals. I hope you enjoy my first card game as a game designer / solo-developer. Do let me know if you have fun!
row.short_description: Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is a fun, easy to pick up nostalgic weed lifestyle card game. Free from deck building or any additional complexities, 'Peace Edition' is a casual, chill, yet challenging card game with no additional accounts, no micro-transactions or in game purchases required.
row.notes: References to marijuana, it's consumption and it's effects.

row.name: Animal Shelter 2: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Animal Shelter 2: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Our four-legged friends need your help! Animal Shelter Simulator 2: Prologue comes with more animals that need your help. You will need to provide them with a clean, safe environment, as well as food and water and, most importantly, lots of love. Thankfully, you won’t be alone this time! Grow your shelter with new employees! Managing a whole shelter by yourself is a tough job! Good thing you’ve got the help of skilled workers that can take on some of the responsibilities. Remember – managing people is not easy either! Play with your friends in co-op! Everything is always more fun with friends! Invite your friends to work on your shelter and find the perfect homes for your animals together! Emote, interact and have fun, all the while being surrounded by beautiful scenery and cute animals. Help animals find their forever homes! The adoption process requires a lot of patience. It is important to pick the correct pet for the right person, and vice versa! In Animal Shelter Simulator 2: Prologue, the potential adopters will be able to visit the shelter and see the pets for themselves before they make up their mind about them. Remember that a lot of things can impact the chance of an adoption: the animal’s traits, their current state, and even the state of the shelter itself! Maintain the shelter and enjoy its beauty! Your shelter is located in a picturesque little town surrounded by the forest and mountains. Make sure that it fits right in among the beautiful scenery – keep it clean and upgrade its features regularly! Enjoy the view of it both during the day and at night! Meet your new furry friends Pet them, play with them, even dress them up! The Animal Shelter is back and its residents are full of life and always eager to interact with you. Make sure that all their needs are met and that they are healthy, and they will repay you with lots of love!
row.short_description: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2: Prologue! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

row.name: BUMP! Superbrawl
row.detailed_description: Welcome to BUMP! Superbrawl, the newest PvP Free To Play game from Ubisoft, where strategic Planning meets explosive action ! BUMP! Superbrawl is a 1v1 action-strategy game set in the utopian City of Arcadia, a vibrant home to mythical deities and legendary creatures from all over the world. Compete in the grand Superbrawl Tournament, where brains and brawn collide for ultimate glory and a shot at fulfilling your mythical purpose in the human world. A Fresh Take on 1v1 Battles! Discover a unique mix of fast-paced strategy and chaotic action: Quick Matches, Big Decisions: Engage in explosive 3-minute battles that keep you on your toes. Simultaneous Turns: Plan your moves, anticipate your opponent, and see the action unfold together in real-time! Strategize and Adapt: Outsmart your rivals in time-limited rounds to take control of the arena. OVER 20 heroes to unlock! Unlock and customize unique heroes inspired by global mythology—from Greek titans to Japanese gods! Each hero brings distinct abilities, including basic, reactive, and passive skills. Build your ultimate trio by combining four archetypes: Brawler, Dasher, Sniper, or Mage. Every game is unique! Test your adaptability in rotating PvP arenas with unique hazards and layouts! Every match offers new surprises and challenges—no two games are the same. Rise to glory! Climb the leaderboards, master the Road to Glory, and unlock powerful rewards in the BUMP Pass. Compete in exciting events, challenge your friends, and showcase your skills on BUMP TV. Are you ready to dominate the Superbrawl Tournament? Join us on Discord to connect with other players and get the latest updates.
row.short_description: BUMP! Superbrawl is a fast-paced 1v1 turn-based strategy game where anticipation and clever planning are your ultimate weapons. Battle in the vibrant utopia of Arcadia, filled with myths and legends from around the world, and outsmart your opponent to claim victory!

row.name: Coyote: An Old West Vignette
row.detailed_description: Coyote: An Old West Vignette is a tiny point-and-click adventure game about a gruff marshall on the trail of a deadly outlaw. It leads him to a saloon in a near-deserted ghost town, where the remaining patrons offer opportunities to bring this gunslinger to justice. But along the way, it becomes less clear who the real outlaw is... Features: A quick 15-minute snack of a game Drenched in spaghetti-western atmosphere Dark humorous tone Hand-drawn 2D characters Navigate quirky dialogues and shoot pesky locks Multiple ways to achieve your goal Full keyboard and controller support Cast: Dylan Nagel as the Coyote Antonio Mena as the Desperado​ Aimee Smith as Eleonor Sean Chiplock as the Bartender Edwyn Tiong as the Mysterious Stranger
row.short_description: Coyote: An Old West Vignette is a tiny point-and-click adventure game about a gruff marshall on the trail of a deadly outlaw.
row.notes: Some cursing, references to stealing, and other old west crime-related activities.

row.name: SoundKilla
row.detailed_description: 🏝️ SoundKilla: RUN DI PLACE Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of Caribbean sound clash culture with SoundKilla . In this dynamic multiplayer experience, you and your crew will battle for sonic supremacy in the ultimate test of rhythm, strategy, and style.​ 🎮 Game Overview RUN DI PLACE is the heart-pounding multiplayer control mode where two teams compete to dominate the dancehall. Capture and hold key zones, unleash powerful dubplates, and outmaneuver your rivals in fast-paced matches that demand both coordination and creativity.​ 🌍 Key Features Dynamic Multiplayer Battles : Engage in matches where teamwork and timing are crucial to control. Authentic Caribbean Vibes : Experience a vibrant world inspired by the rich traditions of Caribbean music and culture, from bustling urban streets to serene island landscapes.​ Customizable Sound Systems : (COMING SOON) and upgrade your own sound system, tailoring your setup to match your playstyle and dominate the competition.​ Strategic Gameplay : (COMING SOON) Utilize unique abilities and power-ups to gain an edge over your opponents, turning the tide of battle in your favor.​ Immersive Story Mode : (COMING SOON) Embark on a compelling journey to help your mother save your family home, collecting rare dubplates and facing formidable bosses along the way.​  🎧 Join the SoundKilla Community Whether you're a seasoned selector or new to the scene, SoundKilla offers an exhilarating blend of music, competition, and culture. Step into the arena, rally your crew, and prove you've got what it takes to RUN DI PLACE.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of Caribbean sound clash culture with SoundKilla. In this dynamic multiplayer experience, you and your crew will battle for sonic supremacy in the ultimate test of rhythm, strategy, and style.
row.notes: The depicted violence in this game comes from the player defeating enemy bosses. The player is tasks to eliminate the enemy. There is gun violence and melee violence. Any depiction signs or symbols in the game that may deemed offensive is not intended to offend or promote any form of racism or bigotry.

row.name: Shrineflow
row.detailed_description: Enter the Yokai Realm Shrineflow is a multiplayer (1 vs 1) hide-and-seek game between a powerful Kitsune and a stealthy Ninja in a Japanese-inspired Yokai arena. The Kitsune uses her magical abilities to interact with the arena and track down her opponent. The Ninja uses his stealth skills and trickery to stay undetected while searching the arena for golden coins that will grant him access to the Kitsune’s treasure trove. No round is like any other, as both characters have multiple abilities to choose from at the start of each game. Will you storm through your realm as the Kitsune, determined to catch the intruder? Or will you evade and outwit a stronger opponent like the Ninja? Enter the arena and outplay your friends in Shrineflow! A Student Team A student team pitched, planned, and developed this project as a capstone (thesis) project at the BYU Center for Animation. This game was accomplished from start to finish in a single year, and we’re incredibly proud of our work. However, please keep in mind this project was completed quickly by students, and you will probably encounter bugs and other hiccups because of this. Most of our amazing team members are moving on to jobs or other coursework, meaning any updates after release are very unlikely. We appreciate your understanding, look forward to your feedback, and hope you enjoy experiencing the world we’ve created.
row.short_description: Shrineflow is a multiplayer (1 vs 1) hide-and-seek game between a Kitsune and a Ninja. The Kitsune uses her magical abilities to track down her opponent. The Ninja uses his stealth skills to stay undetected while he collects enough to coins to break into the treasure trove.

row.name: Turmoil
row.detailed_description: A 3D isometric top-down dieselpunk-inspired, roguelike game. The world of Turmoil is set in an alternate history where humans developed machines that run on oil to automate society. Eventually, machines began making more machines to boost productivity while safety was disregarded. As the last human left in the esteemed factory of Geargrave Automations, Harry suffers a life-threatening injury to the only thing keeping him a valuable asset to the company. Now, with an injured mechanical arm leaking oil, sitting in the trash, Harry realizes he won't survive unless he fights. He must rise from the ashes, learning how to survive with nothing but his leaking arm and a general knowledge of mechanics. His goal is to avenge the humans who were disposed of in the past by defeating the boss, Kornelius Rayburn Geargrave, and shutting down the factory. Geargrave only values efficiency, output, and profit, so when hearing of Harry's retaliation, all robots are set to go hostile when in the presence of deviant employees. Navigate through three different procedurally generated levels of the factory, fighting hostile robots for survival, collecting their oil to continue forward as there is no choice but to persist. Collect blueprints and scrap around the factory to upgrade Harry's mechanical arm. Collect oil canisters to keep him alive and utilize the hazardous environment to defeat attacking robots. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.
row.short_description: Turmoil is a 3D isometric top-down action roguelike game. Inspired by a dieselpunk aesthetic, navigate a winding factory space filled with environmental hazards and hostile robot workers with the goal of survival. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.
row.notes: The story of Turmoil depicts a man with a mechanical right arm. This arm gets caught in a conveyor belt during the opening scene of the game, leading it to be crushed between two metal objects. The gore is minimal as it is shown 2D stylized cutscene. The main character runs on oil rather than blood, so he leaks oil when his arm is crushed. This oil is the player's health and drains consistently throughout the game. The player's only survival option is to fight back against the factory robots that turned on him. The player must kill hostile robots to gain an oil canister pickup, which will provide a health boost

row.name: Hidden Arcade: Hundreds of Ghosts!
row.detailed_description: How did you get here? After befriending your first Ghost in the abandoned Arcade Hall, he asks you to retrieve any Ghosts that are trapped inside the Arcade Games! What do you do now? In order to retrieve the first 100 pieces, you must dive into the world of the Arcade Game Drama Llama and find every last fragment to free every soul. And if you feel up to it, you can dive into 2 distinct Arcade Game experiences and retrieve the last 200 Ghosts trapped in them. What then? You can compete against the whole world in global leaderboards by finding the 100 Ghosts exceedingly quicker! And after that? You can create your own levels or download user-created ones, including their own leaderboards! (Level Editor DLC sold separately for 0.99$. I would like to keep the entire game free, but I sadly have to make back thhe 100$ Steam Fee and get funny stuff like tax advisers that keep me out of jail.) Why would you do all that just to click Ghosts? Because it is just so much fun! Seriously. It is also cozy and relaxing. But most of all, every pop you hear from finding a Ghost releases a bit more dopamine. Thank you for reading this and have a great day! :)
row.short_description: Find and free the hidden Ghosts spread throughout distinct Arcade Game Worlds, and create your own ones!

row.name: Dexmith: Heroes of The SYStem Playtest
Invasion of the Mushroom Men of Planet Y!
row.detailed_description: You've led a normal life-until this morning, that is! You wake up to discover the world is under attack! Evil Mushroom Men from the far reaches of space have come to conquer our world! What vile plans do they have for us, pitiful mammal? It's up to you to decide how you cope with this sudden attack by alien fungi. Choose to be a hero, a villain, or just some schmuck trying to survive and not get fried. Rescue your neighbor, or leave her to her fate. Try to escape the alien onslaught, heroically seek to end the threat they pose, or turn traitor and lead the Mushroom forces to victory. Remember, mammal, the Fate of the World is in your hands! Dum dum dummm!!! Invasion of the Mushroom Men of Planet Y! is a goofy, light hearted visual novel. In addition to making choices to decide where the story goes, a few key choices are dependent on a random luck factor (these points are heavily hinted at in the text).
row.short_description: This is a quick, goofy game that lasts about ten minutes per play through-unless you choose wrongly-organ music, please! In addition to your choices, there is also the random element of chance that may affect your fate. Due to the constraints of the game engine, can only be viewed in windows mode.

row.name: Ubermensch
row.detailed_description: Multiplayer notes You can host & join listen servers when launching the game using option 1 -- this will open a popup in your default browser to link your Epic Games account. If you launch with option 2 to play offline against bots only, be sure to also change the in-game network setting to 'offline' at the map selection screen. About the Game Movement: • Dash: press a directional key + [shift] by default • Boost: while moving forward and aiming up, press the dash key • Slide: press [ctrl] by default Weapons: • Luger: starting in slot 1, accurate hipfire and no damage dropoff • Gewehr 43: starting in slot 2, high damage with shorter maximum range • StG 44: placed around each of the maps Maps: • Envy: capture 2 of the monuments within each of the 3 main temples to win points • Will to Power: TDM, control the pickups in the central building • Eternal Recurrence: TDM with health in nooks along edges of the map
row.short_description: First-person mod of the Unreal Engine Lyra starter project

row.name: Go! Go! Hamster Chef!
row.detailed_description: All of Hamster Chef’s friends are hungry! Only YOU can satisfy their craving. In Go! Go! Hamster Chef! you take the role of Hamster Chef, a plucky young entrepreneur who’s out to make and deliver food to all the animals in the village. Find ingredients, cook dishes, and deliver them to your hungry friends! It’s completely innocent! Your village overflows with the bounty of nature! Fresh ingredients are yours for the taking. Just pop them into your cheek pouches and take them home to your kitchen. I don’t think you’ll ever run out of yummy ingredients to find! Take, take, take, Hamster Chef! Your kitchen is the envy of the town! Use your state-of-the-art appliances and transform your ingredients into dishes that are sure to make your friends’ mouths water! Get the recipe right, Hamster Chef! You’d better not make any mistakes! Hop on your radical scooter and book it to your friends’ homes. You have hungry mouths to feed! Stay on the roads for maximum speed. You’d better not wander off if you know what’s good for you, Hamster Chef! Go! Go! Hamster Chef! was created for an N64-style game jam in just 45 days. Since then, it’s been streamed and recorded by over 300 content creators and gathered over 5 million views! For this Steam release, we’ve rolled out a number of fixes and improvements and also created brand new end-game content! Now’s your chance to experience the definitive version of Go! Go! Hamster Chef!
row.short_description: Help Hamster Chef cook yummy dishes and deliver them to his animal pals in this short, colorful, and definitely-not-spooky adventure.

row.name: 攻城与召唤 Siege and Summons 【5分钟一局 策略竞技 】
row.detailed_description: Siege and Summon is an online turn-based competitive card game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build a deck of cards to challenge powerful players in the world of the Three Kingdoms. NPCs can also fight against other players and form teams to challenge dungeons. Game features ◆ Card deck: Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build their own deck for battle. Soldier cards are divided into: ordinary, elite, and hero. Two ordinary cards can be put into battle; other cards can be put into battle one. The deck can contain up to 30 cards, which can include soldier cards and skill cards. ◆How to play: Players use their respective decks to fight on a 3*10 field. The enemy and we take turns taking action until the opponent's general or our general is defeated. ◆ Profession: Players can freely choose among 4 professions: Swordsman, Dharma Lord, Taoist Saint, and Divine Arrow; each deck can only use the same profession card. ◆ Push pictures: After building a deck, players can engage in push battles to fight against NPC decks with their own characteristics; push pictures to obtain protagonist experience, copper coins and various treasure chests; and only push pictures can obtain advanced professional cards. ◆Competition: After the arena is opened, you can compete with other players, and it is endless fun to fight with others; the arena is settled quarterly, and each quarter is based on the player's points ranking. The top players can get the soldier card that will be launched next season. ◆ Team formation: After the team dungeon is opened, you can form a team with other players to challenge high-difficulty dungeons; the dungeons are divided into three difficulty levels: simple, normal, and difficult. The higher the difficulty, the greater the benefits.
row.short_description: Siege and Summon is an online turn-based competitive card game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build a deck of cards to challenge powerful players in the world of the tk. NPCs can also fight against other players and form teams to challenge dungeons.

row.name: Clue For Your Thoughts
row.detailed_description: In this murder mystery game, you are a detective tasked with solving the weird, strange and the weirder. Read through the general description, witness interviews, case facts, chat logs and sift through the evidence to figure out who did it. Once you've come to your conclusion, You can accuse who did it. Be careful, everyone has something to hide, but only one person did it. Leave no stone unturned, one small clue may be all you get. Investigate love triangles, discover hidden motives and question fashion decisions on your journey through 12 unique cases in Clue For Your Thoughts!
row.short_description: Sift through the evidence to find out who did it.
row.notes: Mature themes, bad language, depictions of blood and innuendo

At the moment such as: - 'CUBES' a multiplayer game where players first build their castle using children's figures, and then try to destroy the enemy's castle by shooting from a huge cannon. Made in a friendly and very cute setting. - 'Cubes 2D' a single-player game similar to Tetris, but with a number of improvements and difficulty settings.
row.short_description: Collection of works by Worfy

row.name: WWII Squad Level Land Battles ssp
row.detailed_description: It is a Hard core Turn based Chit based wargame set in WW2, But quite easy to use, a simple left click to move or right click to attack. The Chits Represent Small Arms , Squads and AFVs. you have Leaders that improve units they are near to. There is terrain effects modifiers, Leader Bonuses, Armor and Anti-Armor weapons. There is a good Line of sight system and walls so you can karal enemy units to say a building. the editor is great allows you to set everything and create victory points, on the main game screen I added copy and paste of units so modules are easy to create. The big thing that shines in this game is a great A.I. and opfire. the userstuff folder you can add your own graphics for officers or tanks.
row.short_description: A Wargame for Grognards, its a little bit complicated for the average user. it is chits representing the units . the combat is decided by dice rolls and modifiers. It is 2D topdown. with a fantastic A.I.

row.name: Warfare : Battleground™
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in a world of dynamic battles in the new indie game Warfare: Battleground. Play on exciting maps, including a variety of locations. Use a variety of weapons and unique equipment to summon reinforcements and deal devastating damage. Take part in familiar childhood modes such as Point Control or Team Battle, with support for up to 16 players. The map size will adjust for each mode accordingly, creating continuous tension. Night maps add atmosphere and necessitate the use of flashlights, however they are not available for every weapon, which will force players to not get used to one weapon. The complex shooting and weapon control mechanics will require you to have fast reaction times and extreme accuracy. Gather in co-op and destroy enemies together. Join the development of the game together with the community. Speak your ideas, participate in the community, and you will help the developers to make the game better.
row.short_description: Join Warfare: Battleground, an arcade multiplayer first-person shooter! Fight in a variety of modes using a large arsenal of weapons and destroy your opponents with helicopters and air strikes. Are you ready for battle?

row.name: Distant
row.detailed_description: Imagine yourself diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. How would you see the world? What emotions would you experience? What would your symptoms look like? Distant aims to answer these questions by putting you in the shoes of someone with Alzheimer's disease. In this first-person 10-minute experience, you will experience some of the symptoms that those with Alzheimer's face every day. With some simple puzzles and games, you can expect to gain an understanding of: - The fears - Auditory hallucinations - and disorientation that those with Alzheimer's may suffer from. You will also gain an understanding of some of the safety precautions that one can take to ensure a safe environment for those with Alzheimer's.
row.short_description: Imagine yourself diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. How would you see the world? What emotions would you experience? What would your symptoms look like? Answer these questions yourself by playing in the shoes of someone with the disease, first-person.

row.name: Sorcerer Smackdown
row.detailed_description: Open Alpha's premiere local 2D fighting experience tears its way into the ring! Use both muscles and magic to beat down your opponents and prove yourself as the mightiest mage in the arena! Meet the fantastic fighters: - Boodini is the spookish spectre of an unspecified magician, back from the dead to try his hand at a different kind of performance-- physical performance! Along with him is his dutiful assistant, the Metaldead, a necromatic musician always eager to hype up her now ghostly partner! This duo isn't just undying, it's post-dying, too! - Stone Cold is a frosty, frigid fighter... an ever-cold elemental... a bone-chilling brawler. This cryogenic character likes to use a cool combination of wintry wandwork and freezing fisticuffs to defeat its foes. - Lurking in the comments of nearly every online forum is a valiant keyboard warrior known throughout the interwebs as u/Grand-Magician29. Despite being a mere mortal, this basement-dweller fancies himself quite the magic aficionado (just ask the five magic-related subreddits he moderates). But whatever you do, don't insult his waifu 4 laifu, or he'll have no choice but to unsheath his (totally authentic) katana and defend her honor! - Don't let his flimsy fairy wings fool you: Rock Hard is packing! A punch, that is. His rippling muscles will intimidate any foe who dares draw near, but all he really needs is his tiny pink wand to vanquish them. When you're up against Rock Hard, you're in between him and a hard place!
row.short_description: In Sorcerer Smackdown, joining the fight is simple: grab a friend, choose a character, and let the match begin! Unleash both physical and magical attacks using the keyboard for commands, mixing and matching moves to craft devastating combos to prevail against your opponent!

row.name: Gummy Jump 2
row.detailed_description: You just emerged from the depths of the colossal machine, only to find that its vastness far exceeds your wildest imagination. The metallic walls tower over you, casting long shadows that shift ominously as you explore your surroundings. As you take in the intricate machinery around you However, time is not on your side. you must act swiftly and decisively. Scattered throughout the environment are hidden collectibles that can aid you in your quest for survival. Each item you find could provide crucial advantages in your battles ahead. As you progress, the tension mounts, culminating in an epic boss fight that will determine your fate. Will you harness the knowledge from the items you’ve collected to emerge victorious, or will you fall to the relentless foe that pursues you? In this treacherous world, every choice matters, and survival is just the beginning of your journey.
row.short_description: you just climbed out of the machine only to realize it's a lot bigger then you imagined, you meet an older gummy that seems familiar, there are enemies trying to track you down, find collectibles, use the furnaces to melt the robots and consume the gummy bear enemies.

row.name: Event Horizon
row.detailed_description: An amnesiac astronaut wakes up disoriented after an unscheduled landing in an unknown location among the cosmos. Who are you? Where are you? And why are you here? Something calls, the star of the void awaits... Descend into the depths of the event horizon with the assistance of The Motherboard, an artificial intelligence that miraculously survived the crash. Regain the memories of the astronaut as you fight through the deserted Outer, the lush Inner, and the crystalized Center. Wield the state-of-the-art Nexus-BHG , or Nexus-Black Hole Gun, a powerful hunk of metal capable of harnessing and condensing a black hole's power into a single burst. When all else fails, the astronaut may upgrade their standard-issued blaster to make an attempt at rivaling the Nexus-BHG's strength. Anomalies Unidentified alien lifeforms who inhabit the dark crevices of the event horizon, varying from humanly familiar to formlessly obscure. The astronaut must find and scan these creatures to learn more about them. Are they intelligent? Why can they speak? One will watch the astronaut walk by while the other clings to the astronauts legs. These multi-classed enemies will vary in threat level and the astronaut must dispose of them as they see fit. Be warned. The Omniscanner A device attached to the astronaut’s gauntlet allows them to scan all life forms found in the event horizon and give real-time analysis of the objects scanned. All data is tracked in the Logbook, and information is secretly sent back to Earth without the astronaut knowing it. The Logbook (LOG) The Logbook, also called The LOG, is a device attached to the astronaut that is an extension of The Motherboard. This device stores and retrieves data on everything the astronaut has scanned with the Omniscanner. Additionally, it allows the astronaut to tap into the functions of The Motherboard without being directly on the spacecraft. The Logbook is programmed to send information back to The Motherboard and keep track of the astronaut's health. The Quantum Stabilizer A device that can stabilize The ███████████, and prevent it from growing or consuming nearby matter. This device is a container that has the ability to capture, manipulate and utilize quantum forces. The Tachyon Translocator A radar device that allows the astronaut to track pulses of high-frequency electromagnetic waves that are reflected off the object back to the source. The astronaut may utilize this device to to track rifts in time and space, allowing for travel between layers of the black hole through The Motherboard's systems. The ███████████ An unknown entity known to be “the center of space and time.” Local anomalies do not know much about this being other than the fact that it exists and resides deep within the layers of the event horizon. The ███████████ is also rumored to hold cosmic powers, including the ability to reverse time.
row.short_description: Event Horizon is an action-adventure sci-fi shooter with the heart of souls-like utilizing gun modification and first-person scanning to explore the unknown depths of the cosmos.

row.name: Sector Unknown - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown . Sector Unknown - Prologue is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2 , Knights of the Old Republic , Fallout: New Vegas , as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3 , Encased , Colony Ship , Trudograd , and Pathfinder: Kingmaker . Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. Alongside combat, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically. Story In Sector Unknown - Prologue , your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories. In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful mega-corporation that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now absent from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and forsaken planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all. Sector Unknown - Prologue weaves themes of exploration, discovery, conflict and greed, crafting an epic tale of adventure and rebellion in the boundless expanse of space. With the Prologue version of the game, the entire first planet of Maku will be available for players. Choose Your Path In Sector Unknown - Prologue , every choice you make shapes your journey. As you traverse through null sector, your interactions with characters and factions on each planet will uniquely influence the narrative. Your decisions determine not only the outcome of each planetary story arc but also the fate of the entire sector. From forging alliances to making tough moral choices, your path is yours to define. Whether through diplomacy, strategy, or combat, your story will unfold in a way that reflects your personal play-style and decisions, culminating in a truly bespoke gaming experience where you are the architect of your destiny. Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown.
row.short_description: Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free demo of the story-rich, isometric RPG Sector Unknown. Start on the desolate planet of Maku, establish a stronghold, ally with or dominate local factions, and combat a tyrannical organization set on ruthlessly exploiting the sector's resources and inhabitants.
row.notes: This game features content that may be unsettling for some players. The scenes in question are not depicted in graphic detail and are presented in an isometric perspective, occurring sporadically throughout the gameplay. Players can expect to see occasional blood and read harsh language. Alcohol and some narcotics are used by characters. Discretion is advised.

row.name: Star-Wired
row.detailed_description: A Game Design Capstone Project - By DePaul University Students! After returning from a star-dust-scavenging trip, Bit, our little starling captain, finds his Ship commandeered by an intergalactic militia, the Infestors. To save his home, he ventures within the circuits of his Starship friend, to rewire damage done by the Infestors and rid the circuits of malware. PHYSICS BASED CABLE GAMEPLAY! Star-Wired is a whimsical, endearing, top-down puzzle game, with a focus on plugging in cables to power level mechanics! The cables can be pushed, tangled, pulled, wrapped around, and swung to complete circuits and open the exit door of each level. DEV TEAM Liv Baughman: art lead, environment, and 2D art Maeve Butler: 3D art and animation Brandon Ehrman: 3D art Tyler Ackerman: level design and gameplay programming Catherine Simmons: producer, social media manager Kai Langevin: lead programmer Jake Arthur: designer, prototype SOUND TEAM Beth Sawltz: sound design, music Collin Wittlich: cutscene sound effects, music
row.short_description: Repair the circuitry of your Starship and clear out the intrusive programs in a cute and casual puzzle game. Plug in cables, activate moving objects, and dodge malicious entities on your quest for success!

row.name: Dwarven Realm
row.detailed_description: Dwarven Realm Explore an epic fantasy medieval world crafted on the Unreal Engine 5 where dwarves fight for survival in a hostile universe. In this captivating strategy/idle game , guide your colony of dwarves through unique challenges , tough moral choices, and unforgettable encounters. Explore , mine , upgrade , trade to ensure the prosperity of your people in a game where every decision matters. Are you ready to lead your own clan of dwarves? Dive into the adventure now! Gameplay In this game, with an RTS camera view, you will lead a colony of dwarves on a hostile mountain, where the survival of your clan depends on your wise choices. Extract precious resources , expand your colony , and evade the dangers of this fantastical world. With rich gameplay mechanics and strategic depth, each playthrough is a unique adventure that will test your management skills and ingenuity. Narration Dive into an immersive, choice-driven narrative where every decision shapes the destiny of your dwarf colony . In this captivating game, your leadership is put to the test as you guide your companions through an epic story. Get ready to embark on a narrative adventure where your decisions impact the world around you. Artistic Direction Dwarven Realm offers an immersive stylized 3D art direction that plunges you into the epic world of dwarves. From majestic mountain landscapes to intricate details of dwarven structures, with the assistance of Unreal Engine 5, every visual element is carefully crafted to capture players' imagination. Project Status Dwarven Realm is a student project developed from scratch in less than 3 months.
row.short_description: Explore an epic fantasy medieval world where dwarves fight for survival in a hostile universe. Guide your colony of dwarves through unique challenges, tough moral choices, and unforgettable encounters. Explore, mine, build, trade to ensure the prosperity of your people.

row.name: Tarlis World
row.detailed_description: Game contains 7 campaign maps with many quests around You can choose up to two classes from up to 12 max character slots Each class have to choose up from 6 skills Try again after beating campaign by choosing higher difficulty Game has 4 elements to get your wanted one! (Fire, Cold, Knockback, Lifedrain) Necromancer has ability to summon your undead ones to fight for you! Teleport to base using portal skill anytime to get your gear up/sell Collect and unlock achievements during play
row.short_description: 'Tarlis World' is game where you rule the world with your own tactic or strategy to achieve your goals!
row.notes: Game containts much blood and killing

row.name: Space Cats
row.detailed_description: Space Cats thrusts you into the fur of a daring space-faring feline with one simple mission: Don't. Hit. Rockets. The controls are straightforward, ensuring you'll pick up the gameplay in no time, but mastering it is a whole other story. Each session is a new adventure thanks to the procedurally generated obstacles that keep the challenge fresh and engaging. You aren't alone, however. Space cat aliens will randomly fly by. Should you collide with one, you'll get a healthy dose of Catnip. Encountering this cosmic phenomenon doubles your points but launches you into a high-speed, psychedelic state that turns the gameplay into a frenetic and visually wacky experience. It's a thrilling risk that tests your skills and reflexes to the extreme. Crafted for players who enjoy a blend of challenge, humor, and nostalgia, Space Cats draws inspiration from the quirky side of early internet culture. It's designed to be lighthearted and entertaining, perfect for those moments when you want to dive into a game that doesn't take itself too seriously but still offers a compelling gameplay experience. Whether you're aiming to crush your high score or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, Space Cats promises a delightful mix of classic gaming mechanics, modern challenges, and a good dose of early internet-era humor. Get ready to dodge, dash, and dive through the cosmos with the most adventurous cats in the galaxy!
row.short_description: 'Space Cats': Zip around as a space cat dodging rockets and grabbing Catnip for double points and a trippy speed boost. A fresh, funny game with a nod to internet culture, blending challenge, humor, and nostalgia.

row.name: Glitch Maze.exe
row.detailed_description: Glitch Maze.exe is a casual maze game, that draws inspiration from games like Pac-Man, while adding subtle horror elements. The game embraces the concept of using your past failures to progress: every time you die, you leave behind a small beacon of light that reveals parts of the maze and dangers lurking in it. Features Explore 18 handcrafted mazes Use your past failures to beat the maze or play cautiously Use power-ups to highlight or freeze the dangers Gather high scores to alter the dynamic on the level Find sercrets
row.short_description: In this fast-paced arcade game, inspired by Pac-Man, you navigate through a dark maze, chasing the highest score. Avoid the lurking dangers, find secrets and game-changing power-ups as you explore the maze. And remember, even your failures can illuminate your path through the darkness.

row.name: The Courage to be Disliked
row.detailed_description: Depression,exhaustion ...... A young girl's life is full of pain, she doesn't understand why. One day, she came to a strange village where a sign at the entrance says: 'It is shameful to reject others.' In the village, there was no option to refuse others. The villagers each have their own unique stories and requests, some offering important insights while others needing help and understanding. She has to interact with the villagers, complete tasks and explore their stories. With such rules, how could she find a way to leave the village? What kind of insights would she gain on this journey?' In the game, you will explore a rich and colorful main map, encountering some cute but odd NPC characters, each with a unique personality. Completing their tasks not only progresses the story but also bring you unexpected rewards and revelations. In addition to interacting with the NPCs, you will also need to will also face challenges of puzzles , finding objects and battles, uncovering secrets hidden within the game world. This is a journey of inner healing exploration, hoping to convey the importance of finding courage and happiness through player experiences. Everyone will discover their own healing and revelations in this unique world because every adventure is a journey of inner growth and exploration. Are you ready to embark on your journey of the heart? This game is an older one previously made in RMXP with low resolution. The game flow takes about 40 minutes and there is only one ending. %% The game is using Arial fonts, If there is a problem displaying fonts please download Arial fonts file and put it in C:\Windows\Fonts folder. Here are some of the characters that appear in the game: The main role of the game, an ordinary girl The grumpy old lady. The talking frog. Don't kiss him. He won't turn into a prince. Cute kitten with magical powers The farmer with loud voice
row.short_description: A Healing Journey to Find Yourself

row.name: Evil Sinister
row.detailed_description: Several Episodes Join us into the abyss Evil Sinister will have several chapters , so stay informed by: And join: These smalls actions really help me a lot and you will get updates about the game release. About the Game Evil Sinister: Introduction In Evil Sinister you are an independent journalist thrust into the heart of darkness as you lead a daring investigation into an infamous abandoned house. Whispers of malevolent forces and chilling disturbances have plagued the neighboring community, beckoning you to uncover the truth behind the sinister secrets lurking within. Feel the fear Armed with only your determination and a flickering flashlight, you embark on a harrowing journey into the depths of the abandoned abode. Every creaking floorboard and ominous shadow sends a shiver down your spine as you navigate the foreboding halls, piecing together the fragmented remnants of the house's grim history. But beware, for you are not alone in your pursuit of the truth. Sinister entities and otherworldly apparitions haunt the corridors, determined to thwart your progress and drive you to the brink of madness. As you delve deeper into the darkness, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur, and you must rely on your keen investigative skills to survive the onslaught of supernatural horrors. Find the thruth Evil Sinister is a pulse-pounding psychological horror game, that will test your courage and resilience in the face of unspeakable evil. Will you uncover the chilling secrets of the abandoned house, or will you become just another victim of its malevolent grasp? The answers lie within, waiting to be discovered by those brave enough to confront the darkness head-on.
row.short_description: You're a journalist investigating an abandoned house. Armed with only a flashlight, navigate its haunted halls to uncover its secrets. Beware, malevolent forces lurk, blurring reality and nightmare. Will you survive to reveal the truth, or become another victim of its sinister grasp?

row.name: Video Connector

row.name: 修仙小屋
row.detailed_description: 此游戏是作者下班后闲暇时独自一人开发，服务需费用以及Steam注册费用都是自掏，更新较慢，不喜勿喷！非商业游戏，无氪金无充值！ （注：这是一个多人在线的文字网游，非单机游戏!） （注：这是一个多人在线的文字网游，非单机游戏!） （注：这是一个多人在线的文字网游，非单机游戏!） 为什么会被微软防火墙判断为病毒或其他杀软拦截或者更新失败卡死？ 答：个人开发者开发的小游戏，没有公司资质或安全背书。因为游戏有联网操作，所以会被各种安全软件误报为威胁而拦截删除。有时候更新完之后新的exe程序还未提交给杀软厂商白名单审核，所以也会被识别为危险软件。更新失败卡死也是同样的原因，杀软识别为病毒自动删除了程序，所以不管怎么更新都会一直失败。 如何解决：百度一下如何彻底关闭win10 defener。用其他杀毒软件的话将游戏加入白名单也行（每次更新客户端都要加，因为exe程序更新了） 这是一款文字挂机类修仙小游戏，主打的就是上班摸鱼挂机修仙。 游戏介绍： 游戏主打摸鱼时能够聊天吹牛，并且聊天环境会被维护的很轻松休闲（禁止一切涉黄、低俗之类的言论，违者禁言或封号）。 目前游戏经过重新设计优化（写设计文档写了3个月，200多页），游戏本身已经做到了很大程度的平衡，玩家直接没有最强，基本都是互相克制，具体可以通过游玩体验。 游戏目前已开发的共有11个功能（还有几个功能慢慢开发） 介绍一下目前已有功能： 人物： 人物界面能够看到自己的所有属性，大部分内容都是能够看懂的，有几个需要单独介绍下。 首先修为跟血量挂钩，1修为=1血量。 唯一通行货币就是金币，金币可以在市井里交易购买其他人的物品。 精力和体力也做了改动，可以叠加了，每日签到获取精力时不会清空剩余的数值，而是直接叠加上去，等于就是无限上限！ 运势只有有普通，好运，超级好运。运势涉及到历练收益、挖矿采药收益，具体可在游戏时体会。 闪避命中改为了通过装备中的佩饰来获取了，新增了暴击和韧性，暴击意为战斗时几率打出倍率伤害，而韧性是抵消对方对你打出暴击的概率。 五行属性： 金：1金=1物理攻击 火：1火=1道术攻击 木：1木=50血 土：1土=1物理防御 水：1水=1道术防御 装备属性：防具和武器的第二属性，具体可以在字面意思看出来，属于战斗时发挥作用的属性。 背包： 背包功能就跟大部分网游的背包基本一样，只是大幅度优化了体验，在背包物品上左键和右键都可以有对应的弹出框操作，具体可以实际体验（非常方便）。同时背包里放入了穿戴装备功能，能够看到已穿戴的装备。本游戏中装备是主要玩法之一。 历练： 历练是主要玩法中的另一个重要点，通过历练不同的地图能够获取不同的属性点，每个属性点加的属性都不一样，具体的可以根据自己喜欢的属性去历练。 洞府： 洞府包含了道侣、单双修、打坐挖矿采药功能。 单修：每12分钟恢复1精力 双修：每10分钟恢复1精力 单修双修成功时可以获得2-5金币或修为 单双修成功时有几率获得1灵玉，福袋 双修时成功了可以获得道侣好感度，双修失败将会降低好感度，最低为0 单双修时不可以历练 单双修、打坐无论是失败还是成功都有几率触发机遇事件（2%概率） 打坐可以恢复体力，每15分钟可以恢复1体力。打坐时不可以挖矿，采药。 挖矿可以获得灵石，采药可以获得灵草，灵石可以用来强化，灵草后面可以用来炼丹。 BOSS: 可以获得金币和修为，几率获得对应地图所属装备，具体爆率可以查看各BOSS爆率。每日报名时间为0-15点，15-0点为获取结果时间。 市井： 就是其他网游的摆摊功能，可以自由交易，任何物品都可以交易！每日领取的物品也可以交易！没有国产游戏的呕心绑定系统！ 排行榜： 可以玩到各个属性的排名，每2小时自动更新一次，大部分榜单只能看到你所属大境界的排名，例如你是合体境，那么你只能看到合体境及以下的前50名排名。另外需要用户主动去点击同步数据，你的各属性数据才会同步进排行榜进行排名的。 奇遇： 历练、单双修、打坐、采药挖矿时无论失败还是成功都有几率遇到奇遇，遇到的奇遇有效期为2个小时，2个小时之后想要恢复奇遇就得使用奇遇丹，目前每日签到可以获取奇遇丹，后面通过炼丹可以获得奇遇丹。奇遇顾名思义可以获得一些东西也可能失去一些东西，具体有哪些东西就通过游玩来体验吧！ 设置： 目前设置里有设置最小化时是托盘化还是放置任务栏，以及在设置里戴上你拥有的称号（称号需要在背包里使用后才能显示在设置里面，使用后就变成你自己的物品了不可以交易，在背包里的称号物品是可以交易的！） 反馈： 有任何问题或BUG可以通过反馈快速提交，作者看到后会进行回复，一些重大BUG会给与称号的奖励！
row.short_description: 这是一款文字挂机类修仙聊天小游戏，主打的就是上班摸鱼聊天挂机修仙。（注：这是一个多人在线的文字网游，非单机游戏!）

row.name: Horror Family｜恐怖家族  - Flight
row.detailed_description: 'Horror Family - Flight' is a loop-based horror game set on an airplane and is the first installment in the Horror Family series. Story : The protagonist (Mitsuo Nakamura) falls asleep on a plane on his way back from a business trip. And when he wakes up... Gameplay : This game is a loop-based horror game. Immersion : The game screen flickers with noise, intensifying the horror. Play Time : It can be completed in about 20 minutes. Developer's Anecdote : Developed single-handedly by a 15-year-old. Notice :The title has been changed from “Grudge Murder” to “Horror Family”. row.name: Speakeasy
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Speakeasy,  a fast-paced 2D shoot'em up adventure set against the backdrop of 1930s Chicago. In Speakeasy, you're the last line of defense for an iconic speakeasy against a relentless mafia onslaught. They're not just any enemies; they're creditors turned attackers, determined to settle scores because of the debts you owe. Your mission? Protect your sanctuary using wit, strategy, and firepower at all costs.  As you navigate through wave after wave of enemies, Speakeasy offers a frenetic gameplay experience that captures the essence of the era with a modern, dynamic twist. It's not just a game; it's a test of resilience and quick thinking, where every shot counts, and every decision could be your last. Prepare to defend your speakeasy, outsmart the mafia, and immerse yourself in the excitement of 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique. Controls WASD or Arrow Keys to Move Horizontally . Spacebar to Crouch . F Key (and hover mouse) to Fix Obstacles . Left Mouse Click to Shoot . Credits Ella Andersson: Sound Design, SFX Artist, Game Design and Documentation. Juan F. Gutierrez: Game Direction, Creative Direction, Programming, Sound and VFX Direction, Lead Programming, UI/UX Lead Designer, Lead Game Design, Project Management Support, and Lead Sound Design. Kasper G. Hellqvist: Game Design and Programming Associate. Ladan Roohian: Art Direction, Lead Artist, Environmental Artist, Animation Artist and Game Design. Martin Pritula: Creative Direction, Head of Production, Scrum Master, Release Manager, Marketing Manager & Artist, UI Consulting and Lead Game Design. Vera Jeukendrup: Art Direction, Lead Character Artist, Character Animation, and Game Design. Music Used Win Screen Lose Screen
row.short_description: An isometric shoot 'em-up minigame set in an underground bar in 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique.

row.name: Element Release: Water Territory  元素释放：水之领域 Playtest
AI-VJ
row.detailed_description: Wow your DJ shows, house parties, and events, with curated, pre-generated AI visuals and live fractals! The AI VJ app offers curated, pre-generated audio reactive AI visuals to Wow your DJ shows, house parties and events! It is minimalistic VJ software that syncs visuals with your music using Ableton Link or any live audio source, for mesmerizing effects Working features already include: – Has great default settings that take care of the VJing for you. So you can focus on DJing again! – Supports a projector (secondary screen), but can also be run on a single screen; clicking to the side hides the UI – Use Ableton Link to connect to Virtual DJ, Rekordbox, Traktor, Serato and other popular DJ software, for perfect sync – Fallback to line-in input, microphone input, WASAPI, or native PC audio loopback to estimate BPM from any live audio source – Usable with your own VJ videos / VJ loops collection – Make picture slide-shows for special events by loading your own pictures onto a deck. Automatically audio synced! – Easily re-arrange, and inter-mix visual clips, fractals and pictures through drag and dropping visuals, banks, decks and sets – You can control AI-VJ using your keyboard and mouse. No VJ controller needed! It's already close to being one of the easiest VJ programs to set up & use For DJs it's the best VJ software to quickly get going! Oh, and it's completely FREE VJ software! Visuals beyond samples will be released as paid DLC. Some non-core elements are, and will be DLCs, such as the Customize Your DJ Logo DLC, which allows you to customize your DJ logo for public DJ shows. But other than that it's a fully functional & completely free VJ app! If you enjoy AI VJ and would like to support further development, you could consider buying DLCs
row.short_description: Add mesmerizing AI visuals to your DJ shows. Liven up the big screen at house parties! Get perfect sync by linking up with all popular DJ software, or by using estimated beats per minute from any audio playing on your PC (such as Youtube or Spotify). Can even play your own VJ loops and VJ videos!
